papers.title: From Text to Simulation: Building EPANET Models from Formalized Network Descriptions with a Local Language Model

summary.en: A software pipeline uses a local LLM to construct and correct EPANET water-distribution-network models from formalized natural-language descriptions.

details.en: The paper presents HydraKG, which builds EPANET models from tabular or verbal network descriptions, validates the resulting models, and uses an LLM for extraction and correction in the verbal workflow. It evaluates the approach on seven networks, including a real distribution zone.

limitations.en: Assessment is based only on the supplied title and abstract; implementation details beyond the described LLM workflow are not available.

papers.title: Construction of a reservoir flood control scheduling knowledge graph through co-creation between large language models and domain experts

summary.en: The paper proposes an expert–LLM co-creation method for constructing a reservoir flood-control scheduling knowledge graph from unstructured documents.

details.en: LECERI combines autonomous LLM-based exploration with expert refinement to improve the accuracy and completeness of a knowledge graph supporting reservoir flood-control scheduling. It reports precision, recall, and F1 scores of 0.52, 0.61, and 0.56.

limitations.en: Assessment is based only on the supplied abstract; implementation details and broader evaluation context are not available.

papers.title: Post-processing Subglacial Physics Model with Per-site JEPA Specialist Models Enable Natural-language Glaciological Intelligence

summary.en: A preprint analyzes subglacial hydrology and glacier sliding using physics-based simulations and interpretable machine learning, then builds a natural-language glaciological intelligence system with per-glacier JEPA specialists and an agentic LLM router.
summary.zh: 一篇预印本使用基于物理的模拟和可解释机器学习分析冰下水文与冰川滑动，随后构建了一个自然语言冰川学智能系统，其中包含按冰川划分的 JEPA 专家和一个智能体式 LLM 路由器。

details.en: The study examines how subglacial water pressure, bed geometry, meltwater input, and system state relate to glacier sliding across four glaciers. It then uses glacier-specific JEPA representations queried by Claude Sonnet/Opus to retrieve specialist information and improve natural-language answers.
details.zh: 该研究考察了冰下水压、冰床几何形态、融水输入和系统状态如何与四座冰川的冰川滑动相关。随后，该研究使用由 Claude Sonnet/Opus 查询的特定冰川 JEPA 表征来检索专家信息并改进自然语言回答。

limitations.en: Assessment is based solely on the supplied abstract; implementation and evaluation details beyond the abstract are unavailable.
limitations.zh: 评估完全基于所提供的摘要；摘要之外的实现和评估细节不可用。

papers.title: GeoAI Platform for Natural Language Exploration of Multidimensional Flood Risk Scenarios

summary.en: A GeoAI platform enables natural-language exploration of multidimensional coastal flood-risk scenarios through a deterministic tool-routed LLM agent and spatially grounded map-chat interface.
summary.zh: 一个 GeoAI 平台通过确定性的工具路由 LLM 代理和具有空间定位的地图聊天界面，实现对多维沿海洪水风险情景的自然语言探索。

details.en: The preprint presents a queryable store for 141 flood scenarios and related physical and socioeconomic data, plus an LLM agent that translates compound natural-language planning questions into geospatial tool calls.
details.zh: 该预印本介绍了一个可查询的存储库，其中包含 141 个洪水情景及相关的物理和社会经济数据，以及一个将复合自然语言规划问题转换为地理空间工具调用的 LLM 代理。

limitations.en: Assessment is based solely on the supplied title and abstract; implementation details and quantitative evaluation results are not provided.
limitations.zh: 评估完全基于所提供的标题和摘要；未提供实现细节和定量评估结果。

papers.title: Do large language models improve hydrologic model calibration?

summary.en: Evaluates whether large language models improve hydrologic model calibration.
summary.zh: 评估大语言模型是否能改进水文模型校准。

details.en: The title frames a direct evaluation of LLM use in hydrologic model calibration.
details.zh: 标题对 LLM 在水文模型校准中的使用进行了直接评估。

limitations.en: Only the title and metadata were supplied; the abstract, methods, datasets, and quantitative results are unavailable.
limitations.zh: 仅提供了标题和元数据；摘要、方法、数据集和定量结果均不可用。

papers.title: Toward Agent-Native Water Systems: A Case Study of the Digital Transformation of a 2,300-square-kilometer Watershed, its Sensors, Dams, and the People Who Control Them

summary.en: A case study of an agentic digital transformation across a large watershed, its dams, sensors, operators, and water-management workflows.
summary.zh: 一项关于大型流域及其水坝、传感器、操作人员和水资源管理工作流程中代理式数字化转型的案例研究。

details.en: The paper evaluates agent readiness through field logistics, network automation, stormwater planning, sensor reporting, and audited translation of operator questions into water-modeling workflows.
details.zh: 该论文通过现场物流、网络自动化、雨洪水规划、传感器报告，以及将操作人员的问题经审计后转化为水建模工作流程，评估代理就绪度。

limitations.en: The supplied abstract does not identify the specific LLM or agent model architecture, but it directly documents substantive AI-agent operation and evaluation in water workflows.
limitations.zh: 所提供的摘要未确定具体的 LLM 或代理模型架构，但直接记录了水工作流程中实质性的 AI 代理运行与评估。

papers.title: Using a Large Language Model for Accurate Technical Language Generation in the Predictive Maintenance of Circulating Water Systems in Nuclear Power Plants
papers.venue: Nuclear Plant Instrumentation and Control & Human-Machine Interface Technology (NPIC&HMIT 2025)

summary.en: A large language model is used for technical language generation in the predictive maintenance of circulating water systems at nuclear power plants.
summary.zh: 使用大型语言模型为核电厂循环水系统的预测性维护生成技术语言。

details.en: The title indicates a water-system predictive-maintenance application in which an LLM generates accurate technical language.
details.zh: 标题表明，这是一个水系统预测性维护应用，其中 LLM 生成准确的技术语言。

limitations.en: The abstract is empty, so the decision relies on the title and supplied metadata; implementation details and evaluation evidence are unavailable.
limitations.zh: 摘要为空，因此判断依赖于标题和所提供的元数据；实施细节和评估证据不可用。

papers.title: Data and code for "Deferring construction, reconsidering reliance: investment sequencing in the Waikato water-supply decision"
papers.venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)

summary.en: Data and code supporting an analysis of investment sequencing in the Waikato water-supply decision, including illustrative timing chronologies, successor-attribution comparisons, reproduction scripts, and an analytical figure.
summary.zh: 支持对Waikato供水决策中的投资排序进行分析的数据和代码，包括说明性时序、后续归因比较、复现脚本和分析图。

details.en: The release documents assumptions, historical sources, calculations, code, and visualisation for reconstructing the historical design of the 2021–2022 Waikato water-supply decision. The calculations and timing relationships are explicitly illustrative rather than observations of implemented supply or policy outcomes.
details.zh: 该发布内容记录了用于重构2021–2022年Waikato供水决策历史设计的假设、历史来源、计算、代码和可视化。计算结果和时间关系明确是说明性的，而非对已实施供水或政策结果的观测。

limitations.en: The record states that the calculations are illustrative and that the associated manuscript is separate and as-yet-unsubmitted; the extent of human versus LLM contribution is not further quantified.
limitations.zh: 该记录说明这些计算是说明性的，相关手稿是独立的且尚未提交；人类与LLM贡献的程度尚未进一步量化。

papers.title: Pre-registration: precipitation phase and event streamflow delivery in snow-affected US catchments (p304_phase)
papers.venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)

summary.en: A preregistration for testing whether rain-versus-snow precipitation changes event-scale streamflow delivery across snow-affected US catchments.
summary.zh: 一份预注册方案，用于检验降雨与降雪降水是否会改变受积雪影响的美国流域中事件尺度的河流流量输送。

details.en: The work specifies matched-catchment, within-catchment, and dose-response analyses of 7-, 30-, and 90-day quickflow delivery fractions. It is outcome-blind at deposit, with no snow-versus-rain contrast yet examined. An AI agent wrote and ran the analysis code under a predefined protocol.
details.zh: 该工作规定了对7天、30天和90天快速流量输送比例进行匹配流域、流域内和剂量-反应分析。该方案在数据存档时对结果保持盲态，尚未检验降雪与降雨之间的对比。一名AI代理根据预定义协议编写并运行了分析代码。

limitations.en: This is a preregistration and reports no completed snow-versus-rain contrast or substantive scientific results. The supplied text supports code-writing and code-execution involvement, but does not specify further LLM reasoning or interpretation.
limitations.zh: 这是一份预注册方案，未报告已完成的降雪与降雨对比或实质性科学结果。所提供的文本支持代码编写和代码执行参与，但未说明进一步的LLM推理或解释。

papers.title: Who Gets Help First? A counterfactual audit of large language model decisions in flood response
papers.venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)

summary.en: A preregistered counterfactual audit of LLM decisions in flood response across languages and affected-population characteristics.
summary.zh: 一项预注册的反事实审计，旨在评估不同语言和受影响人口特征下 LLM 在洪灾响应中的决策。

details.en: The study designs 75 flood-response cases in Thessaly, Valais, and Valencia, covering dispatch, evacuation, relief, housing, and triage, to test whether LLM decisions change when affected people, location, or prompt language changes while need remains constant.
details.zh: 该研究在 Thessaly、Valais 和 Valencia 设计了 75 个洪灾响应案例，涵盖调度、疏散、救济、住房和分诊，以检验在需求保持不变的情况下，当受影响人群、地点或提示语言发生变化时，LLM 的决策是否会改变。

limitations.en: This version archives the preregistered study design before study results, so it provides no empirical findings or evaluated outcome data.
limitations.zh: 此版本在研究结果公布前归档了预注册的研究设计，因此不提供任何实证发现或经过评估的结果数据。

papers.title: A Topology-Guided GeoAI Agentic Framework for Urban Flood Screening

summary.en: A topology-guided GeoAI agentic framework uses public geospatial data and explicit spatial analysis to screen urban flood-priority basins, with a language model supporting threshold selection, recommendation drafting, and evidence review.
summary.zh: 一种拓扑引导的 GeoAI 智能体框架使用公共地理空间数据和显式空间分析，对城市洪水优先级流域进行筛选，并由语言模型支持阈值选择、建议起草和证据审查。

details.en: The framework accepts a place name, drawn region, or uploaded boundary; retrieves elevation, rainfall, soil, land-cover, exposure, and infrastructure data; extracts terrain depressions; ranks candidate basins; and provides an interactive map and report. It includes human checkpoints and evaluates basin agreement with a D8 flow-routing model across multiple study areas.
details.zh: 该框架接受地点名称、绘制的区域或上传的边界；获取高程、降雨、土壤、土地覆盖、暴露度和基础设施数据；提取地形洼地；对候选流域进行排序；并提供交互式地图和报告。该框架包含人工检查点，并使用 D8 流路由模型在多个研究区域评估流域一致性。

limitations.en: The abstract does not identify the specific language model or provide implementation details beyond its recorded decision points.
limitations.zh: 摘要未明确具体的语言模型，也未提供除其记录的决策点之外的实施细节。

papers.title: Water management in flood-prone areas using nature-based solutions: an AI-assisted systematic review and thematic analysis

summary.en: An AI-assisted systematic review and thematic analysis of nature-based solutions for flood risk reduction and water management.
summary.zh: 一项关于用于洪水风险降低和水管理的基于自然的解决方案的AI辅助系统综述和主题分析。

details.en: The study reviews 185 publications on nature-based solutions in flood-prone areas, using an LLM for screening, structured data extraction, semantic clustering, and evidence synthesis with human validation.
details.zh: 该研究评述了洪水易发地区关于基于自然的解决方案的185篇出版物，使用LLM进行筛选、结构化数据提取、语义聚类以及经人工验证的证据综合。

limitations.en: The supplied abstract does not identify the specific LLM or provide implementation details, but it clearly establishes substantive LLM use in the hydro-focused review workflow.
limitations.zh: 所提供的摘要未确定具体的LLM或提供实施细节，但明确表明在以水文为重点的综述工作流程中实质性地使用了LLM。

papers.title: Wastewater surveillance of antimicrobial resistance in human populations: an updated systematic review and meta-analysis of the concordance between wastewater and human resistance prevalence — protocol v1.0 and search strategies as executed (PROSPERO CRD420261520110)
papers.venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)

summary.en: A systematic-review protocol and executed search strategies for assessing concordance between antimicrobial-resistance prevalence in wastewater and human populations, with Claude used in several review-workflow tasks.
summary.zh: 一份系统综述方案和已执行的检索策略，用于评估废水与人类群体中抗微生物药物耐药性患病率之间的一致性，其中 Claude 用于若干综述工作流程任务。

details.en: The deposit specifies the review protocol, database searches, citation tracking, screening procedures, deduplication materials, and planned analysis of wastewater–human AMR concordance. Claude was used for drafting, database-interface operation, deduplication code, and a non-decision-making third title/abstract rating.
details.zh: 该存档具体说明了综述方案、数据库检索、引文追踪、筛选程序、去重材料，以及对废水—人类 AMR 一致性的计划分析。Claude 被用于起草、数据库界面操作、去重代码编写，以及不参与决策的第三次标题/摘要评级。

limitations.en: The supplied metadata describes a protocol and search deposit rather than completed meta-analysis results; it does not quantify the effect or accuracy of the LLM-assisted workflow.
limitations.zh: 所提供的元数据描述的是方案和检索存档，而非已完成的荟萃分析结果；其中未量化 LLM 辅助工作流程的效果或准确性。

papers.title: IntelliCal Agent (INCA): Code for Diagnosis-Guided Parameter Specification in Hydrologic Models
papers.venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)

summary.en: INCA is a diagnostic-reasoning framework that uses multimodal LLMs to generate and evaluate targeted parameter updates in spatially distributed hydrologic models.
summary.zh: INCA 是一个诊断推理框架，使用多模态 LLM 在空间分布式水文模型中生成并评估有针对性的参数更新。

details.en: The work provides source code for an IntelliCal Agent that combines hydrologic diagnostics, parameter semantics, and multimodal LLMs in an iterative reasoning–verification workflow for hydrologic-model parameter specification.
details.zh: 该工作提供了 IntelliCal Agent 的源代码，该代理在水文模型参数指定的迭代推理–验证工作流中结合了水文诊断、参数语义和多模态 LLM。

limitations.en: The supplied metadata does not identify a specific LLM model, evaluation dataset, or numerical results.
limitations.zh: 所提供的元数据未指明具体的 LLM 模型、评估数据集或数值结果。

papers.title: The Water Sustainability Platform: A Cognitive Multi-agent System for Autonomous Groundwater Oversight

summary.en: A cognitive multi-agent platform for autonomous oversight of groundwater sustainability and regulatory compliance.
summary.zh: 一个用于自主监督地下水可持续性和法规合规性的认知多智能体平台。

details.en: The paper presents the Water Sustainability Platform as an autonomous system intended to address limitations of passive SCADA-based hydro-informatics workflows and support oversight of groundwater-related regulatory violations.
details.zh: 该论文介绍了Water Sustainability Platform，这是一种旨在解决基于被动SCADA的水文信息学工作流局限性并支持对地下水相关法规违规行为进行监督的自主系统。

limitations.en: The supplied abstract is truncated and does not specify the underlying agent architecture or whether a conventional LLM is used; the scope decision relies on the explicit multi-agent-system description.
limitations.zh: 所提供的摘要不完整，未说明底层智能体架构或是否使用传统LLM；范围判定依据是明确的多智能体系统描述。

papers.title: FloodVLM-Pix: Language-Guided Pixel-Level Flood Understanding

summary.en: A multimodal flood-understanding preprint that builds a large remote-sensing benchmark and proposes a vision-language model for flood description and pixel-level segmentation.
summary.zh: 一篇多模态洪水理解预印本，构建了一个大型遥感基准，并提出了一种用于洪水描述和像素级分割的视觉语言模型。

details.en: The work introduces a benchmark with flood image patches and textual descriptions of flood severity and evolution, then proposes FloodVLM-Pix with flood-prior and multi-temporal pixel-decoder modules. It evaluates language-level flood description and pixel-level flood segmentation against existing VLMs and flood segmentation models.
details.zh: 该工作引入了一个包含洪水图像块以及洪水严重程度和演变的文本描述的基准，随后提出了带有洪水先验和多时相像素解码器模块的 FloodVLM-Pix。该方法针对语言级洪水描述和像素级洪水分割，与现有 VLM 和洪水分割模型进行了评估。

limitations.en: Assessment is based only on the supplied abstract; implementation details of the language components are not provided.
limitations.zh: 评估仅基于所提供的摘要；未提供语言组件的实现细节。

papers.title: Flood risk assessment of stone arch bridges based on large language model and Bayesian Network

summary.en: A paper on flood-risk assessment for stone arch bridges using a large language model and a Bayesian Network.
summary.zh: 一篇使用大语言模型和贝叶斯网络进行石拱桥洪水风险评估的论文。

details.en: The title identifies flood risk assessment of stone arch bridges as the central application and names a large language model and Bayesian Network as the methodological basis.
details.zh: 标题将石拱桥洪水风险评估确定为核心应用，并指出大语言模型和贝叶斯网络是方法论基础。

limitations.en: Only the title and bibliographic metadata were supplied; implementation details and evaluation results are unavailable.
limitations.zh: 仅提供了标题和书目信息；实现细节和评估结果不可用。

papers.title: Inteligencia artificial para el diseño de humedales artificiales: Chat GPT en soluciones basadas en la naturaleza

summary.en: The paper explores ChatGPT GPT-4o as a design-support tool for preliminary constructed-wetland systems treating domestic greywater.
summary.zh: 该论文探讨了将 ChatGPT GPT-4o 作为处理生活灰水的初步人工湿地系统设计支持工具。

details.en: A structured prompt supplied flow, wastewater characteristics, and budget constraints to generate constructed-wetland configurations, materials, vegetation, and operation options. The proposed horizontal subsurface-flow wetland was compared with engineering criteria and specialized literature.
details.zh: 一个结构化提示提供了流量、废水特性和预算约束，以生成人工湿地配置、材料、植被和运行方案。所提出的水平潜流人工湿地与工程标准和专业文献进行了比较。

limitations.en: The supplied evidence is an abstract and does not establish experimental validation beyond the reported comparison with technical criteria and literature.
limitations.zh: 所提供的证据是一篇摘要，除报告的与技术标准和文献的比较外，并未确立实验验证。

papers.title: Enhancing flood resilience in critical communication infrastructures: empirical analysis and software-defined architecture design

summary.en: The paper analyzes how catastrophic floods disrupt critical communication infrastructure and uses LLM-assisted evidence analysis to inform a software-defined 5G resilience architecture.
summary.zh: 该论文分析灾难性洪水如何破坏关键通信基础设施，并利用LLM辅助的证据分析为软件定义的5G韧性架构提供信息。

details.en: It combines literature, official disaster reports, and interviews to identify communication failure modes in flood scenarios, then maps 5G software-defined capabilities to those flood-related challenges.
details.zh: 该论文结合文献、官方灾害报告和访谈，识别洪水情景下的通信故障模式，然后将5G软件定义能力映射到这些与洪水相关的挑战。

limitations.en: The supplied abstract does not identify the specific LLM, prompting procedure, or quantitative contribution of the LLM-assisted analysis.
limitations.zh: 所提供的摘要未说明具体的LLM、提示程序或LLM辅助分析的定量贡献。

papers.title: DriftGuard: an agentic hybrid temporal transformer and graph attention network framework for autonomous calibration drift detection and correction in distributed marine sensor networks

summary.en: DriftGuard is an autonomous framework for detecting and correcting calibration drift in distributed marine sensor networks using graph-temporal modeling, uncertainty estimation, and an LLM-driven agentic workflow.
summary.zh: DriftGuard 是一个自主框架，利用图时序建模、不确定性估计和 LLM 驱动的智能体工作流，检测并校正分布式海洋传感器网络中的校准漂移。

details.en: The paper evaluates DriftGuard on Argo float profiles, NDBC buoy time series, and the AdapAD benchmark. Its pipeline combines a heterogeneous sensor graph, a Hybrid Temporal Transformer and Graph Attention Network, cross-sensor consistency loss, conformal prediction, and a LangGraph-orchestrated agentic loop with RAG support for autonomous correction and operational sensor-state decisions.
details.zh: 该论文在 Argo 浮标剖面、NDBC 浮标时间序列和 AdapAD 基准数据集上评估 DriftGuard。其流程结合了异构传感器图、Hybrid Temporal Transformer 和 Graph Attention Network、跨传感器一致性损失、保形预测，以及由 LangGraph 编排并由 RAG 提供支持的智能体循环，用于自主校正和运行中的传感器状态决策。

papers.title: Source-discrimination feedback for large language model agents in river pollution source identification

summary.en: A source-discrimination feedback method guides an LLM agent to identify pollution sources and select additional observations in branching river networks.
summary.zh: 一种源辨识反馈方法引导 LLM 智能体识别污染源，并在分支河网中选择额外观测。

details.en: The preprint links a hydrodynamic–water-quality model to a ReAct-based LLM agent that retains source hypotheses and compares predicted differences at unused observation blocks. It evaluates the approach on synthetic river pollution events against ordinary ReAct, fixed observation plans, and a deterministic selector.
details.zh: 该预印本将水动力–水质模型与基于 ReAct 的 LLM 智能体相连接，后者保留源假设，并比较未使用观测区块中的预测差异。该方法在合成河流污染事件上进行了评估，并与普通 ReAct、固定观测计划和确定性选择器进行了对比。

limitations.en: The evaluation uses synthetic events and conceptual-network, offline-observation conditions; the abstract does not establish performance on real-world river incidents.
limitations.zh: 该评估采用合成事件以及概念网络、离线观测条件；摘要未证明其在现实世界河流事故中的表现。

papers.title: Reconstructing flood-induced human mobility using LLM agent with disaster context adaptation
papers.venue: Transportation Research Part D Transport and Environment

summary.en: An LLM-agent framework reconstructs individual mobility trajectories during urban floods to support evacuation analysis and flood-resilient transport planning.
summary.zh: 一种LLM-agent框架重建城市洪水期间的个体出行轨迹，以支持疏散分析和抗洪交通规划。

details.en: The Disaster-aware Trajectory Generator combines LLM agents with an agent-based framework and evaluates flood-induced mobility patterns using 1.32 billion records from the 2021 Zhengzhou flood.
details.zh: Disaster-aware Trajectory Generator将LLM agents与基于主体的框架相结合，并使用2021年郑州洪水期间的13.2亿条记录评估洪水引发的出行模式。

limitations.en: Assessment is based on the supplied metadata and abstract only.
limitations.zh: 评估仅基于所提供的元数据和摘要。

papers.title: Language model agents find polluted water but rarely locate its source
papers.venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)

summary.en: A benchmark study of language-model agents for detecting polluted water and locating its source.
summary.zh: 一项用于检测污染水体并定位其来源的语言模型智能体基准研究。

details.en: The archive provides fixed-field benchmark software and task files, including source-present and control tasks, environmental-condition transformations, evaluator answers, scoring, replay validation, and baseline controllers.
details.zh: 该存档提供固定字段的基准软件和任务文件，包括源存在任务和对照任务、环境条件变换、评估器答案、评分、回放验证以及基线控制器。

limitations.en: The supplied text does not identify the specific language-model families or provide quantitative cohort results; scoring records are deposited separately.
limitations.zh: 所提供的文本未确定具体的语言模型系列，也未提供定量队列结果；评分记录另行存放。

papers.title: HydroPrior: Offline LLM-Prior-Guided Residual Warning for Hydropower Bearing Vibration

summary.en: A hydropower bearing-vibration early-warning method that uses offline LLM-derived operating-context features with residual forecasting and calibrated alerting.
summary.zh: 一种水电轴承振动预警方法，利用离线LLM提取的运行环境特征，结合残差预测和校准告警。

details.en: HydroPrior combines frozen LLM priors with lightweight residual-based warning, evaluates forecasting error and proxy-event warning performance, and reports results on a public hydropower bearing-vibration dataset.
details.zh: HydroPrior将冻结的LLM先验与基于轻量级残差的预警相结合，评估预测误差和代理事件预警性能，并在一个公开的水电轴承振动数据集上报告结果。

limitations.en: The evaluation uses rapid vibration transitions as proxy events and is reported on an evaluated unit record; the abstract does not establish broader operational deployment or fault-diagnosis performance.
limitations.zh: 评估使用快速振动过渡作为代理事件，并基于一个已评估机组的记录进行报告；摘要未证明其更广泛的运行部署或故障诊断性能。

papers.title: 19 pre-registered predictions on the 2026–27 El Niño season in the Zambezi basin, committed by hash
papers.venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)

summary.en: A pre-registered set of 19 probabilistic predictions for the 2026–27 El Niño season in the Zambezi basin, including hydrological operations and drought-related outcomes, developed and critiqued with AI agents.
summary.zh: 一组预注册的19项关于2026–27年赞比西流域厄尔尼诺季的概率预测，包括水文运行和与干旱相关的结果，由AI代理开发并进行批评。

details.en: The record commits hashed prediction files in advance and specifies later publication and scoring procedures. Predictions cover Lake Kariba water releases for power, drought declarations, ENSO readings, humanitarian responses, financing, insurance, and cross-system connections. Claude-based agents wrote and challenged each prediction and read source material used for lags, effect sizes, and base rates.
details.zh: 该记录提前提交经过哈希处理的预测文件，并规定了后续发布和评分程序。预测涵盖卡里巴湖为发电进行的放水、干旱声明、ENSO读数、人道主义响应、融资、保险以及跨系统关联。基于Claude的代理撰写并质疑每项预测，并阅读了用于确定滞后期、效应量和基准发生率的来源材料。

limitations.en: The prediction texts are private until resolution, so the record does not yet provide the detailed prediction contents, outcomes, or skill results. It nevertheless explicitly documents the hydroclimate targets and substantive AI-agent workflow.
limitations.zh: 预测文本在结果确定前处于保密状态，因此该记录目前尚未提供详细的预测内容、结果或技能表现。然而，它明确记录了水文气候目标以及实质性的AI代理工作流程。

papers.title: Equitable supply in water distribution networks using data-driven optimization and AI-assisted voice automation

summary.en: The work clearly targets equitable water supply in water distribution networks, but the metadata does not establish whether the AI-assisted voice automation is an LLM or a substantive language-driven agent.
summary.zh: 该工作明确针对供水分配网络中的公平供水，但元数据无法确定 AI 辅助语音自动化是否为 LLM 或实质性的语言驱动代理。

details.en: The title describes equitable water distribution using data-driven optimization and AI-assisted voice automation.
details.zh: 标题描述了使用数据驱动优化和 AI 辅助语音自动化实现公平供水分配。

limitations.en: Only the title and publication metadata are supplied; no model description, workflow, evaluation, or evidence of LLM/agent use is available.
limitations.zh: 仅提供了标题和出版物元数据；没有模型描述、工作流程、评估或使用 LLM/代理的证据。

papers.title: AutoCF: An Automated LLM-Assisted Ecosystem for Compound Flood Simulation, Evaluation, and Impact Attribution

summary.en: AutoCF is presented as an automated ecosystem for compound coastal-flood simulation, evaluation, exposure analysis, driver attribution, and cross-platform execution, with Hurricane Harvey as the demonstrated case.
summary.zh: AutoCF被呈现为一个用于复合沿海洪水模拟、评估、暴露分析、驱动因素归因和跨平台执行的自动化生态系统，并以Hurricane Harvey作为示例案例。

details.en: The work reports flood-simulation accuracy against gauges and high-water marks, CPU/GPU agreement, and attribution of precipitation and coastal forcing to inundation and societal exposure. The title claims LLM assistance, but the supplied abstract does not describe that assistance.
details.zh: 该工作报告了相对于测站和高水位标记的洪水模拟准确性、CPU/GPU一致性，以及对降水和沿海强迫对淹没和社会暴露影响的归因。标题声称有LLM辅助，但所提供的摘要未描述这种辅助。

limitations.en: The supplied metadata does not identify the LLM, its inputs or outputs, the workflow components it operates, or any evaluated LLM-dependent capability.
limitations.zh: 所提供的元数据未明确指出LLM、其输入或输出、其运行的工作流组件，或任何经过评估的依赖LLM的能力。

papers.title: Agent-assisted modeling for urban drainage systems

summary.en: Introduces SWMM-MCP, an MCP-based framework that lets users operate EPA SWMM through natural language and evaluates it with eight base LLMs.
summary.zh: 介绍了 SWMM-MCP，这是一个基于 MCP 的框架，使用户能够通过自然语言操作 EPA SWMM，并使用八个基础 LLM 对其进行评估。

details.en: The paper addresses domain-specific stormwater modeling by connecting LLMs to SWMM through swmm_api, PySWMM, and an MCP server. It evaluates benchmark task completion, computational efficiency, response detail, and prompt-response behavior across eight LLMs.
details.zh: 该论文通过 swmm_api、PySWMM 和 MCP 服务器将 LLM 连接到 SWMM，以解决特定领域的雨洪建模问题。论文评估了八个 LLM 在基准任务完成情况、计算效率、响应详细程度以及提示-响应行为方面的表现。

limitations.en: Assessment is based only on the supplied metadata and abstract; implementation and evaluation details beyond the abstract are unavailable.
limitations.zh: 评估仅基于所提供的元数据和摘要；摘要之外的实现和评估细节不可用。

papers.title: Making waves: Human-governed workflow logic for agentic AI in water management

summary.en: Perspective on human-governed agentic workflows for water management, with a 158-question reservoir-regulation evaluation comparing Native RAG and Agentic RAG using Qwen3.6–27B.
summary.zh: 关于人类治理的水管理智能体工作流的观点，包含一项包含158个问题的水库调度评估，对比了 Native RAG 和 Agentic RAG，使用 Qwen3.6–27B。

details.en: The paper argues that execution trajectories and human governance can support reusable agent skills and workflow controllers in water management. Section 2 reports a controlled comparison using the same local reservoir-regulation knowledge base and quantised Qwen3.6–27B model. Across 158 questions, Agentic RAG reportedly improves evidence completeness from 81% to 100% and answer accuracy from 42% to 92%, while first-response time increases from 18.2 s to 27–28 s. The broader skill-learning loop and urban flood response pathway are proposed frameworks rather than demonstrated deployed systems.
details.zh: 论文认为，执行轨迹和人类治理可以支持水管理中可复用的智能体技能和工作流控制器。第2节报告了一项受控对比，使用相同的本地水库调度知识库和量化的 Qwen3.6–27B 模型。在158个问题中，据报道，Agentic RAG 将证据完整性从81%提升至100%，将答案准确率从42%提升至92%，而首次响应时间从18.2 s增加至27–28 s。更广泛的技能学习循环和城市洪水响应路径被提出作为框架，而非已经演示部署的系统。

limitations.en: Five-page Perspective. The reservoir QA comparison is reported in the main text, but detailed evaluation protocol, question-level data, uncertainty estimates and implementation code are not provided in the supplied PDF. Data are available on request. The urban-flood scenario is illustrative; the proposed skill/controller learning loop is not empirically validated here.
limitations.zh: 五页的观点文章。水库问答对比在正文中有报告，但所提供的 PDF 未提供详细的评估方案、逐问题数据、不确定性估计和实现代码。数据可应要求提供。城市洪水情景仅作说明；本文未对所提出的技能/控制器学习循环进行实证验证。

papers.title: LeakAgent: a multi-agent system for leak detection using multi-modal large language model coordination in water distribution network

summary.en: A multi-agent LLM-coordinated system jointly detects leaks and identifies affected partitions in water distribution networks.
summary.zh: 一种由LLM协调的多智能体系统，可联合检测漏水并识别供水管网中受影响的分区。

details.en: The paper integrates hydraulic pressure-sensitivity information, network zoning, sensor placement, graph-based leak detection, and autonomous fault repair within an LLM-coordinated multi-agent workflow, evaluated across five water distribution networks.
details.zh: 该论文将水力压力敏感性信息、网络分区、传感器布置、基于图的漏水检测和自主故障修复整合到由LLM协调的多智能体工作流中，并在五个供水管网上进行了评估。

limitations.en: Assessment is based only on the supplied title and abstract; implementation details are not available.
limitations.zh: 评估仅基于所提供的标题和摘要；无法获得实现细节。

papers.title: Assessing flood-related wellbeing from public discourse in Ireland using large language model as judge, 2012--2025

summary.en: The preprint develops an LLM-based pipeline to measure flood-related wellbeing from public discourse in Ireland over 2012–2025.
summary.zh: 该预印本开发了一种基于LLM的流程，用于从2012–2025年爱尔兰的公共话语中衡量与洪水相关的福祉。

details.en: It introduces a flood-wellbeing instrument covering distress appraisal, perceived efficacy and agency, and relational-institutional connectedness, then uses large language models to extract these measures at scale and analyze stressor activation and mediation pathways.
details.zh: 该研究提出了一种洪水—福祉测量工具，涵盖痛苦评估、感知效能与能动性，以及关系—制度联结；随后使用大型语言模型大规模提取这些测量结果，并分析压力源激活和中介路径。

limitations.en: The supplied abstract does not specify the particular LLMs, prompting setup, or validation procedure, but it clearly establishes substantive LLM participation.
limitations.zh: 所提供的摘要未具体说明所使用的LLM、提示设置或验证程序，但明确确立了LLM的实质性参与。

papers.title: An Evidence-Constrained RAG Learning Support System for Interdisciplinary Smart Water Engineering Education: Multi-Source Knowledge Governance and Reproducible Technical Evaluation

summary.en: The paper develops and technically evaluates an evidence-constrained RAG learning-support system for interdisciplinary smart water engineering education.
summary.zh: 该论文开发并技术评估了一个受证据约束的RAG学习支持系统，用于跨学科智慧水务工程教育。

details.en: It governs and retrieves multi-source hydrological, hydraulic, standards, model, and software knowledge, then evaluates retrieval quality and refusal behavior on frozen benchmarks.
details.zh: 该系统管理并检索多源水文、水力学、标准、模型和软件知识，然后在冻结基准上评估检索质量和拒答行为。

limitations.en: The evaluation establishes technical feasibility and evidence-auditability, not educational effectiveness or expert-validated professional correctness. Hosted model calls and restricted or third-party sources are not exactly reproducible without the same provider state and permissions.
limitations.zh: 该评估证实了技术可行性和证据可审计性，但未证实教育效果或经专家验证的专业正确性。若没有相同的提供商状态和权限，托管模型调用以及受限或第三方来源无法完全复现。

papers.title: Pallade Idrico: A Zero-Loss Hybrid RAG-LLM Architecture for Economic Regulation and Governance of the Italian Integrated Water Service
papers.venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)

summary.en: A hybrid RAG-LLM system specialized for economic regulation, compliance, and governance of Italy’s Integrated Water Service.
summary.zh: 一个专门用于意大利综合供水服务经济监管、合规与治理的混合 RAG-LLM 系统。

details.en: The report presents Pallade Idrico, a fine-tuned Italian LLM combined with a regulatory-document ingestion, hierarchical-temporal reranking, and retrieval pipeline. It evaluates the system on water-service tariffs, technical quality, metering, and user-protection regulations, with automated testing by a Gemini-based AI agent.
details.zh: 该报告介绍了 Pallade Idrico，这是一个经过微调的意大利语 LLM，结合了法规文件摄取、层级-时间重排序和检索流程。该系统针对供水服务费率、技术质量、计量和用户保护法规进行评估，并由基于 Gemini 的 AI 代理进行自动化测试。

limitations.en: The supplied metadata is a bounded excerpt, but it contains sufficient evidence to determine scope. Metadata exceeded the request limit; screening used a truncated excerpt.
limitations.zh: 所提供的元数据是一段有界摘录，但包含足以确定范围的证据。元数据超出请求限制；筛选使用了截断摘录。

papers.title: Photothermal‐Seek: Literature‐Grounded Knowledge Graphs for Discovering High‐Performance Solar Evaporators

summary.en: A literature-grounded knowledge graph uses LLM-assisted extraction and reasoning to discover and evaluate high-performance solar interfacial evaporators for desalination and water purification.
summary.zh: 一个以文献为基础的知识图谱利用 LLM 辅助的提取和推理，发现并评估用于脱盐和水净化的高性能太阳能界面蒸发器。

details.en: The paper presents Photothermal-Seek, built from 2771 publications, to connect synthesis, structure, and performance information for solar interfacial evaporation materials. It combines LLM-assisted extraction, graph reasoning, and full-text evidence retrieval, then uses the resulting knowledge base to guide the construction and testing of a polypyrrole-coated wood evaporator and assess an unseen design.
details.zh: 该论文介绍了 Photothermal-Seek，该系统基于 2771 篇出版物构建，用于关联太阳能界面蒸发材料的合成、结构和性能信息。它结合了 LLM 辅助提取、图推理和全文证据检索，然后利用所得知识库指导聚吡咯涂层木材蒸发器的构建和测试，并评估一种未见过的设计。

limitations.en: The abstract does not identify the specific LLM, prompting, or implementation details, but it explicitly states the LLM-assisted functions and their connection to solar interfacial evaporation research.
limitations.zh: 摘要未说明具体的 LLM、提示词或实现细节，但明确说明了 LLM 辅助功能及其与太阳能界面蒸发研究的联系。

papers.title: 地热计算器专业版-GGS
papers.venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)

summary.en: A geothermal simulation software artifact that supports AI-Agent-assisted modeling alongside geothermal flow, heat-transfer, and resource-assessment capabilities.
summary.zh: 一种地热模拟软件产物，支持 AI-Agent 辅助建模，以及地热流动、传热和资源评估功能。

details.en: GGS provides geological and fracture-network modeling, hydrothermal geothermal simulation, CO₂ storage and compositional simulation, dynamic geothermal resource assessment, and AI-Agent-assisted modeling.
details.zh: GGS 提供地质和裂缝网络建模、水热地热模拟、CO₂ 储存与组分模拟、动态地热资源评估以及 AI-Agent 辅助建模。

limitations.en: The supplied text does not identify the underlying model, training method, or implementation details of the AI agent.
limitations.zh: 所提供的文本未指出 AI agent 的底层模型、训练方法或实现细节。

papers.title: Separating Runtime Acceptance from Offline Contract Alignment in LLM-Orchestrated Flood GIS Workflows: A Dual-Case Evaluation

summary.en: Evaluates GeoFloodAgent, an LLM-orchestrated flood-GIS workflow, using dual-case flood tasks and contract-alignment metrics.
summary.zh: 使用双案例洪水任务和契约一致性指标评估 GeoFloodAgent（一种由 LLM 编排的洪水-GIS 工作流）。

details.en: The paper evaluates runtime acceptance and post-run alignment with product, lineage, and action contracts across Chinese-language Zhengzhou and Forlì flood cases. It also tests configuration sensitivity of deterministic SAR-based flood extent processing and cautions that completion rate alone is insufficient for evaluating LLM-orchestrated flood GIS.
details.zh: 该论文评估了中文郑州和 Forlì 洪水案例中的运行时接受度，以及运行后与产品、溯源和行动契约的一致性。论文还测试了基于确定性 SAR 的洪水范围处理的配置敏感性，并指出，仅凭完成率不足以评估由 LLM 编排的洪水 GIS。

limitations.en: The abstract explicitly states that the study does not validate hydrological accuracy, establish operational decision validity, or demonstrate open-world error detection. It evaluates a finite, study-authored benchmark.
limitations.zh: 摘要明确指出，该研究未验证水文准确性，未确立运行决策有效性，也未展示开放世界错误检测能力。该研究评估的是一个由研究者编制的有限基准。

papers.title: HydroJEV: A one-second, training-free screen for cyber-attack and fault attribution in water distribution networks

summary.en: The preprint proposes a fast, training-free first-tier screen for attributing cyberattacks, physical faults, transients, and sensor faults in water distribution network SCADA alarms, with LLMs used as benchmarked reviewers in a gated triage cascade.
summary.zh: 该预印本提出了一种快速、无需训练的第一层筛查方法，用于在供水管网 SCADA 报警中归因网络攻击、物理故障、瞬态和传感器故障，并将 LLM 用作经基准测试的审查器，纳入门控分诊级联流程。

details.en: It evaluates Jev, rules, a supervised classifier, and seven cloud LLMs on C-Town and additional EPANET water networks, reporting attribution performance, speed, and reduced LLM review workload.
details.zh: 该研究在 C-Town 和其他 EPANET 供水网络上评估了 Jev、规则、一种有监督分类器和七个云端 LLM，并报告了归因性能、速度以及减少的 LLM 审查工作量。

limitations.en: The abstract does not identify the specific LLMs or detail their prompting and implementation, but it explicitly establishes substantive LLM evaluation and reviewer use.
limitations.zh: 摘要未指出具体的 LLM，也未详细说明其提示和实现方式，但明确确立了实质性的 LLM 评估和审查器使用。

papers.title: Development of an Agent-Powered Decision Support System for Real-Time Flood Control Consultation at the Xiaolangdi Reservoir

summary.en: An LLM- and multi-agent-powered RAG decision support system for real-time flood control consultation at the Xiaolangdi Reservoir.
summary.zh: 一种由 LLM 和多智能体驱动的 RAG 决策支持系统，用于小浪底水库的实时防洪会商。

details.en: The paper develops and deploys a flood-control consultation platform that coordinates specialized agents, retrieves historical flood cases and technical specifications, analyzes real-time hydrological information, and generates operational recommendations consistent with reservoir safety requirements.
details.zh: 该论文开发并部署了一个防洪会商平台，该平台协调专业化智能体，检索历史洪水案例和技术规范，分析实时水文信息，并生成符合水库安全要求的运行建议。

limitations.en: The supplied abstract reports practical deployment and reduced consultation time but does not provide detailed experimental design, baseline definitions, or quantitative results.
limitations.zh: 所提供的摘要报告了实际部署情况和会商时间的缩短，但未提供详细的实验设计、基线定义或定量结果。

papers.title: A SURVEY AND COMPARATIVE ANALYSIS OF LEAD IN DRINKING WATER POLICIES IN THE AMERICAS

summary.en: Comparative assessment of lead-in-drinking-water policies across 28 countries in the Americas, identifying regulatory strengths and gaps.
summary.zh: 对美洲28个国家饮用水铅政策的比较评估，识别监管优势与差距。

details.en: The study evaluates monitoring, lead-source elimination, budgets, plumbing regulations, and policy environments, finding persistent gaps in enforcement and actionable lead-elimination measures.
details.zh: 该研究评估了监测、铅源消除、预算、管道法规和政策环境，发现执法以及可操作的铅消除措施方面仍存在持续性差距。

limitations.en: The supplied abstract does not identify the specific language models, prompting, or how document sourcing affected downstream grading and conclusions.
limitations.zh: 所提供的摘要未说明具体的语言模型、提示方式，也未说明文档来源如何影响后续评分和结论。

papers.title: Visual narratives of disaster on Instagram: a multimodal AI-assisted analysis

summary.en: The paper uses ChatGPT-4 to analyze visual and emotional narratives in Instagram posts about the 2021 western Germany floods, supporting large-scale assessment of disaster impacts and recovery discourse.
summary.zh: 该论文使用 ChatGPT-4 分析关于2021年德国西部洪灾的 Instagram 帖子中的视觉和情感叙事，为大规模评估灾害影响和恢复话语提供支持。

details.en: Approximately 2,700 Instagram posts were analyzed using human-supervised ChatGPT-4 image interpretation, manual validation, thematic classification, emotional analysis, and hashtag examination across flood response and recovery phases.
details.zh: 使用人工监督的 ChatGPT-4 图像解读、人工验证、主题分类、情感分析以及主题标签考察，对大约2,700条 Instagram 帖子进行了分析，涵盖洪灾响应和恢复阶段。

limitations.en: Assessment is based on the supplied abstract only.
limitations.zh: 评估仅基于所提供的摘要。

papers.title: Regional Groundwater Database for Arequipa and Surroundings in Southern Peru from Unstructured Sources Using an Integrated Optical Character Recognition and Large Language Model Workflow

summary.en: A regional groundwater database for southern Peru is constructed from unstructured documents and monitoring data using OCR, a large language model, and human verification.
summary.zh: 利用 OCR、大语言模型和人工核验，从非结构化文档和监测数据构建了一个秘鲁南部区域地下水数据库。

details.en: The work recovers and validates 4,775 georeferenced groundwater records from 3,675 documents, including hydraulic and geological parameters, and evaluates transcription fidelity and data-reuse risks.
details.zh: 该工作从 3,675 份文档中恢复并验证了 4,775 条地理参考地下水记录，包括水文地质和地质参数，并评估了转录保真度和数据再利用风险。

limitations.en: Evidence is limited to the supplied title and abstract; implementation details of the language model are not provided.
limitations.zh: 证据仅限于所提供的标题和摘要；未提供大语言模型的实现细节。

papers.title: Evaluating Modern Tools and Large Language Models for Digitising Sea-Level Data from Marigrams

summary.en: The preprint evaluates conventional digitisation tools and two large language models for recovering historical sea-level observations from marigrams.
summary.zh: 该预印本评估了传统数字化工具和两个大型语言模型从海潮仪记录中恢复历史海平面观测数据的能力。

details.en: A multi-user framework compares 11 digitisation tools and two LLMs on a week-long marigram from the Clyde Estuary. The LLMs exceeded 10% of the observed tidal range in error, while most conventional tools achieved errors below 1%.
details.zh: 一个多用户框架在来自 Clyde Estuary、为期一周的海潮仪记录上比较了11种数字化工具和两个LLM。LLM的误差超过观测潮差的10%，而大多数传统工具的误差低于1%。

papers.title: Predictors and Orchestrators: Parsimonious Machine Learning within an Agentic AI Harness for Multi-Horizon Karst Aquifer Forecasting

summary.en: A deployment-aware framework forecasts karst aquifer discharge and groundwater levels over 1–12 weeks and embeds the validated predictors in a five-agent operational architecture.
summary.zh: 一个考虑部署的框架预测未来1–12周的岩溶含水层排放量和地下水位，并将经过验证的预测器嵌入一个五智能体运行架构中。

details.en: The study evaluates several machine-learning model families on approximately 79 years of Edwards Aquifer observations, finding extreme gradient boosting most reliable across forecast horizons. A five-agent architecture automates the operational forecasting and reporting workflow.
details.zh: 该研究在爱德华兹含水层约79年的观测数据上评估了多个机器学习模型系列，发现极端梯度提升在各预测时段中最为可靠。一个五智能体架构自动化运行预测和报告工作流程。

papers.title: Knowledge-Guided Vision-Language Inference for Image-Based Urban Flood Depth Estimation

summary.en: FloodVision uses a knowledge-guided vision-language model to estimate urban floodwater depth from single RGB images.
summary.zh: FloodVision 使用知识引导的视觉语言模型，根据单张 RGB 图像估计城市洪水水深。

details.en: The preprint introduces FloodVision, which combines a general-purpose VLM with FloodKG, a knowledge base of canonical object dimensions and component landmarks, to provide geometrically grounded flood-depth estimates. It evaluates the approach on 654 crowdsourced urban flood images and reports lower errors than a VLM-only baseline.
details.zh: 该预印本介绍了 FloodVision。FloodVision 将通用 VLM 与 FloodKG 相结合。FloodKG 是一个包含标准物体尺寸和组件地标的知识库，用于提供具有几何依据的洪水水深估计。该方法在 654 张众包城市洪水图像上进行评估，报告的误差低于仅使用 VLM 的基线。

papers.title: Field photography and satellite radar for verifying alternate wetting and drying in Balinese subaks: data, code and figures
papers.venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)

summary.en: A hydro-focused research artifact on verifying alternate wetting and drying irrigation in Balinese rice terraces using farmer photographs and satellite radar, with a vision-capable language model classifying the photographs.
summary.zh: 一项以水文为重点的研究成果，利用农民拍摄的照片和卫星雷达，验证巴厘岛稻田梯田中的交替干湿灌溉，并使用具备视觉能力的语言模型对这些照片进行分类。

details.en: The deposit contains data, analysis code, figures, field boundaries, language-model photographic classifications and reasoning text, classifier reliability analysis, and Sentinel-1/NISAR radar extractions. It evaluates field- and community-scale detection of synchronized drying and documents radar and threshold-related effects.
details.zh: 该存档包含数据、分析代码、图表、田块边界、语言模型对照片的分类结果和推理文本、分类器可靠性分析，以及 Sentinel-1/NISAR 雷达提取结果。该研究评估了田块和社区尺度上对同步干燥的检测，并记录了雷达和阈值相关的影响。

limitations.en: The supplied metadata does not identify the specific vision-capable language model or provide quantitative details of the reliability analysis.
limitations.zh: 所提供的元数据未标明具体的具备视觉能力的语言模型，也未提供可靠性分析的定量细节。

papers.title: Improving multi-factor river water quality prediction using deep learning and large language models with retrieval-augmented generation

summary.en: A hydro-focused framework combines deep learning, retrieval-augmented LLMs, and a RAG-enhanced multi-agent system for river water-quality prediction, classification, and management recommendations.
summary.zh: 一个以水文为重点的框架结合深度学习、检索增强型 LLM 和 RAG 增强的多智能体系统，用于河流水质预测、分类和管理建议。

details.en: The study integrates water-quality, meteorological, socio-economic, and hydro-topographic data to predict six river water-quality indicators with a CNN-LSTM-attention model. Literature-based retrieval helps configure hyperparameters, while an LLM-enabled multi-agent system performs water-quality grade classification and generates improvement recommendations using domain knowledge and expert experience.
details.zh: 该研究整合水质、气象、社会经济和水文地形数据，使用 CNN-LSTM-attention 模型预测六项河流水质指标。基于文献的检索有助于配置超参数，而由 LLM 支持的多智能体系统利用领域知识和专家经验执行水质等级分类并生成改善建议。

papers.title: Auditable Automation of Activated Sludge Modeling for Wastewater Treatment Diagnosis Using LLM-Agents

summary.en: A paper presents an auditable LLM-Agent workflow for configuring, executing, and calibrating activated sludge models for wastewater treatment diagnosis.
summary.zh: 本文提出了一种可审计的 LLM-Agent 工作流，用于配置、执行和校准活性污泥模型，以诊断污水处理问题。

details.en: AutoWWTP-ASM translates wastewater-process descriptions into structured, library-constrained activated sludge model configurations, supports execution and calibration, and evaluates multiple LLM backbones, agent modules, deployment settings, standardized BSM1 scenarios, and full-scale WWTP data.
details.zh: AutoWWTP-ASM 将污水处理过程描述转换为结构化且受模型库约束的活性污泥模型配置，支持执行和校准，并评估多个 LLM 主干、智能体模块、部署设置、标准化 BSM1 场景以及全规模 WWTP 数据。

papers.title: Sparse validation can mask process errors in urban flood modelling: evidence from large multimodal model-assisted video observations

summary.en: A preprint evaluates whether sparse peak-depth validation can detect process errors in an urban flood model using minute-level inundation observations derived from videos with large multimodal model assistance.
summary.zh: 一篇预印本评估了稀疏峰值水深验证能否利用大型多模态模型辅助从视频中获取的分钟级积水观测结果，检测城市洪水模型中的过程错误。

details.en: The study calibrates and validates a 1D–2D MIKE FLOOD model for Dalian, China, then compares simulations with 20,825 video-derived inundation levels. It quantifies errors in occurrence, timing, severity, and duration and finds substantial process-fidelity errors despite low peak-depth RMSEs.
details.zh: 该研究针对中国大连校准并验证了1D–2D MIKE FLOOD模型，然后将模拟结果与20,825个视频推导的积水水位进行比较。研究量化了发生、时间、严重程度和持续时间方面的误差，并发现尽管峰值水深RMSE较低，过程保真度仍存在显著误差。

papers.title: Scientific capabilities and deployment sustainability of small-scale LLMs in biological wastewater treatment

summary.en: The preprint evaluates a domain-specialized small LLM for scientific reasoning and sustainable deployment in biological wastewater treatment, including hypothesis generation and wastewater-treatment-plant deployment analysis.
summary.zh: 该预印本评估了一个面向生物废水处理领域的专用小型LLM在科学推理和可持续部署方面的表现，包括假设生成和废水处理厂部署分析。

details.en: BioWater, an 8-billion-parameter LLM fine-tuned on wastewater-treatment knowledge, is benchmarked on retrospective cognition, comprehension fidelity, and prospective extrapolation. The study also reports human–LLM hypothesis generation supported by laboratory experiments and compares the sustainability of local small-scale versus cloud-based large-scale LLM deployment across global wastewater treatment plants.
details.zh: BioWater是一个在废水处理知识上进行微调的80亿参数LLM，研究对其回顾性认知、理解保真度和前瞻性外推能力进行了基准测试。该研究还报告了由实验室实验支持的人类–LLM假设生成，并比较了全球废水处理厂中本地小规模与基于云的大规模LLM部署的可持续性。

summary.zh: 一种基于LLM、案例知识引导的工作流程，为水利水电项目生成可审计的施工阶段安全评价报告。

details.en: The study combines structured knowledge extraction, executable appraisal planning, iterative evidence-grounded generation, and LLM-based evaluation metrics. It evaluates the workflow on historical reports and evidence documents, comparing standard RAG with the proposed approach using conclusion support and hallucination rates.
details.zh: 该研究结合了结构化知识提取、可执行的评价规划、迭代式证据支撑生成以及基于LLM的评价指标。研究在历史报告和证据文件上评估该工作流程，并使用结论支持率和幻觉率将标准RAG与所提出的方法进行比较。

papers.title: Toward Planetary-Scale Intelligence: A Multi-Agent Framework for Cross-Domain Environmental Anomaly Detection and Reasoning
papers.venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)

summary.en: A supervisor coordinates perception, geospatial, temporal and domain agents—including hydrology—to detect cross-domain environmental anomalies such as flash floods.
summary.zh: 一个监督器协调感知、地理空间、时间和领域智能体——包括水文学智能体——以检测诸如山洪等跨领域环境异常。

details.en: The Planetary Intelligence System is a multi-agent architecture in which a supervisor routes work among perception, geospatial, temporal-pattern and environmental-domain agents over typed messages, tiered memory and a retrieval-augmented knowledge layer. The paper reports evaluation on four simulated and two real-world-derived datasets across flash-flood, wildfire, air-quality and seismic-anomaly families, with higher F1, lower latency and fewer false positives than stated single-agent and multi-agent baselines. It is relevant as cross-domain hydrology-adjacent Agent evidence rather than a dedicated operational flood system.
details.zh: Planetary Intelligence System 是一种多智能体架构，其中监督器通过类型化消息、分层记忆和检索增强知识层，在感知、地理空间、时间模式和环境领域智能体之间分配工作。该论文报告了在四个模拟数据集和两个源自真实世界的数据集上的评估，涵盖山洪、野火、空气质量和地震异常系列；与所述的单智能体和多智能体基线相比，其 F1 更高、延迟更低且误报更少。作为跨领域、与水文学相邻的 Agent 证据，它具有相关性，而不是一个专门的运营洪水系统。

limitations.en: This is a single-author Zenodo research artifact spanning several hazards; the abstract does not disaggregate flood-specific performance or identify an independently verified operational deployment.
limitations.zh: 这是一项涵盖多种灾害的单作者 Zenodo 研究成果；摘要未分解山洪特定性能，也未说明经过独立验证的运营部署。

papers.title: HazardReasoner: Evidence-Grounded Large Language Model Reasoning for Natural-Disaster Inference
papers.venue: 2026 11th International Conference on Electronic Technology and Information Science (ICETIS)

summary.en: HazardReasoner combines evidence ledgers, typed geospatial tools, guideline retrieval and an independent critic for auditable disaster reasoning, including flood-response feasibility.
summary.zh: HazardReasoner结合证据账本、类型化地理空间工具、指南检索和独立批评器，实现可审计的灾害推理，包括洪水响应可行性。

details.en: The framework normalizes public disaster observations into evidence ledgers, compares competing hazard hypotheses, executes typed GIS and numerical tools, retrieves response guidelines, and checks answers with an independent safety critic. The paper reports PubDis-Reason with 1,250 cases and 5,000 questions from DisasterQA, HumAID, CrisisMMD and xBD. Reported macro-F1 is 78.2 versus 72.4 for ReAct, with unsafe-action rate 3.6% versus 7.9%. A flood case rejects a shelter within the projected inundation zone. Results are aggregate multi-hazard metrics, not flood-only performance.
details.zh: 该框架将公共灾害观测规范化为证据账本，比较相互竞争的灾害假设，执行类型化 GIS 和数值工具，检索响应指南，并使用独立的安全批评器检查答案。论文报告了 PubDis-Reason，其中包含来自 DisasterQA、HumAID、CrisisMMD 和 xBD 的 1,250 个案例和 5,000 个问题。报告的宏平均 F1 为 78.2，而 ReAct 为 72.4；不安全行动率分别为 3.6% 和 7.9%。一个洪水案例拒绝了位于预测淹没区内的避难所。结果是多灾种指标的汇总，而非仅针对洪水的性能。

limitations.en: Full text supplied by the user and read (5 pages, pp. 287–291). Flood-specific metrics and the exact base LLM are not specified in the inspected text; reported benchmark results and supplementary availability have not been independently reproduced.
limitations.zh: 用户提供并阅读了全文（5 页，第 287–291 页）。所检查的文本未说明洪水特定指标和确切的基础 LLM；报告的基准结果和补充材料可用性尚未经过独立复现。

papers.title: A human-verified database of reported socioeconomic drought impacts for 368 prefecture-level units in China, 2010–2025
papers.venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)

summary.zh: 一个经过人工核验的中国已报道社会经济干旱影响数据库，采用网络搜索和检索增强型LLM构建，随后进行人工核验。

Qwen3-Max is used with web search to identify reported impacts and generate traceable evidence statements.
details.zh: 该工作汇编了2010–2025年368个地级单位的5,888条单位—年份记录，识别出2,299起经过核验的干旱影响事件，并标注其社会经济表现类型。使用Qwen3-Max结合网络搜索识别已报道的影响并生成可追溯的证据陈述。

papers.title: A Global Event-Based Benchmark for Tide and Surge Models Beyond the Tide Gauge

summary.en: Introduces a global event-based benchmark for evaluating coastal sea-level and storm-tide models using news-reported flood events identified with an LLM.
summary.zh: 介绍了一个基于全球事件的基准，用于使用LLM识别的新闻报道洪水事件评估沿海海平面和风暴潮模型。

details.en: The study constructs a global database of approximately 33,000 coastal flood records over 10 years, using an LLM calibrated with tide-gauge data to identify events. It evaluates GTSM and ECCC storm-tide products and compares event-based detection with conventional gauge-based metrics.
details.zh: 该研究构建了一个全球数据库，包含10年间约33,000条沿海洪水记录，并使用经过潮位计数据校准的LLM识别事件。研究评估了GTSM和ECCC风暴潮产品，并比较了基于事件的检测与传统的基于潮位计的指标。

papers.title: Towards autonomous urban drainage modelling: evaluating AI agent architectures for automated SWMM calibration

summary.en: The paper evaluates skill-based, tool-based, and multi-agent LLM architectures for automated urban drainage model calibration using SWMM.
summary.zh: 该论文评估了基于技能、基于工具和多智能体的LLM架构，用于使用SWMM进行自动化城市排水模型校准。

details.en: A controlled SWMM case study compares three agent organisations for coordinating calibration procedures. The study reports equivalent calibrated-model accuracy but differences in reliability, cost, language-model capability requirements, and token consumption.
details.zh: 一项受控的SWMM案例研究比较了用于协调校准流程的三种智能体组织方式。研究报告称，校准模型的准确性相当，但在可靠性、成本、语言模型能力要求和token消耗方面存在差异。

papers.title: Intelligent extraction of reservoir dispatching information integrating large language model and structured prompts

summary.en: A structured-prompt large language model method and an operational AI agent extract reservoir-dispatch entities and relationships from heterogeneous regulations to support dispatch professionals.
summary.zh: 一种结构化提示的大语言模型方法和一个运行型 AI agent 从异构法规中提取水库调度实体和关系，以支持调度专业人员。

details.en: The paper addresses the costly and unstable manual or natural-language-prompt-based extraction of reservoir dispatching rules. It refines extraction labels, encodes them with Backus–Naur Form, guides a large language model to produce structured data, and develops an AI agent for dispatch professionals. The reported entity and relationship extraction F1 scores are both above 80%.
details.zh: 该论文针对人工或基于自然语言提示的水库调度规则提取成本高且不稳定的问题。该方法细化提取标签，使用 Backus–Naur Form 对其进行编码，引导大语言模型生成结构化数据，并为调度专业人员开发一个 AI agent。报告的实体和关系提取 F1 分数均高于 80%。

papers.title: HydroSuite-AI: a web-based LLM environment for hydrological code generation and execution for the hydrosuite open-source ecosystem

summary.en: HydroSuite-AI is a web-based LLM assistant for generating, retrieving, validating, and executing hydrological code across the HydroSuite open-source ecosystem.
summary.zh: HydroSuite-AI 是一个基于 Web 的 LLM 助手，用于在 HydroSuite 开源生态系统中生成、检索、验证和执行水文代码。

details.en: The paper presents a Planner-Worker-Synthesizer system with RAG over hydrological library documentation and client-side execution. It evaluates cross-library hydrological workflows, 60 domain-specific tasks, and workshop deployment, reporting differences in function-retrieval accuracy and latency across LLM backends.
details.zh: 论文介绍了一个 Planner-Worker-Synthesizer 系统，该系统基于水文库文档使用 RAG，并支持客户端执行。该系统评估了跨库水文工作流、60 项领域特定任务和研讨会部署，并报告了不同 LLM 后端在函数检索准确率和延迟方面的差异。

summary.en: The paper proposes an automated method for evaluating large language models on open-ended questions in the hydropower domain.
summary.zh: 该论文提出了一种用于评估大型语言模型在水电领域开放式问题上表现的自动化方法。

details.en: It addresses the limited domain adaptability, efficiency, and subjectivity of manually evaluating LLMs on hydropower open-ended questions. The available abstract indicates that the proposed automated evaluation method is based on LLMs, although its detailed implementation is truncated.
details.zh: 该方法针对人工评估LLM在水电开放式问题上的领域适应性有限、效率低和主观性强等问题。现有摘要表明，所提出的自动化评估方法基于LLM，但其具体实现被截断。

limitations.en: The abstract is truncated after “automatic...”, so the specific evaluator design, datasets, and evaluation procedure cannot be determined from the supplied metadata.
limitations.zh: 摘要在“automatic...”之后被截断，因此无法根据所提供的元数据确定具体的评估器设计、数据集和评估流程。

papers.title: Allocation institutions under a food–energy–water nexus drought

summary.en: Compares curtailment, auction, and quota institutions for allocating drought-limited reservoir water, then tests the institutional ranking with language-model claimants.
summary.zh: 比较截流、拍卖和配额制度在分配受干旱限制的水库水资源方面的表现，然后使用语言模型索取方检验制度排名。

details.en: The study evaluates food-floor breaches and aggregate welfare under three allocation rules for a reservoir serving food and a high-value mobile claimant. Language-model claimants are used to replicate the institutional comparison across two model families, with a reported replication and reasoning-audit protocol.
details.zh: 该研究评估了为粮食和高价值流动索取方提供服务的水库在三种分配规则下的粮食底线违约情况和总体福利。研究使用语言模型索取方，在两个模型系列中复现制度比较，并采用了所报告的复现与推理审计协议。

limitations.en: The abstract describes a stylised substrate rather than a specific basin and does not identify the model families or detailed claimant interaction protocol.
limitations.zh: 摘要描述的是一种风格化的基础设定，而非特定流域，并未确定模型系列或详细的索取方互动协议。

papers.title: Intelligent Recommendation for Safety Risk Precontrol Knowledge in Mega Hydropower Engineering Construction: A Hybrid Method Driven by Textual Semantics
papers.venue: Journal of Construction Engineering and Management

summary.en: A language-model-driven semantic matching and knowledge recommendation method for proactive safety-risk precontrol in mega hydropower construction.
summary.zh: 一种由语言模型驱动的语义匹配和知识推荐方法，用于大型水电建设中的主动安全风险预控。

details.en: The study combines contrastive sentence embeddings, a general language model, interactive semantic-feature fusion, deep text matching, and knowledge retrieval/inference to recommend relevant safety precontrol knowledge for hydropower construction risk factors. It reports an F1-score of 97.57% for semantic matching and 98.95% average precision for recalling the top 10 knowledge items on the stated dataset.
details.zh: 该研究结合对比句子嵌入、通用语言模型、交互式语义特征融合、深度文本匹配以及知识检索/推理，为水电建设风险因素推荐相关的安全预控知识。在所述数据集上，语义匹配的F1-score为97.57%，召回前10项知识的平均精度为98.95%。

limitations.en: Assessment is based only on the supplied abstract; implementation details and the precise architecture or scale of the general language model are not provided.
limitations.zh: 评估仅基于所提供的摘要；未提供实现细节以及通用语言模型的具体架构或规模。

papers.title: Improved Flood Management and Risk Communication Through Large Language Models

summary.en: The paper proposes a multimodal RAG-based flood management framework using a Flood Knowledge Graph and diverse hydrological, meteorological, and social-media inputs. It applies LLMs to flood-related decision support, warning and information sharing, and evacuation route planning.
summary.zh: 该论文提出了一个基于多模态 RAG 的洪水管理框架，使用洪水知识图谱以及多样化的水文、气象和社交媒体输入。该框架将 LLMs 应用于洪水相关的决策支持、预警与信息共享以及疏散路线规划。

details.en: The study addresses flood risk management and communication by integrating LLMs/RAG with a Flood Knowledge Graph. It reports improved reliability for flood decision support and proposes expert validation and security layers for operational uses such as flood-constrained evacuation planning.
details.zh: 该研究通过将 LLMs/RAG 与洪水知识图谱相结合，解决洪水风险管理与沟通问题。研究报告称，洪水决策支持的可靠性有所提高，并针对洪水约束下的疏散规划等运营用途，提出了专家验证和安全层。

limitations.en: Evidence is limited to the supplied abstract; implementation details, evaluation design, and operational deployment conditions are not provided.
limitations.zh: 证据仅限于所提供的摘要；未提供实现细节、评估设计和运营部署条件。

papers.title: Physics-constrained large language model-assisted optimal scheduling approach for hydro-wind-solar systems considering multi-level backwater effects

summary.en: A physics-constrained LLM-assisted method designs scheduling strategies for cascade hydro-wind-solar systems with multi-level backwater effects.
summary.zh: 一种受物理约束的LLM辅助方法，为具有多级回水效应的梯级水电-风电-光伏系统设计调度策略。

details.en: The study combines POA decomposition, deterministic hydraulic and physical evaluation, hard-feasibility screening, and LLM-assisted adaptive strategy design. It evaluates the approach on wet, normal, and dry years and Monte Carlo wind-solar scenarios.
details.zh: 该研究结合了POA分解、确定性水力和物理评估、硬可行性筛选以及LLM辅助的自适应策略设计。该方法在丰水年、平水年和枯水年以及蒙特卡罗风-光场景下进行评估。

limitations.en: Evidence is limited to the supplied abstract; detailed implementation and reproducibility information are not available here.
limitations.zh: 证据仅限于所提供的摘要；此处没有详细的实现和可复现性信息。

papers.title: Multi-Source Sensing Sparse-Masked Heterogeneous Graph-Constrained Large Language Model for Cross-Condition Fault Diagnosis of Hydropower Unit Rotating Components

summary.en: A sparse-masked heterogeneous graph framework uses multi-source sensing and a frozen LLM for evidence-constrained cross-condition fault diagnosis of hydropower unit rotating components.
summary.zh: 一种稀疏掩码异构图框架利用多源传感和冻结的LLM，对水电机组旋转部件进行受证据约束的跨工况故障诊断。

details.en: The method encodes multi-source vibration and graph relationships, selects a physics-guided sparse evidence subgraph, organizes signal and degradation evidence into prompts, and uses a frozen large language model for diagnostic reasoning. It is evaluated on rotating-machinery datasets and a multi-unit hydropower dataset.
details.zh: 该方法对多源振动和图关系进行编码，选择物理引导的稀疏证据子图，将信号和退化证据组织成提示，并利用冻结的大语言模型进行诊断推理。该方法在旋转机械数据集和多机组水电数据集上进行了评估。

limitations.en: The abstract does not identify the specific LLM architecture or provide detailed quantitative results, but it explicitly establishes the model's operational role in the hydropower diagnosis workflow.
limitations.zh: 摘要未明确具体的LLM架构，也未提供详细的定量结果，但明确确立了该模型在水电诊断工作流中的操作作用。

papers.title: FD-SE-LLM: A Semantic-Enhanced Large Language Model Framework for Fault Diagnosis of Hydropower Carbon Brush Bearings
papers.venue: Journal of Dynamics Monitoring and Diagnostics

summary.en: FD-SE-LLM is an LLM-based framework for cross-condition fault diagnosis of hydropower carbon brush bearings using semantic processing of industrial vibration signals.
summary.zh: FD-SE-LLM 是一种基于 LLM 的框架，用于利用工业振动信号的语义处理对水电碳刷轴承进行跨工况故障诊断。

details.en: The paper addresses operating-condition drift in hydropower equipment diagnosis. It combines semantic projection of periodic and transient vibration features, fault-specific representation disentanglement, and a time adapter within an LLM framework, and reports evaluation on hydropower and other datasets.
details.zh: 该论文针对水电设备诊断中的运行工况漂移问题。在 LLM 框架内，它结合了周期性和瞬态振动特征的语义投影、面向故障的表征解耦以及时间适配器，并报告了在水电数据集和其他数据集上的评估结果。

papers.title: Citizen flood imagery enhances urban aftermath monitoring and exposes reporting inequities

summary.en: A two-stage framework uses citizen-generated flood images and a fine-tuned vision-language model to produce spatially explicit information on urban flood aftermath and identify reporting gaps.
summary.zh: 一个两阶段框架利用公民生成的洪水图像和经过微调的视觉语言模型，生成关于城市洪水灾后情况的空间明确的信息，并识别报告空白。

details.en: The study applies flood-masked geolocation and a fine-tuned vision-language model to social media imagery in San Francisco, comparing the resulting flood-aftermath information with institutional reporting and examining socially uneven visibility.
details.zh: 该研究将洪水掩膜地理定位和经过微调的视觉语言模型应用于San Francisco的社交媒体图像，将由此产生的洪水灾后信息与机构报告进行比较，并考察社会层面不均衡的可见性。

limitations.en: Assessment is based only on the supplied title and abstract; model architecture, training details, and evaluation procedures are not provided.
limitations.zh: 评估仅基于所提供的标题和摘要；未提供模型架构、训练细节和评估程序。

papers.title: Water Quality Assessment Using Transformer, Quantum Neural Network, XGBoost, and Random Forest Models in an Agentic n8n Workflow with Applications in Maritime Robotics, Education, and Training

summary.en: An agentic n8n workflow combines water-quality prediction models with an LLM diagnosis agent for surface-water assessment and decision support.
summary.zh: 一个智能体化 n8n 工作流将水质预测模型与 LLM 诊断智能体相结合，用于地表水评估和决策支持。

details.en: The paper uses SETX water-quality data and multiple predictive models to classify safe and unsafe surface-water conditions. An LLM-based diagnosis agent then analyzes the predictions, generates a water-quality assessment and risk classification, summarizes the results, and identifies influential parameters.
details.zh: 该论文使用 SETX 水质数据和多个预测模型，对安全和不安全的地表水状况进行分类。随后，一个基于 LLM 的诊断智能体分析预测结果，生成水质评估和风险分类，总结结果，并识别具有影响力的参数。

limitations.en: Assessment is based on the supplied abstract; the abstract does not specify the LLM model, prompts, or quantitative evaluation of the LLM diagnosis component.
limitations.zh: 评估基于所提供的摘要；该摘要未说明 LLM 模型、提示词或对 LLM 诊断组件的定量评估。

papers.title: Spatiotemporal coupling between physical disaster impacts and social sentiment in urban flood events using large language models
papers.venue: International Journal of Disaster Risk Reduction

summary.en: The study uses large language models to analyze social sentiment during urban flooding events and conduct spatiotemporal coupling with physical disaster impacts.
summary.zh: 研究利用大型语言模型分析城市洪涝事件中的社会情绪，并与物理灾害影响进行时空耦合。

details.en: The paper focuses on urban flooding events, combines physical disaster impacts and social sentiment data to conduct spatiotemporal coupling research, and explicitly uses large language models.
details.zh: 该论文聚焦城市洪涝事件，结合物理灾害影响和社会情绪数据开展时空耦合研究，明确使用大型语言模型。

limitations.zh: 仅提供标题，未提供摘要或方法细节，因此无法确认具体模型、输入数据、评估方式和工作流实现。

papers.title: Relevance is not enough: A Communication-Oriented Retrieval System for Consequential Scientific Question Answering

summary.en: A communication-oriented RAG system helps residents and community leaders interpret public water-quality findings and decide on actions.
summary.zh: 一个面向沟通的 RAG 系统帮助居民和社区领导者解读公共水质研究结果并决定采取何种行动。

details.en: The system classifies questions by reasoning type, generates follow-up questions to retrieve missing evidence, distinguishes known from uncertain information, and rewrites scientific details into accessible persona-based language. It is evaluated on more than 160 questions using human-centered completeness measures.
details.zh: 该系统按推理类型对问题进行分类，生成后续问题以检索缺失的证据，区分已知信息与不确定信息，并将科学细节改写为易于理解的、基于角色的语言。该系统使用以人为本的完整性指标，在超过 160 个问题上进行了评估。

limitations.en: The abstract does not specify the underlying language model, prompting or training details, or the exact water-quality questions and actions studied.
limitations.zh: 摘要未说明所使用的底层语言模型、提示或训练细节，也未说明所研究的确切水质问题和行动。

papers.title: Where should control sit? Reliability-cost trade-offs in delegating water distribution network optimisation to LLM agents

summary.en: The study evaluates where autonomous LLM agents should control stages of water distribution network optimisation, comparing reliability, resource cost and solution quality across deterministic and ReAct-based workflows.
summary.zh: 该研究评估了自主 LLM 智能体应在何处控制供水管网优化的各个阶段，并比较了确定性工作流和基于 ReAct 的工作流在可靠性、资源成本和解决方案质量方面的表现。

details.en: It examines single-objective pump energy minimisation and multi-objective energy-resilience optimisation on the C-Town water distribution network across five LLMs. The study finds that delegating nodes to ReAct agents increases resource use and can cause structural workflow failures, while optimisation quality is relatively insensitive to control allocation.
details.zh: 该研究考察了 C-Town 供水管网中的单目标泵能耗最小化和多目标能耗-韧性优化，涉及五个 LLM。研究发现，将节点委托给 ReAct 智能体会增加资源使用量，并可能导致工作流出现结构性故障，而优化质量对控制分配相对不敏感。

limitations.en: Evidence is limited to the supplied abstract; detailed implementation, datasets beyond the named benchmark, and full evaluation procedures are not available here.
limitations.zh: 证据仅限于所提供的摘要；此处无法获得详细的实施方案、除所述基准数据集之外的数据集以及完整的评估程序。

papers.title: What structured tool interfaces do and do not provide for LLM-based SWAT+ calibration

summary.en: Researching the capabilities provided and not provided by structured tool interfaces for LLM-based SWAT+ model calibration.
summary.zh: 研究结构化工具接口对基于LLM的SWAT+模型校准所提供和未提供的能力。

details.en: The title points to a hydrological modeling study that uses LLM for SWAT+ calibration and examines the role of structured tool interfaces.
details.zh: 题名指向一个将LLM用于SWAT+校准的水文建模研究，并考察结构化工具接口的作用。

limitations.en: Only the title is provided, while the abstract and methodological details are missing; therefore, the specific calibration process, tool functions, or experimental results cannot be determined.
limitations.zh: 仅提供题名，缺少摘要及方法细节，因此无法判断具体校准流程、工具功能或实验结果。

papers.title: Towards Smart Water Infrastructure: Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Models for Acoustic Leak Detection

summary.en: A retrieval-augmented LLM framework retrieves historical pipeline acoustic cases and uses them to generate evidence-grounded water-pipeline leak diagnoses and reports.
summary.zh: 一种检索增强型 LLM 框架检索历史管道声学案例，并利用这些案例生成有证据支撑的供水管道泄漏诊断和报告。

details.en: The study constructs a database of historical acoustic cases from water distribution networks, retrieves relevant cases, and incorporates them into LLM prompts for acoustic leak detection. It evaluates the approach on samples from Dalian and Hong Kong and reports diagnostic performance comparable to specialized supervised models.
details.zh: 该研究构建了一个来自供水管网历史声学案例的数据库，检索相关案例，并将其纳入 LLM 提示词中以进行声学泄漏检测。该方法在来自大连和香港的样本上进行了评估，并报告称其诊断性能与专门的监督模型相当。

limitations.en: Assessment is based only on the supplied abstract; details of the LLM architecture, prompting, and evaluation protocol are not available.
limitations.zh: 评估仅基于所提供的摘要；有关 LLM 架构、提示词设计和评估协议的细节不可用。

papers.title: Toward advanced management of sludge bulking: An explainable evaluation framework to quantify and improve large language model cognitive capabilities

summary.en: A paper proposes an explainable framework for using and evaluating large language model capabilities in advanced sludge-bulking management.
summary.zh: 一篇论文提出了一个可解释框架，用于利用和评估大型语言模型在先进污泥膨胀管理中的能力。

details.en: The title indicates a wastewater-focused study connecting sludge-bulking management with an explainable framework that quantifies and improves LLM cognitive capabilities. The abstract is unavailable, so the exact workflow and empirical evaluation details cannot be determined.

papers.title: Retrieval-Augmented Classification of Environmental Mitigations in Hydropower Licensing Documents

summary.en: A preprint develops BERT, RAG, and hybrid pipelines to classify environmental mitigation obligations in hydropower licensing documents under severe label scarcity.
summary.zh: 一篇预印本开发了 BERT、RAG 和混合管道，用于在标签严重稀缺的情况下，对水电许可文件中的环境缓解义务进行分类。

details.en: The study evaluates classification over 5,860 paragraphs from 2017 hydropower license documents and 135 mitigation categories. Its RAG pipeline retrieves category definitions to support zero-shot classification, while a hybrid combines BERT detection with RAG classification.
details.zh: 该研究在来自 2017 年水电许可文件的 5,860 个段落和 135 个缓解类别上评估分类效果。其 RAG 管道检索类别定义以支持零样本分类，而混合管道则结合 BERT 检测与 RAG 分类。

limitations.en: The supplied abstract does not identify the RAG generator, state that it is an LLM/GPT/language model, or clarify whether generation is performed by a language model rather than another NLP architecture.
limitations.zh: 所提供的摘要未确定 RAG 生成器，未说明其是 LLM/GPT/语言模型，也未明确生成是否由语言模型而非另一种 NLP 架构执行。

papers.title: Large language model as reservoir operator: a generative agent bridging human judgment and optimization in water resource systems

summary.en: The paper evaluates an LLM as a reservoir operator for monthly water-supply allocation at Folsom Lake over a 21-year simulation.
summary.zh: 该论文评估了LLM作为水库调度员，在Folsom Lake进行月度供水分配的表现，模拟期为21年。

details.en: An LLM makes reservoir release and water-supply allocation decisions from contextual information. Its behavior and performance are benchmarked against historical operations, a neural-network regressor, and dynamic programming, with analyses of chain-of-thought outputs, sensitivity, and rationale.
details.zh: LLM根据背景信息做出水库泄放和供水分配决策。其行为和性能与历史运行、神经网络回归器和动态规划进行了基准比较，并分析了思维链输出、敏感性和理由。

limitations.zh: 评估仅基于所提供的标题和摘要；实施细节和完整的实验方案不可用。

papers.title: Grounding large language models in hydrologic modelling

summary.en: HydroAIM grounds LLM agents in automated hydrological time-series modelling using expert workflows, an MCP architecture and execution feedback.
summary.zh: HydroAIM 通过专家工作流、MCP 架构和执行反馈，将 LLM agents 应用于自动化水文时间序列建模。

details.en: The framework combines expert task planning, a standardised algorithmic workflow library and an iterative execution toolbox. The paper reports 92.8% execution success across 125 tasks using five LLMs; removing the expert workflow reduces success to 0%. Across 531 CAMELS catchments, reported median NSE is 0.58 for local models and 0.73 for global models. This is a hydrological modelling study, distinct from the hydropower operation chapter.
details.zh: 该框架结合了专家任务规划、标准化算法工作流库和迭代执行工具箱。论文报告称，使用五个 LLM 完成 125 项任务时，执行成功率为 92.8%；移除专家工作流后，成功率降至 0%。在 531 个 CAMELS 流域中，报告的局部模型中位 NSE 为 0.58，全局模型中位 NSE 为 0.73。这是一项水文建模研究，不同于水电运行章节。

limitations.en: User-supplied PDF title, DOI and abstract checked; reported performance has not been independently reproduced. Grounding is a journal pre-proof.
limitations.zh: 已检查用户提供的 PDF 标题、DOI 和摘要；报告的性能尚未得到独立复现。Grounding 是期刊预印本。

papers.title: Event logic graph-augmented generation for interpretable urban waterlogging emergency decision-making

summary.en: The paper proposes ELGAG, a graph-augmented RAG framework that retrieves causal waterlogging evidence and uses an LLM to generate interpretable emergency assessment reports.
summary.zh: 该论文提出 ELGAG，一种图增强 RAG 框架，用于检索内涝因果证据，并利用 LLM 生成可解释的应急评估报告。

details.en: It organizes historical urban waterlogging cases, causal factors, response actions, responsible entities, and emergency resources into an Event Logic Graph. Retrieved cause–event–response evidence is supplied under domain-enhanced prompt constraints to an LLM for emergency report generation, with validation-gated feedback for knowledge evolution. Experiments use Guangzhou urban waterlogging data from 2010–2019 and compare the framework with vector-based and graph-enhanced RAG baselines.
details.zh: 该框架将历史城市内涝案例、因果因素、响应行动、责任实体和应急资源组织成事件逻辑图。在领域增强的提示约束下，将检索到的原因–事件–响应证据提供给 LLM，以生成应急报告，并通过验证门控反馈实现知识演化。实验使用 2010–2019 年广州城市内涝数据，并将该框架与基于向量和图增强的 RAG 基线方法进行比较。

limitations.en: Evidence is limited to the supplied abstract; the detailed implementation, model identity, and evaluation procedures are not available here.
limitations.zh: 证据仅限于所提供的摘要；此处未提供详细的实现、模型名称和评估流程。

papers.title: Enhancing LLM-based generation of safety hazard rectification measures for mega hydropower construction via cascaded RAG and adaptive ColBERT

summary.en: Uses an LLM with cascaded RAG and adaptive ColBERT to generate safety-hazard rectification measures for mega hydropower construction.
summary.zh: 使用带有级联 RAG 和自适应 ColBERT 的 LLM，为大型水电工程施工生成安全隐患整改措施。

details.en: The paper feed indicates an LLM-based method for producing safety hazard rectification measures in mega hydropower construction. No abstract or further methodological and evaluation details are provided.

papers.title: Hydrology Copilot: A cloud-native AI system for hydrological data analysis

summary.en: Hydrology Copilot coordinates LLM agents, cloud-native NLDAS-3 access, inspectable code, memory, and validation for reproducible drought-analysis workflows.
summary.zh: Hydrology Copilot 协调 LLM 代理、云原生 NLDAS-3 访问、可检查代码、记忆和验证，以实现可复现的干旱分析工作流。

details.en: Hydrology Copilot translates natural-language requests into hydrological analyses over NASA NLDAS-3 data using a multi-agent architecture for query parsing, code generation, execution, and visualization. Its design adds persistent memory, dataset-aware query validation, inspectable Python workflows, Kerchunk-based data virtualization, and expert-validated hydrological functions. Benchmark analyses match expert reference results, drought diagnostics agree with the operational U.S. Drought Monitor, and data-access optimizations improve I/O latency by 1.5–4.6 times, providing unusually concrete evidence for a deployable hydrological copilot.
details.zh: Hydrology Copilot 使用多代理架构，将自然语言请求转换为基于 NASA NLDAS-3 数据的水文分析，用于查询解析、代码生成、执行和可视化。其设计增加了持久记忆、数据集感知的查询验证、可检查的 Python 工作流、基于 Kerchunk 的数据虚拟化，以及经专家验证的水文函数。基准分析结果与专家参考结果一致，干旱诊断结果与业务运行中的 U.S. Drought Monitor 一致，数据访问优化将 I/O 延迟提升了 1.5–4.6 倍，为可部署的水文 Copilot 提供了异常具体的证据。

limitations.en: The evidence centers on NLDAS-3 drought workflows implemented with Azure services and GPT-4o; generalization to other hydrological archives, models, operational organizations, and decision responsibilities has not yet been demonstrated.
limitations.zh: 证据主要集中于使用 Azure 服务和 GPT-4o 实现的 NLDAS-3 干旱工作流；对于其他水文档案、模型、业务组织和决策职责的泛化尚未得到证明。

papers.title: HydroSuite-AI: Facilitating Hydrological Research with LLM-Driven Code Assistance

summary.en: HydroSuite-AI connects an LLM interface to HydroLang, HydroCompute, and HydroRTC for hydrological code generation, execution, and library-specific question answering.
summary.zh: HydroSuite-AI 将 LLM 接口连接到 HydroLang、HydroCompute 和 HydroRTC，用于水文代码生成、执行以及特定于库的问题回答。

details.en: HydroSuite-AI is an LLM-enhanced web application intended to reduce the coding and documentation burden in hydrological analysis. It integrates three open-source hydrology libraries, generates code snippets, provides an execution environment, and answers factual questions about the supported tools so that users can move from natural-language requests to executable analysis. Case studies and user feedback provide early evidence for hydrological research and education use.
details.zh: HydroSuite-AI 是一款经 LLM 增强的 Web 应用，旨在减轻水文分析中的编码和文档负担。它集成了三个开源水文学库，生成代码片段，提供执行环境，并回答有关所支持工具的事实性问题，使用户能够从自然语言请求转向可执行的分析。案例研究和用户反馈为其在水文研究和教育中的应用提供了初步证据。

limitations.en: This is a version-1 preprint that has not been peer reviewed; the reported case studies and user feedback do not establish controlled code-correctness rates or production-scale reliability.
limitations.zh: 这是一篇尚未经过同行评审的版本-1 预印本；所报告的案例研究和用户反馈并未确定受控的代码正确率或生产规模的可靠性。

papers.title: Human-AI teaming for water quality documentation analysis with large language models

summary.en: The EWRA study compares three OpenAI models with human reviewers on 20 water-quality documents and finds that localized chunking improves coding accuracy and agreement.
summary.zh: EWRA 研究比较了三个 OpenAI 模型与人工审阅者在 20 份水质文件上的表现，发现局部化分块提高了编码准确率和一致性。

details.en: The two-page EWRA 2025 paper evaluates GPT-4o, GPT-4o-mini, and o1-mini as additional reviewers of urban water-quality documentation. Twenty laboratory and field documents were manually coded for concerns including corrosion, pollutants, and chemical imbalances, then processed through open and localized chunk-based prompting and assessed using agreement, accuracy, precision, recall, and Fleiss' Kappa. The reported results show that utility-specific definitions and localized context improve accuracy, cross-run agreement, and true-positive identification, supporting a bounded human-LLM workflow for documentation review.
details.zh: 这篇两页的 EWRA 2025 论文评估了 GPT-4o、GPT-4o-mini 和 o1-mini 作为城市水质文档的额外审阅者。20 份实验室和现场文档被人工编码，以标记腐蚀、污染物和化学失衡等问题，随后通过开放式和基于局部化分块的提示词进行处理，并使用一致性、准确率、精确率、召回率和 Fleiss' Kappa 进行评估。报告结果显示，针对公用事业的定义和局部化上下文提高了准确率、跨运行一致性和真阳性识别率，支持一种受限的人类-LLM 文档审阅工作流。

limitations.en: The evidence comes from a two-page conference paper and a controlled set of 20 documents; it does not establish transfer to other utilities, prospective operational use, or direct action on a water system.
limitations.zh: 证据来自一篇两页的会议论文和一组受控的 20 份文档；其并未证明能够迁移到其他公用事业、用于前瞻性运营，或直接对供水系统采取行动。

papers.title: Evaluating the logical and mathematical reasoning capabilities of language models in agricultural water management

summary.en: DEW and FLOW benchmark how large reasoning models handle 419 logical and mathematical agricultural water-management questions and how graph-RAG changes their performance.
summary.zh: DEW 和 FLOW 对大型推理模型处理 419 个农业水资源管理逻辑和数学问题的能力，以及 graph-RAG 如何改变其性能进行了基准测试。

details.en: The article introduces the 419-question Dataset for Evaluating Water Management across 24 agricultural water-management domains and a graph retrieval-augmented prompting framework called FLOW.
