It evaluates o3-medium, Claude Sonnet 4, Gemini 2.5 Pro, and Qwen3-30B-A3B, reporting average gains over chain-of-thought prompting of 7.73% for logical reasoning and 16.33% for mathematical reasoning. The benchmark also identifies economic decisions, empirical equations, and model overconfidence as important weaknesses, making it useful evidence about the foundational reasoning capabilities on which later water-management agents would depend.
details.zh: 本文介绍了涵盖 24 个农业水资源管理领域的 Dataset for Evaluating Water Management（419 个问题的数据集），以及一种称为 FLOW 的图检索增强提示框架。该研究评估了 o3-medium、Claude Sonnet 4、Gemini 2.5 Pro 和 Qwen3-30B-A3B，并报告称，与 chain-of-thought prompting 相比，逻辑推理的平均提升为 7.73%，数学推理的平均提升为 16.33%。该基准还确定经济决策、经验方程和模型过度自信是重要弱点，为了解后续水资源管理代理所依赖的基础推理能力提供了有用证据。

limitations.en: The study evaluates question answering and mathematical reasoning rather than tool execution, live irrigation operations, or accountable water-allocation decisions.
limitations.zh: 该研究评估的是问题回答和数学推理，而不是工具执行、实时灌溉运营或负责任的水资源分配决策。

papers.title: A conversational intelligent assistant for enhanced operational support in floodplain management with multimodal data

summary.en: Floodplain Manager AI combines LLM-based semantic search with multimodal FEMA flood-map interpretation to provide location-specific regulatory guidance for floodplain management.
summary.zh: Floodplain Manager AI 将基于 LLM 的语义搜索与 FEMA 洪水地图的多模态解读相结合，为洪泛区管理提供特定地点的监管指导。

details.en: The study develops Floodplain Manager AI as a decision-support assistant for floodplain managers who must interpret regulations, retrieve location-specific information, and communicate flood risk. It combines large language models, semantic search, and multimodal interpretation of FEMA flood maps, and reports experimental improvements in response accuracy and relevance. The work is directly relevant to flood-risk operations because the language model is grounded in regulatory and geospatial materials rather than used only for generic question answering.
details.zh: 该研究开发了 Floodplain Manager AI，作为洪泛区管理人员的决策支持助手，帮助其解读法规、检索特定地点的信息并传达洪水风险。它结合了大语言模型、语义搜索以及对 FEMA 洪水地图的多模态解读，并报告了实验中响应准确性和相关性的提升。该工作与洪水风险运营直接相关，因为该语言模型以监管和地理空间材料为依据，而不仅仅用于通用问答。

limitations.en: The evaluation covers regulatory question answering and FEMA flood-map interpretation in experimental tests; independent replication and sustained deployment within a floodplain-management agency have not been demonstrated.
limitations.zh: 评估涵盖实验测试中的监管问答和 FEMA 洪水地图解读；尚未证明可由独立机构复现，也未证明其能够在洪泛区管理机构内持续部署。

papers.title: Integrating LLM-based agents with uncertainty-aware optimization for water-energy-carbon nexus management in irrigation districts

summary.en: The Water Research record identifies an LLM-agent and uncertainty-aware optimization study for water–energy–carbon nexus management in irrigation districts.
summary.zh: Water Research 记录确认了一项针对灌溉区水–能源–碳耦合管理的 LLM-agent 和不确定性感知优化研究。

details.en: The publisher-maintained bibliographic record establishes a direct application of LLM-based agents to irrigation-district water–energy–carbon nexus management and links the agent component with uncertainty-aware optimization. This supports scope inclusion as a water-management agent study, but the accessible evidence does not establish the system architecture, optimization formulation, study area, evaluation design, or reported performance.
details.zh: 出版商维护的书目记录确立了基于 LLM 的 agents 在灌溉区水–能源–碳耦合管理中的直接应用，并将 agent 组件与不确定性感知优化联系起来。这支持将其纳入水管理 agent 研究范围，但可获取的证据无法确定系统架构、优化公式、研究区域、评估设计或报告的性能。

limitations.en: Only title, authorship, journal, date, DOI, PII, and reference metadata were accessible; the abstract and full text were not openly available, so no method- or result-level claims are made.
limitations.zh: 仅可获取标题、作者信息、期刊、日期、DOI、PII 和参考文献元数据；摘要和全文未公开，因此不作方法或结果层面的断言。

papers.title: FloodReasonBench: Benchmarking VLM Reasoning Segmentation for Embodied Flood Response at the Edge

summary.en: FloodReasonBench introduces a flood-specific VLM reasoning-segmentation dataset and jointly measures segmentation quality, latency, energy, and communication cost on an NVIDIA Jetson edge platform.
summary.zh: FloodReasonBench 引入了一个专用于洪水的 VLM 推理-分割数据集，并在 NVIDIA Jetson 边缘平台上联合测量分割质量、延迟、能耗和通信成本。

details.en: FloodReasonBench evaluates how VLMs translate response-oriented language requests into pixel-level grounding for people, buildings, vehicles, and other targets in real flood scenes. Its FloodResponseSeg dataset supports a benchmark that combines task accuracy with lightweight visual encoding, hierarchical split inference, compressed intermediate representations, and measurements on an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Xavier. The results expose operating trade-offs among flood-scene segmentation quality, edge latency, energy consumption, and communication footprint for resource-constrained embodied response platforms.
details.zh: FloodReasonBench 评估 VLM 如何将面向响应的语言请求转化为真实洪水场景中人员、建筑物、车辆及其他目标的像素级定位。其 FloodResponseSeg 数据集支持一项基准测试，将任务准确率与轻量级视觉编码、分层拆分推理、压缩中间表示以及在 NVIDIA Jetson AGX Xavier 上的测量相结合。结果揭示了资源受限的具身响应平台在洪水场景分割质量、边缘延迟、能耗和通信开销之间的运行权衡。

limitations.en: The evidence is a seven-page arXiv preprint and a benchmark evaluation, not a field deployment of an embodied flood-response system.
limitations.zh: 相关证据是一篇七页的 arXiv 预印本和一项基准评估，而不是对具身洪水响应系统的现场部署。

papers.title: Can large language models quantify urban floods from multi-source textual information

summary.en: DeepFlood uses LLM reference-based inference to estimate flash-flood depth categories from event narratives, reaching 95.5% category accuracy against expert estimates in the Greater New York case.
summary.zh: DeepFlood 使用基于 LLM 参考的推理，根据事件叙述估计山洪深度类别；在大纽约地区案例中，相对于专家估计，其类别准确率达到 95.5%。

details.en: DeepFlood converts unstructured flash-flood narratives into quantitative inundation-depth categories through reference-based LLM inference. The study evaluates multiple backbones, including ChatGPT and Gemini, and reports 95.5% flood-depth category accuracy and 92.4% reference-based reasoning accuracy for narratives from the Greater New York Metropolitan Area relative to domain-expert estimates. The resulting information is intended to support post-event flood assessment and urban flood-model validation where conventional observations are incomplete.
details.zh: DeepFlood 通过基于参考的 LLM 推理，将非结构化山洪叙述转换为定量的淹没深度类别。该研究评估了多个骨干模型，包括 ChatGPT 和 Gemini，并报告称，相对于领域专家估计，来自大纽约都会区的叙述在洪水深度类别方面的准确率为 95.5%，基于参考的推理准确率为 92.4%。所得信息旨在支持事件后洪水评估和城市洪水模型验证，尤其适用于传统观测不完整的情况。

limitations.en: The reported evaluation covers flash-flood narratives from one metropolitan region and uses domain-expert estimates as the comparison reference rather than direct water-depth observations.
limitations.zh: 报告的评估涵盖来自一个都会区的山洪叙述，并使用领域专家估计作为比较参考，而非直接的水深观测。

papers.title: Assessing Reliability of Large Language Model Outputs on Drinking Water Quality Data from Smart Water Distribution System

summary.en: The chapter evaluates how reliably Gemini 1.5 and ChatGPT-4o interpret and recommend actions from real-time drinking-water quality measurements.
summary.zh: 本章评估 Gemini 1.5 和 ChatGPT-4o 对实时饮用水水质测量结果的解读及行动建议的可靠性。

details.en: The study applies Gemini 1.5 Flash, Gemini 1.5 Pro, and ChatGPT-4o to real-time chlorine, pH, total dissolved solids, and temperature data from an IoT-enabled smart water distribution system at IIT Jodhpur. It focuses on checking the reliability of LLM-generated interpretations and recommendations against a real-world drinking-water dataset, providing foundational evidence for LLM-assisted water-quality assessment rather than an autonomous operational workflow.
details.zh: 该研究将 Gemini 1.5 Flash、Gemini 1.5 Pro 和 ChatGPT-4o 应用于来自 IIT Jodhpur 一个支持 IoT 的智能供水系统的实时余氯、pH、总溶解固体和温度数据。研究重点是根据真实世界的饮用水数据集，检查 LLM 生成的解读和建议的可靠性，为 LLM 辅助的水质评估提供基础性证据，而不是建立自主运行工作流。

limitations.en: Scope inclusion and the current summary are based on the verified publisher abstract; collection of the subscription chapter PDF is intentionally deferred.
limitations.zh: 范围纳入和当前摘要基于经核实的出版商摘要；订阅章节 PDF 的收集被有意推迟。

papers.title: Large language model-driven decision-making for single-atom Fenton-like catalysts toward wastewater treatment

summary.en: An LLM workflow mines more than 1,000 catalyst publications and patents, then supports experimentally checked catalyst selection for advanced wastewater treatment.
summary.zh: 一个LLM工作流挖掘了超过1,000篇催化剂出版物和专利，随后支持针对高级废水处理的、经实验验证的催化剂选择。

details.en: The study uses few-shot chain-of-thought prompting to extract synthesis, material-property, and performance knowledge from more than 1,000 publications and patents on Fenton-like single-atom catalysts. The structured knowledge is combined with machine-learning prediction and literature-grounded synthesis recommendations to select catalyst configurations for target wastewater conditions. Experiments are reported to confirm the performance of platform-recommended catalysts under realistic conditions.
details.zh: 该研究使用少样本思维链提示，从超过1,000篇关于类Fenton单原子催化剂的出版物和专利中提取合成、材料性质和性能知识。结构化知识与机器学习预测和以文献为依据的合成建议相结合，以针对目标废水条件选择催化剂配置。据报道，实验确认了平台推荐的催化剂在现实条件下的性能。

limitations.en: The evidence concerns catalyst-design decision support under the reported target wastewater conditions rather than autonomous operation of a wastewater-treatment process.
limitations.zh: 相关证据涉及在所报告的目标废水条件下为催化剂设计提供决策支持，而非废水处理过程的自主运行。

papers.title: Integrating multi-source data and large language models in flood vulnerability curve analysis for buildings in mainland China

summary.en: The study combines RAG-grounded LLM reasoning with construction, survey, and market data to generate building flood depth-damage curves for mainland China.
summary.zh: 该研究将基于RAG的LLM推理与建筑、调查和市场数据相结合，为中国大陆生成建筑物洪水水深—损失曲线。

details.en: The study integrates 646 construction-cost records, 881 field-survey responses, and more than 42,000 market-price records with domain retrieval and several LLM prompting strategies. The LLM generates economic-loss ratios for building components and indoor property across inundation depths, and the resulting curves are compared with established flood depth-damage references. The work provides an updateable approach for synthesizing flood-vulnerability curves under limited historical loss data.
details.zh: 该研究将646条建筑成本记录、881份实地调查答卷和42,000多条市场价格记录与领域检索及几种LLM提示策略相结合。LLM针对不同淹没水深生成建筑构件和室内财产的经济损失率，并将所得曲线与已有的洪水水深—损失参考曲线进行比较。该工作为在历史损失数据有限的情况下综合洪水脆弱性曲线提供了一种可更新的方法。

limitations.en: The collector did not capture an abstract; scope and summary were checked against the official Scientific Reports article page. The curves were assessed for plausibility rather than empirically validated as national curves.
limitations.zh: 采集器未获取摘要；研究范围和摘要已根据官方Scientific Reports文章页面进行核查。这些曲线的合理性得到了评估，但尚未作为全国性曲线进行实证验证。

papers.title: Automating SWMM-based stormwater modelling and analysis through a tool-augmented single-agent system

summary.en: SWMM-Agentic uses one LLM to orchestrate documented SWMM functions and completes 98.3% of a 60-task urban stormwater benchmark with the strongest tested model.
summary.zh: SWMM-Agentic 使用一个 LLM 编排有文档记录的 SWMM 函数，并在 60 项城市雨洪基准测试中以测试模型中性能最强者完成了 98.3% 的任务。

details.en: SWMM-Agentic couples a single LLM orchestration model with documented functions for inspecting, editing, running, and analysing an existing SWMM model through natural-language instructions. The authors evaluate 20 static, 20 dynamic, and 20 scenario-based tasks with three LLMs, yielding 180 runs; the strongest model completes 59 of 60 tasks, and 89 of 100 failed tool calls are followed by a successful corrective call within three attempts. The system also reproduces network characteristics, compares control strategies, and runs a human-framed rain-garden scenario for combined-sewer-overflow analysis, providing direct evidence for traceable LLM orchestration of urban stormwater modelling workflows.
details.zh: SWMM-Agentic 将单个 LLM 编排模型与有文档记录的函数相结合，通过自然语言指令检查、编辑、运行和分析现有的 SWMM 模型。作者使用三个 LLM 对 20 项静态任务、20 项动态任务和 20 项基于情景的任务进行评估，共产生 180 次运行；性能最强的模型完成了 60 项任务中的 59 项，并且 100 次失败的工具调用中有 89 次在三次尝试内紧接着出现了成功的纠正调用。该系统还复现了网络特征、比较了控制策略，并运行了一个由人类设定的雨水花园情景，用于合流制溢流分析，为城市雨洪建模工作流中可追溯的 LLM 编排提供了直接证据。

limitations.en: The evaluation uses one Astlingen benchmark model and a human-defined problem and parameter space; transfer to other drainage networks, model-development stages, and operational deployment is not evaluated.
limitations.zh: 评估使用了一个 Astlingen 基准模型以及由人类定义的问题和参数空间；未评估向其他排水网络、模型开发阶段和运营部署的迁移。

papers.title: Assessing the Benefits of Combining Advanced Deep Learning Techniques for Post-Disaster Building Damage Assessment from UAV Imagery

summary.en: A detector–LVLM pipeline classifies post-disaster building damage on FloodNet and RescueNet and reports gains over standalone baselines with limited detection annotations.
summary.zh: 一种检测器–LVLM流水线在FloodNet和RescueNet上对灾后建筑损毁进行分类，并在有限检测标注条件下报告了相较于独立基线的性能提升。

details.en: The framework separates building detection from damage interpretation: a computer-vision detector supplies bounding boxes, and a large vision-language model classifies damage and adds contextual interpretation. Evaluation on FloodNet and RescueNet covers intact, partially damaged, and destroyed buildings, with the best configuration improving reported counting performance over isolated baselines. The paper also analyses failure cases and releases code and data.
details.zh: 该框架将建筑检测与损毁解读分开：计算机视觉检测器提供边界框，大型视觉语言模型对损毁进行分类并添加上下文解读。在FloodNet和RescueNet上的评估涵盖完好、部分损毁和被毁建筑，最佳配置相较于独立基线提高了报告的计数性能。论文还分析了失败案例，并发布了代码和数据。

limitations.en: Only one of the two evaluation benchmarks is flood-specific; this item supports multimodal flood-impact interpretation rather than hydrological forecasting or operational response.
limitations.zh: 两个评估基准中只有一个专门针对洪水；该条目支持多模态洪水影响解读，而非水文预报或运营响应。

papers.title: Unlocking the Potential: Benchmarking Large Language Models in Water Engineering and Research

details.en: The WaterER study introduces 983 benchmark tasks spanning wastewater treatment, environmental restoration, drinking-water treatment and distribution, sanitation, anaerobic digestion, and contaminants assessment. Seven LLMs are evaluated across these tasks to characterize their strengths and limitations as water-engineering expert models. This is enabling benchmark evidence rather than an agent implementation.
details.zh: WaterER 研究引入了涵盖废水处理、环境修复、饮用水处理与配送、卫生设施、厌氧消化和污染物评估的 983 项基准任务。在这些任务中对七个 LLM 进行评估，以刻画其作为水工程专家模型的优势和局限性。这是支持基准测试的证据，而不是代理实现。

papers.title: Naiad: Novel Agentic Intelligent Autonomous System for Inland Water Monitoring

details.en: NAIAD is an LLM-enabled inland-water monitoring assistant that combines retrieval-augmented generation, external-tool orchestration, computational graph execution, and agentic reflection. It integrates weather data, Sentinel-2 imagery, remote-sensing indices, chlorophyll-a estimation, and established monitoring tools. A dedicated benchmark evaluates correctness and relevance across different user-expertise levels, with an ablation across LLM backbones.
details.zh: NAIAD 是一个由 LLM 驱动的内陆水体监测助手，结合了检索增强生成、外部工具编排、计算图执行和智能体反思。它集成了天气数据、Sentinel-2 影像、遥感指数、叶绿素-a 估算以及成熟的监测工具。一个专门的基准测试评估不同用户专业水平下的正确性和相关性，并对不同 LLM 骨干模型进行了消融实验。

papers.title: Mini-JEPA Foundation Model Fleet Enables Agentic Hydrologic Intelligence

details.en: The study proposes five sensor-specialized Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture foundation models routed by an LLM for hydrological questions. The models cover optical, radar, thermal, phenological, and topography-soil inputs; the evaluation reports predictive performance for elevation, temperature, precipitation, soil moisture, and aridity, together with a curated routing test and paired comparison against AlphaEarth-only retrieval.
details.zh: 该研究提出了五个由LLM为水文问题进行路由的、传感器专用的Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture基础模型。这些模型涵盖光学、雷达、热学、物候和地形-土壤输入；评估报告了海拔、温度、降水、土壤湿度和干旱度的预测性能，以及经过整理的路由测试和与仅使用AlphaEarth检索的配对比较。

papers.title: MARLIN: Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning with Murmuration Intelligence and LLM Guidance for Reservoir Management

details.en: MARLIN combines decentralized multi-agent reinforcement learning with an LLM that supplies real-time reward-shaping signals for reservoir management under physical-transfer and environmental uncertainty. Experiments using USGS data report uncertainty, computation, response-time, and scaling outcomes. It is retained as a hybrid LLM-guided reservoir system and distinguished from classical non-LLM MARL.
details.zh: MARLIN 将去中心化多智能体强化学习与一个 LLM 相结合，由该 LLM 为不确定的物理传输和环境条件下的水库管理提供实时奖励塑形信号。使用 USGS 数据的实验报告了不确定性、计算、响应时间和扩展性结果。它被保留为一种混合型 LLM 引导的水库系统，并与经典的非 LLM MARL 区分开来。

papers.title: InsurAgent: A Large Language Model-Empowered Agent for Simulating Individual Behavior in Purchasing Flood Insurance

details.en: The study evaluates large language models for flood-insurance purchase probabilities and proposes InsurAgent, an LLM-empowered system with perception, retrieval, reasoning, action, and memory modules. Retrieval-augmented generation grounds decisions in survey data, while memory supports temporal simulations of individual decisions. The work directly addresses behavioural modelling and policy analysis in a flood-risk context.
details.zh: 该研究评估了大型语言模型在洪水保险购买概率预测中的表现，并提出了 InsurAgent——一个由 LLM 驱动的系统，包含感知、检索、推理、行动和记忆模块。检索增强生成使决策以调查数据为依据，而记忆模块支持对个体决策进行时间模拟。该工作直接针对洪水风险背景下的行为建模和政策分析。

papers.title: AI-Driven Framework for Adaptive Water Network Management with Proof-of-Concept Implementation: Addressing Non-Revenue Water in Jordan

details.en: The study integrates EPANET hydraulic modelling, a digital-twin concept, SCADA, retrieval-augmented generation, function calling, and LLM-based agents for continuous water-network monitoring and adaptive decision support. A proof-of-concept uses offline LLMs and EPYT on a 1,164-junction Amman network and reports automated simulation, anomaly detection, burst localization, and report generation outcomes.
details.zh: 该研究整合了EPANET水力建模、数字孪生概念、SCADA、检索增强生成、函数调用以及基于LLM的智能体，用于持续监测供水网络和提供自适应决策支持。概念验证在包含1,164个节点的Amman网络上使用离线LLM和EPYT，并报告了自动化模拟、异常检测、爆管定位和报告生成结果。

papers.title: Wikimpacts 1.0: a new global climate impact database based on automated information extraction from Wikipedia

summary.en: Wikimpacts 1.0 uses GPT-4o to extract 2,726 climate-extreme events from Wikipedia into a global multiscale impact database evaluated against 156 manually annotated events.
summary.zh: Wikimpacts 1.0 使用 GPT-4o 从 Wikipedia 中提取了 2,726 起气候极端事件，构建了一个全球多尺度影响数据库，并通过与 156 起人工标注事件的对比进行评估。

details.en: Wikimpacts 1.0 uses GPT-4o in an automated pipeline that identifies relevant English Wikipedia articles and extracts, normalizes, geolocates, and stores impacts from floods, droughts, storms, heatwaves, wildfires, and other climate extremes. The database covers 2,726 events from 1034 to 2024, with 17,912 national and 32,343 subnational records. Comparison with 156 manually annotated events reports low error scores for timing, deaths, and economic damage but higher errors for homelessness, displacement, injuries, and damaged buildings, making the work useful evidence for LLM-assisted hydroclimate impact extraction.
details.zh: Wikimpacts 1.0 在自动化流程中使用 GPT-4o，识别相关的英文 Wikipedia 文章，并提取、标准化、地理定位和存储洪水、干旱、风暴、热浪、野火及其他气候极端事件的影响。该数据库涵盖 1034 年至 2024 年的 2,726 起事件，包括 17,912 条国家级记录和 32,343 条次国家级记录。与 156 起人工标注事件的比较表明，时间、死亡人数和经济损失的误差得分较低，但无家可归、流离失所、受伤人数和受损建筑物的误差较高，这使该研究成为 LLM 辅助水文气候影响提取的有用证据。

limitations.en: This is a multi-hazard information-extraction pipeline rather than an Agent workflow. Coverage inherits English-Wikipedia reporting bias, flood coverage is more limited than EM-DAT, and the authors advise against using it alone for complete or sensitive national loss assessments.
limitations.zh: 这是一种多灾种信息提取流程，而不是 Agent 工作流。其覆盖范围继承了英文 Wikipedia 的报道偏差，洪水覆盖范围比 EM-DAT 更有限，作者建议不要单独将其用于完整或敏感的国家级损失评估。

papers.title: MAESTRO: large language model-enabled cross-agency coordination for natural disaster early warning

summary.en: MAESTRO coordinates typhoon early-warning work across agencies through role-based LLM agents, grounded tools, and human oversight, matching expert alert levels in 98% of 100 scenarios.
summary.zh: MAESTRO通过基于角色的LLM代理、基于依据的工具和人工监督，协调跨机构的台风预警工作，在100个场景中的98%与专家警报级别相匹配。

details.en: MAESTRO mirrors institutional roles with multiple LLM-enabled agents that reconcile agency terminology, call grounded forecasting and impact tools, and assemble cross-agency early-warning actions under human oversight. Across 100 typhoon scenarios it matched expert alert levels in 98% of cases and reduced decision latency by more than 85%. A 72-hour Typhoon Lekima replay yielded eight additional hours of lead time for relocating about 180,000 residents, and the system was used in a provincial government platform during multiple typhoon responses over one year.
details.zh: MAESTRO通过多个由LLM支持的代理模拟机构角色，这些代理协调机构术语，调用基于依据的预测和影响工具，并在人工监督下制定跨机构预警行动。在100个台风场景中，它在98%的情况下与专家警报级别相匹配，并将决策延迟降低了超过85%。对Typhoon Lekima进行的72小时重演为疏散约180,000名居民额外争取了八小时的提前时间，并且该系统在一年内多次台风响应期间被用于一个省级政府平台。

limitations.en: The operational evidence comes from typhoon early warning in one provincial governance setting; it does not establish autonomous control of flood-control infrastructure or transferability to other institutional arrangements.
limitations.zh: 运行证据来自一个省级治理环境中的台风预警；它并未证明能够自主控制防洪基础设施，也未证明可迁移到其他机构安排。

papers.title: Improving flood detection with large-scale dashboard camera data

summary.en: BayFlood uses a vision-language model to screen 1,440,184 dashboard-camera images, revealing urban floods and coverage biases missed by existing reporting and sensor networks.
summary.zh: BayFlood 使用视觉语言模型筛查 1,440,184 张仪表盘摄像头图像，揭示了现有报告和传感器网络遗漏的城市洪水及覆盖偏差。

details.en: BayFlood applies a vision-language model to street-level dashboard-camera imagery for fine-grained urban flood detection without requiring a large labelled flood-image dataset. Validation across 1,440,184 images and multiple cities shows correspondence with external flood-risk predictors. In New York City, the method identifies flooding in neighbourhoods overlooked by existing approaches, detects demographic bias in current coverage, and suggests candidate locations for new flood sensors.
details.zh: BayFlood 将视觉语言模型应用于街道级仪表盘摄像头影像，以进行细粒度的城市洪水检测，而无需大型带标签的洪水图像数据集。在 1,440,184 张图像和多个城市中的验证显示，该方法与外部洪水风险预测因子相对应。在纽约市，该方法识别出被现有方法忽视的街区洪水，检测出现有覆盖中的人口统计偏差，并提出了新洪水传感器的候选位置。

limitations.en: The method detects visible street inundation from available camera imagery; its coverage depends on camera routes, image quality, and street visibility, and it does not itself forecast hydraulic states.
limitations.zh: 该方法检测可用摄像头影像中的可见街道积水；其覆盖范围取决于摄像头路线、图像质量和街道可见性，并且其本身不会预测水文状态。

papers.title: GeoRisk-MLLM: A Multimodal Large Language Model Framework for Natural Disaster Risk Detection and Early Warning in Geoscience

summary.en: GeoRisk-MLLM fuses remote-sensing, time-series, and IoT inputs to generate interpretable multi-hazard risk assessments, reporting an average AUC of 0.934 across three benchmarks.
summary.zh: GeoRisk-MLLM 融合遥感、时间序列和 IoT 输入，以生成可解释的多灾种风险评估，并报告了在三个基准上的平均 AUC 为 0.934。

details.en: GeoRisk-MLLM combines a multimodal spatiotemporal encoder, risk-aware reasoning alignment, and compressed edge inference for earthquake, landslide, and flood risk detection and early warning. It aligns imagery and monitoring streams with generated risk reports and uses cache compression and knowledge distillation for resource-constrained deployment. Across three geoscience benchmarks, the preprint reports an average AUC of 0.934 and human ratings that support the interpretability and actionability of its reports.
details.zh: GeoRisk-MLLM 结合多模态时空编码器、风险感知推理对齐和压缩边缘推理，用于地震、滑坡和洪水风险检测与预警。它将图像和监测流与生成的风险报告对齐，并使用缓存压缩和知识蒸馏来实现资源受限部署。在三个地学基准上，该预印本报告了 0.934 的平均 AUC，以及支持其报告可解释性和可操作性的人类评分。

limitations.en: The evidence is a preprint covering several hazard types; the collected abstract does not report flood-specific performance or a real operational flood-warning deployment.
limitations.zh: 证据来自一篇涵盖多种灾害类型的预印本；所收集的摘要未报告洪水专项性能或实际运行的洪水预警部署。

papers.title: CFDID: a China Flood Disaster Impact Database from 1994 to 2023
papers.venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)

summary.en: CFDID combines OCR, LLM extraction, and manual verification to structure 1,716 Chinese flood-impact records from 66 official documents covering 1994–2023.
summary.zh: CFDID结合OCR、LLM提取和人工核验，对1994–2023年66份官方文件中的1,716条中国洪灾影响记录进行结构化处理。

details.en: CFDID contains 1,716 flood-disaster event records, including 1,391 top-level events, compiled from 66 Chinese official documents. Its workflow combines optical character recognition, LLM-based information extraction, and manual verification to capture dates, locations, disaster categories, eight impact indicators, and source provenance. The database covers rainstorm, typhoon, snowmelt, ice-jam, and dam-break floods and reports substantial coverage of national annual totals for casualties, affected population and cropland, collapsed dwellings, and direct economic losses.
details.zh: CFDID包含1,716条洪灾事件记录，其中包括1,391条顶层事件记录，汇编自66份中国官方文件。其工作流程结合光学字符识别、基于LLM的信息提取和人工核验，以获取日期、地点、灾害类别、八项影响指标和来源溯源信息。该数据库涵盖暴雨、台风、融雪、冰塞和溃坝洪水，并报告了人员伤亡、受灾人口和受灾耕地、倒塌房屋以及直接经济损失等全国年度总量的较大覆盖范围。

limitations.en: This is a dataset and extraction workflow rather than an autonomous Agent system; data quality still relies on manual verification and the completeness of the underlying official documents.
limitations.zh: 这是一个数据集和提取工作流程，而非自主Agent系统；数据质量仍依赖人工核验以及底层官方文件的完整性。

papers.title: A progressive fine-tuning strategy for domain-specific large language models in wastewater treatment plants safety

summary.en: Progressive fine-tuning, vLLM deployment, and preference optimization produce a domain-specific LLM for wastewater-treatment-plant safety knowledge and professional tasks.
summary.zh: 渐进式微调、vLLM部署和偏好优化生成了一个面向污水处理厂安全知识和专业任务的领域专用LLM。

details.en: The study constructs a wastewater-treatment-plant safety dataset and partitions domain knowledge into sequential fine-tuning stages so that the LLM consolidates core safety knowledge while reducing catastrophic forgetting and cross-task conflicts. The model is deployed with vLLM and further optimized through direct preference optimization. Reported experiments show stronger adherence to safety protocols and domain understanding than conventional multi-task fine-tuning and larger general-purpose models on the evaluated tasks.
details.zh: 该研究构建了一个污水处理厂安全数据集，并将领域知识划分为连续的微调阶段，使LLM在减少灾难性遗忘和跨任务冲突的同时巩固核心安全知识。该模型通过vLLM进行部署，并通过直接偏好优化进一步优化。报告的实验表明，在所评估的任务中，与传统的多任务微调模型和更大型的通用模型相比，该模型对安全规程的遵循程度更高，领域理解能力更强。

limitations.en: The evidence concerns safety knowledge and professional task support rather than direct control of treatment processes; transfer to other plants and live operational conditions is not established in the collected evidence.
limitations.zh: 相关证据涉及安全知识和专业任务支持，而非对处理过程的直接控制；在所收集的证据中，向其他工厂和实际运行条件的迁移尚未得到证实。

papers.title: A Hybrid LLM-enhanced Water Resources Decision Chain Hypergraph Transformer for Coordinated Reservoir Group Operation

summary.en: An LLM completes implicit nodes and cross-stage relations in a decision-chain hypergraph that classifies coordinated reservoir-operation priorities with a Macro-F1 of 0.9408.
summary.zh: LLM在决策链超图中补全隐式节点和跨阶段关系，以0.9408的Macro-F1对协同水库运行优先级进行分类。

details.en: WRDC-HGT represents reservoir-group operation as a six-node decision chain spanning drivers, hydrological responses, reservoir states, demand sectors, management conflicts, and operation responses. A hybrid LLM completes implicit nodes and cross-stage relations on a rule-based chain skeleton, after which DeBERTa, graph propagation, and hypergraph propagation identify operating priorities. On a multi-source event dataset, the system achieved 0.9392 accuracy, 0.9408 Macro-F1, and 0.9624 recall for high-priority operations across flood-control, water-supply, and ecological objectives.
details.zh: WRDC-HGT将水库群运行表示为一条六节点决策链，涵盖驱动因素、水文响应、水库状态、需求部门、管理冲突和运行响应。混合LLM在基于规则的链骨架上补全隐式节点和跨阶段关系，随后由DeBERTa、图传播和超图传播识别运行优先级。在一个多源事件数据集上，该系统在防洪、供水和生态目标下实现了0.9392的准确率、0.9408的Macro-F1，以及对高优先级运行的0.9624召回率。

limitations.en: This is a preprint evaluated on event classification; it identifies operating priorities but does not demonstrate live reservoir dispatch or direct execution of gate and release decisions.
limitations.zh: 这是一篇在事件分类任务上进行评估的预印本；它能够识别运行优先级，但未展示实时水库调度或闸门和泄放决策的直接执行。

papers.title: A Blueprint for Modern Floodplain Management: System Requirements and Architecture for AI-Ready Platforms

summary.en: A U.S. floodplain-management needs assessment translates local workflow and regulatory bottlenecks into requirements for AI-ready platforms and localized RAG assistants.
summary.zh: 一项美国洪泛区管理需求评估将地方工作流程和监管瓶颈转化为对支持 AI 的平台和本地化 RAG 助手的需求。

details.en: The preprint synthesizes U.S. local ordinances, consultations with floodplain-management professionals, and community validation to identify fragmented mapping, manual documentation, regulatory complexity, communication barriers, and uneven capacity. It proposes a conceptual platform architecture with local or client-side computation, machine-readable regulatory datasets, interoperable GIS and hydrologic services, and localized RAG assistants for permit review, public inquiries, and emergency preparedness.
details.zh: 该预印本综合了美国地方条例、与洪泛区管理专业人员的磋商以及社区验证，以识别碎片化制图、手动文档编制、监管复杂性、沟通障碍和能力不均等问题。文章提出了一种概念性平台架构，包括本地或客户端计算、机器可读的监管数据集、可互操作的 GIS 和水文服务，以及用于许可审查、公众咨询和应急准备的本地化 RAG 助手。

limitations.en: The contribution is a requirements study and conceptual architecture; it does not implement or evaluate the proposed RAG assistant in a live floodplain-management workflow.
limitations.zh: 该成果是一项需求研究和概念性架构；未在实际的洪泛区管理工作流程中实施或评估所提出的 RAG 助手。

papers.title: WaterCopilot: An AI-Driven Virtual Assistant for Water Management

summary.en: WaterCopilot combines RAG with two tool-calling plugins to query Limpopo Basin documents and live hydrological services, producing referenced alerts, calculations, and visualizations.
summary.zh: WaterCopilot 将 RAG 与两个工具调用插件相结合，用于查询林波波河流域文档和实时水文服务，生成带有参考来源的警报、计算结果和可视化内容。

details.en: Developed by IWMI and Microsoft Research, WaterCopilot connects a document-search plugin to indexed policy material and an API plugin to live rainfall, reservoir, environmental-flow, water-accounting, and irrigation data for the Limpopo River Basin. It supports multilingual guided queries, automatic calculations, visual outputs, source references, and links to the basin digital twin. A RAGAS evaluation reports an overall score of 0.8043, including answer relevancy of 0.8571 and context precision of 0.8009, making this a direct example of an LLM assistant coordinating information and data services for transboundary water management.
details.zh: WaterCopilot 由 IWMI 和 Microsoft Research 开发，将文档搜索插件连接到已建立索引的政策材料，并将 API 插件连接到林波波河流域的实时降雨量、水库、生态流量、水资源核算和灌溉数据。它支持多语言引导式查询、自动计算、可视化输出、来源引用以及指向流域数字孪生体的链接。RAGAS 评估报告显示，总体得分为 0.8043，其中答案相关性为 0.8571，上下文精确率为 0.8009，这使其成为 LLM 助手协调跨界水资源管理信息和数据服务的直接示例。

limitations.en: The evaluation emphasizes RAG response quality rather than changes in forecasting skill or basin-management outcomes; the authors also report non-English document-processing and API-latency limitations.
limitations.zh: 该评估侧重于 RAG 响应质量，而非预测能力或流域管理成果的变化；作者还报告了非英语文档处理和 API 延迟方面的局限性。

papers.title: Use of ChatGPT, Claude, and DeepSeek to improve the usability and reproducibility of computational software in hydraulics
papers.venue: University of Thessaly Institutional Repository (University of Thessaly)

summary.en: A civil-engineering thesis compares ChatGPT, Claude, and DeepSeek on friction-factor and shallow-water-equation tasks, emphasizing numerical reliability, self-correction, and reproducibility.
summary.zh: 一篇土木工程学位论文比较了 ChatGPT、Claude 和 DeepSeek 在摩阻系数和浅水方程任务上的表现，强调数值可靠性、自我纠正和可复现性。

details.en: The thesis evaluates the three LLMs on Darcy-Weisbach friction-factor calculation, an analytically solvable shallow-water-equation problem, and steady two-dimensional shallow-water flow with checks on generated plots. It compares final answers, error patterns, corrective interventions, theoretical adequacy, physical consistency, and practical usability as support tools for computational hydraulics. The work is relevant as a direct test of foundational LLM capability in hydraulic computation rather than an Agent that coordinates a larger workflow.
details.zh: 该学位论文评估了三个 LLM 在 Darcy-Weisbach 摩阻系数计算、一个可解析求解的浅水方程问题，以及带有生成图检查的稳态二维浅水流方面的表现。论文比较了最终答案、误差模式、纠正干预、理论充分性、物理一致性，以及作为计算水力学支持工具的实际可用性。这项工作具有相关性，因为它直接测试了 LLM 在水力计算方面的基础能力，而不是测试协调更大工作流程的 Agent。

limitations.en: This is a Greek-language diploma thesis rather than a peer-reviewed study, and the available evidence does not establish broad benchmark coverage or transfer to production hydraulic models; its dated declaration is 11 March 2026, outside the requested search window.
limitations.zh: 这是一篇希腊语学位论文，而非同行评审研究；现有证据无法证明其涵盖广泛基准或能够迁移到生产级水力模型；其日期声明为 2026 年 3 月 11 日，超出所要求的检索时间范围。

papers.title: TransResAI: A Compound AI System for Coastal Transportation Resilience

summary.en: TransResAI combines a local LLM, RAG, secure code generation, geospatial analysis, and flood-scenario data to accelerate coastal transportation-resilience analysis.
summary.zh: TransResAI结合本地LLM、RAG、安全代码生成、地理空间分析和洪水情景数据，以加快沿海交通韧性分析。

details.en: The compound AI system decomposes natural-language requests, generates and executes constrained analysis code, retrieves regional documents, analyzes MATSim flood scenarios and OpenStreetMap-derived flood-risk networks, incorporates equity indicators, and renders interactive maps for Hampton Roads, Virginia. In a structured domain-expert study, it reduced analytical and visualization task time by 80–88%, maintained mean accuracy of 4.60 out of 5, and achieved task-completion rates above 94%. The contribution is a tested interface between LLM orchestration and quantitative coastal-flood infrastructure analysis rather than a standalone chatbot.
details.zh: 该复合AI系统分解自然语言请求，生成并执行受约束的分析代码，检索区域文档，分析MATSim洪水情景和基于OpenStreetMap生成的洪水风险网络，纳入公平性指标，并为弗吉尼亚州汉普顿路地区渲染交互式地图。在一项结构化领域专家研究中，该系统将分析和可视化任务时间减少了80–88%，保持了4.60（满分5分）的平均准确率，并实现了超过94%的任务完成率。其贡献在于构建并测试了LLM编排与定量沿海洪水基础设施分析之间的接口，而不是一个独立的聊天机器人。

limitations.en: Evidence comes from one coastal transportation case and a structured expert study; the system analyzes prepared flood scenarios and does not demonstrate real-time flood forecasting or control of transportation operations.
limitations.zh: 证据来自一个沿海交通案例和一项结构化专家研究；该系统分析准备好的洪水情景，但未展示实时洪水预报或对交通运营的控制。

papers.title: Sustainable Water Management Strategies
papers.venue: Sustainable Agriculture Applications Using Large Language Models

summary.en: This chapter surveys how LLMs could support water-resource decisions through text analysis, predictive-model assistance, and applications in floods, water quality, and agricultural water management.
summary.zh: 本章概述了LLMs如何通过文本分析、预测模型辅助，以及在洪水、水质和农业水资源管理中的应用来支持水资源决策。

details.en: The chapter organizes prospective and reported LLM uses across flood forecasting, water-quality monitoring, agricultural water management, predictive modelling, and decision support. It also discusses dependencies on data quality and computing resources and the need to address ethical and policy questions when linking LLMs with technologies such as IoT systems. The record is useful as cross-domain conceptual context for the water sector rather than as evidence of one implemented Agent workflow.
details.zh: 本章整理了LLMs在洪水预报、水质监测、农业水资源管理、预测建模和决策支持方面的预期用途和已报道用途。还讨论了对数据质量和计算资源的依赖，以及将LLMs与IoT系统等技术相结合时需要应对的伦理和政策问题。该记录可作为水务领域的跨领域概念背景，而不是某一已实施Agent工作流的证据。

limitations.en: This is a broad review-oriented book chapter; the collected abstract does not provide a reproducible system evaluation, comparative metrics, or evidence of operational deployment.
limitations.zh: 这是一个广泛的综述型书籍章节；所收录的摘要未提供可复现的系统评估、比较指标或实际部署的证据。

papers.title: Probabilistic Seasonal Streamflow Forecasting Across California's Sierra Nevada Watersheds with Agentic AI

summary.en: An LLM agent and automated code-mutation system developed seasonal streamflow models that reduced watershed-averaged quantile forecast error by up to 29% against California Bulletin 120 forecasts.
summary.zh: 一个LLM代理和自动化代码变异系统开发了季节性河流流量模型，使流域平均分位数预报误差相较于加利福尼亚州Bulletin 120预报最多降低了29%。

details.en: The workflow uses an LLM-powered agent to discover datasets, synthesize hydrological knowledge from forecasting competitions and literature, and explore model architectures. A second LLM-powered system applies Monte Carlo Tree Search over code mutations. Their resulting adaptive ensemble combines three XGBoost quantile-regression models with physics-informed features to forecast monthly full natural flow at one- to six-month lead times for 23 Sierra Nevada watersheds. Against operational Bulletin 120 forecasts for 2021–2025, the agent-developed system reports its largest gains for early-season cumulative April–July runoff predictions.
details.zh: 该工作流使用LLM驱动的代理来发现数据集，从预报竞赛和文献中综合水文知识，并探索模型架构。第二个LLM驱动的系统在代码变异上应用蒙特卡洛树搜索。由此产生的自适应集成模型结合了三个XGBoost分位数回归模型和物理信息特征，用于预测23个Sierra Nevada流域提前一至六个月的月度完整天然流量。与2021–2025年的业务Bulletin 120预报相比，该代理开发的系统在季初累计4月至7月径流预测中报告了最大增益。

limitations.en: The preprint evaluates an agent-assisted model-development process over 23 watersheds and five forecast years; it does not demonstrate autonomous operational issuance or direct control of reservoir decisions.
limitations.zh: 该预印本评估了一个覆盖23个流域和五个预报年份的代理辅助模型开发流程；它未展示自主发布业务预报或直接控制水库决策。

papers.title: Multi-agent large language model frameworks: Unlocking new possibilities for optimizing wastewater treatment operation

summary.en: This perspective proposes tool-equipped, specialized LLM agents for wastewater-treatment decision support and uses sludge bulking to illustrate how coordinated agents could combine heterogeneous plant data with human oversight.
summary.zh: 该观点文章提出配备工具的专业化 LLM 智能体，用于废水处理决策支持，并以污泥膨胀为例说明协调的智能体如何将异构污水处理厂数据与人工监督相结合。

details.en: The paper argues that wastewater-treatment operation requires multiple specialized, tool-equipped LLM agents because a single model cannot reliably integrate the biological, chemical, physical and unstructured information involved in plant decisions. It presents a sludge-bulking case to illustrate collaborative analysis and targeted recommendations, while framing process-control benefits as prospective rather than a validated autonomous deployment. It explicitly identifies computational cost, decision risk, validation, interpretability and human oversight as implementation constraints.
details.zh: 该论文认为，废水处理运行需要多个配备工具的专业化 LLM 智能体，因为单个模型无法可靠地整合污水处理厂决策所涉及的生物、化学、物理和非结构化信息。论文以污泥膨胀案例说明协作分析和针对性建议，同时将过程控制收益界定为预期收益，而非经过验证的自主部署成果。论文明确指出，计算成本、决策风险、验证、可解释性和人工监督是实施约束。

papers.title: Mapping Water: A Brief History of GIS in Hydrology and a Path Toward AI-Native Modeling

summary.en: This hydrology review organizes AI integration into four levels, from conversational GIS assistance to agents that reason directly over spatial water data and professional models.
summary.zh: 这篇水文学综述将人工智能集成划分为四个层级，从对话式 GIS 辅助到直接对空间水数据和专业模型进行推理的智能体。

details.en: The article traces seven decades of increasing coupling between GIS and hydrological models, then proposes a four-level path toward AI-native spatial water intelligence. Near-term levels retain established GIS and simulation tools while LLM interfaces help formulate queries and invoke functions; later levels envisage agents reasoning over spatially organized observations, geofabrics, and hydrological model outputs through interoperable tool frameworks such as MCP. The review stresses that open data, maintainable software, domain understanding, and institutional capacity are prerequisites for moving from research demonstrations to operational water management.
details.zh: 文章追溯了 GIS 与水文模型逐步加强耦合的七十年历程，随后提出了迈向 AI 原生空间水智能的四级路径。近期层级保留成熟的 GIS 和模拟工具，同时由 LLM 接口帮助制定查询并调用函数；后续层级设想智能体通过 MCP 等可互操作的工具框架，对空间组织的观测数据、地理织物和水文模型输出进行推理。综述强调，开放数据、可维护的软件、领域理解和机构能力，是从研究示范走向运营水管理的先决条件。

limitations.en: The four-level framework is a conceptual synthesis rather than an empirical maturity scale, and the paper does not validate a specific LLM-agent system in operational water management.
limitations.zh: 这四级框架是一种概念性综合，而非实证成熟度量表，并且论文未在运营水管理中验证具体的 LLM-agent 系统。

papers.title: Lightweight graph retrieval-augmented generation agent for safety monitoring digital twins in small- and medium-scale hydropower projects

summary.en: A Gemma-3-4B and GraphRAG agent retrieves monitoring evidence and invokes bounded safety-monitoring digital-twin functions in a field-deployed hydropower project.
summary.zh: 一个 Gemma-3-4B 和 GraphRAG agent 在一个现场部署的水电项目中检索监测证据，并调用有界的安全监测数字孪生函数。

details.en: The assistant grounds a quantized Gemma-3-4B model in a system-function-oriented knowledge graph for a medium-scale hydropower safety-monitoring digital twin. It accepts text or speech instructions, retrieves monitoring information, controls visualizations, invokes predefined system functions, corrects speech-recognition errors, and maintains the graph incrementally. Across 500 instructions, the study reports overall F1 of 0.962 and 100% recall for system-operation tasks. Field tests report 6.5-fold faster simple operations and 4.5-fold faster complex retrieval than manual interaction, with 4.8 GB peak GPU memory and mean response time of 1.5 seconds on a GTX 1060-class device.
details.zh: 该助手将量化的 Gemma-3-4B 模型置于面向系统功能的中型水电安全监测数字孪生知识图谱中。它接受文本或语音指令，检索监测信息，控制可视化，调用预定义的系统函数，纠正语音识别错误，并增量维护图谱。在 500 条指令中，该研究报告称系统操作任务的总体 F1 为 0.962，召回率为 100%。现场测试报告显示，与手动交互相比，简单操作速度提高 6.5 倍，复杂检索速度提高 4.5 倍；在 GTX 1060-class 设备上，GPU 峰值内存为 4.8 GB，平均响应时间为 1.5 秒。

limitations.en: Validation is concentrated in one medium-scale hydropower digital-twin installation and a predefined instruction space; transfer to other assets, rare safety events, and unrestricted multi-turn operation is not established.
limitations.zh: 验证集中于一个中型水电数字孪生设施和预定义的指令空间；向其他资产、罕见安全事件以及不受限的多轮操作迁移的可行性尚未得到证实。

papers.title: Large-Language-Model-Assisted Microbial Source Tracking Reveals Mechanisms of Tropical Cyclone Impacts on Microbial Water Quality in Coastal Environments

summary.en: LAMST uses Llama 3-8B to turn unstructured microbial metadata into marine, terrestrial, wastewater, or insufficient-evidence source classes for post-cyclone coastal water-quality assessment.
summary.zh: LAMST 使用 Llama 3-8B 将非结构化微生物元数据转换为海洋、陆地、废水或证据不足的来源类别，用于飓风过后沿海水质评估。

details.en: The study combines 16S rRNA sequencing with NCBI BioSample metadata and uses Llama 3-8B to classify the likely environmental origin of detected taxa. Applied at 30 Florida Gulf Coast sites after Hurricane Milton, the resulting source fractions help distinguish terrestrial and wastewater associations with enterococci and resistance genes from marine associations with Vibrio parahaemolyticus. The framework is validated on reference samples from marine, terrestrial, and wastewater environments and illustrates a substantive standalone-LLM role in converting unstructured biological records into inputs for water-quality analysis.
details.zh: 该研究将 16S rRNA 测序与 NCBI BioSample 元数据相结合，并使用 Llama 3-8B 对检测到的分类群可能的环境来源进行分类。在飓风 Milton 过后应用于佛罗里达州墨西哥湾沿岸的 30 个地点后，所得来源比例有助于区分肠球菌和耐药基因与陆地及废水的关联，以及与海洋来源的 Vibrio parahaemolyticus 的关联。该框架在来自海洋、陆地和废水环境的参考样本上得到验证，并展示了独立运行的 LLM 在将非结构化生物记录转换为水质分析输入方面的实质性作用。

limitations.en: Both collected versions are non-peer-reviewed preprints, and the method depends on uneven species-level metadata in NCBI BioSample; taxa without adequate metadata cannot be assigned a source class.
limitations.zh: 收集到的两个版本均为未经同行评审的预印本，并且该方法依赖 NCBI BioSample 中不均衡的物种级元数据；没有足够元数据的分类群无法被分配来源类别。

papers.title: Integrating Inverse Prompting and Chain-of-Thought Reasoning for Automated Flood Control Text Generation: A Case Study of the Lixiahe Region

summary.en: A DeepSeek-R1 IP-CoT pipeline extracts hydrological variables and generates constrained flood-control briefings from 1,260 Lixiahe monitoring records.
summary.zh: DeepSeek-R1 IP-CoT 流程从 1,260 条 Lixiahe 监测记录中提取水文变量，并生成受约束的防洪简报。

details.en: The method combines structured extraction of water levels, rainfall, risk levels, and flood-control measures with chain-of-thought reasoning, inverse prompting, beam search, and rule-based consistency checks. It is evaluated on 1,260 flood-control records from the Lixiahe river network covering 2010–2024. The paper reports 95.32% verification accuracy for positive emotional attributes, improved thematic fluency and diversity over baselines, and an inference time compatible with hourly or three-hour briefing cycles. The system targets preparation of operational flood-control text while retaining explicit intermediate reasoning and post-generation checks.
details.zh: 该方法将水位、降雨量、风险等级和防洪措施的结构化提取与思维链推理、逆向提示、束搜索以及基于规则的一致性检查相结合。该方法在来自 Lixiahe 河网、涵盖 2010–2024 年的 1,260 条防洪记录上进行评估。论文报告称，正向情感属性的验证准确率为 95.32%，与基线相比，主题流畅性和多样性均有所提升，且推理时间与每小时或每三小时一次的简报周期相适应。该系统旨在编制作业型防洪文本，同时保留显式的中间推理和生成后的检查。

limitations.en: Validation uses one regional document dataset and mainly linguistic and attribute-based metrics; the study does not test whether generated briefings improve real emergency decisions or remain reliable under live noisy data streams.
limitations.zh: 验证使用了一个区域性文档数据集，且主要采用语言和属性指标；该研究未测试生成的简报是否能改善实际应急决策，或在实时噪声数据流下是否仍然可靠。

papers.title: Identification of tropical cyclone–related flash floods from hazard narratives using a large language model–based approach

summary.en: A validated two-LLM pipeline extracts causal factors from U.S. hazard narratives and identifies 6,470 flash floods associated with 135 tropical cyclones.
summary.zh: 一个经过验证的双LLM流程从美国灾害叙述中提取因果因素，并识别出与135个热带气旋相关的6,470次山洪。

details.en: The study processes National Centers for Environmental Information Storm Events narratives with two LLMs and validation procedures to extract flash-flood contributing factors and classify them as tropical-cyclone-related or external weather and environmental influences. Applied to 2007–2024 records, it identifies 6,470 related flash floods across the contiguous United States and shows that events shaped mainly by cyclone processes occur closer to cyclone tracks, whereas externally influenced events extend farther beyond conventional rainfall ranges. The contribution is large-scale hydrometeorological information extraction and attribution, not real-time flood forecasting.
details.zh: 该研究使用两个LLM和验证程序处理国家环境信息中心风暴事件叙述，提取山洪影响因素，并将其分类为与热带气旋相关的因素或外部天气和环境影响。应用于2007–2024年的记录后，该研究识别出美国本土范围内6,470次相关山洪，并表明主要受气旋过程影响的事件发生位置更靠近气旋路径，而受外部因素影响的事件则延伸至超出传统降雨范围更远的区域。该研究的贡献在于大规模水文气象信息提取与归因，而非实时洪水预报。

limitations.en: The analysis is restricted to U.S. hazard narratives and inherits their reporting quality; the LLM-derived classifications support retrospective climatology and causal screening rather than operational prediction.
limitations.zh: 该分析仅限于美国灾害叙述，并继承了其报告质量；LLM衍生的分类支持回顾性气候学研究和因果筛查，而非业务化预测。

papers.title: HydroVerse Education: An AI-Assisted Education Framework for Immersive Learning and Training Environments

summary.en: HydroVerse Education places a generative-AI virtual instructor inside an immersive hydroinformatics classroom for voice-based guidance through water-system scenarios.
summary.zh: HydroVerse Education 将生成式 AI 虚拟讲师置于沉浸式水信息学课堂中，通过语音引导学习者完成水系统情景学习。

details.en: The platform combines Unreal Engine, Metahuman, virtual reality, and generative AI to provide real-time voice interaction and personalized guidance in simulated hydroinformatics learning environments. Its intended role is to help learners connect water-system theory with interactive scenarios and to lower the cost and access barriers of advanced training. This is an LLM-adjacent education and capacity-building application rather than an Agent executing hydrological models or operational water decisions.
details.zh: 该平台结合 Unreal Engine、Metahuman、虚拟现实和生成式 AI，在模拟的水信息学学习环境中提供实时语音交互和个性化指导。其预期作用是帮助学习者将水系统理论与交互式情景联系起来，并降低高级培训的成本和准入障碍。这是一种与 LLM 相关的教育和能力建设应用，而不是执行水文模型或运营水务决策的 Agent。

limitations.en: The paper primarily describes architecture and intended educational value; the abstract does not report controlled learning outcomes, comparison groups, or evidence of sustained use by water-sector training programs.
limitations.zh: 该论文主要描述了架构和预期的教育价值；摘要未报告受控学习成果、对照组或水务部门培训项目持续使用的证据。

papers.title: HydroScholar AI: A Collaborative Agent for End-to-End Automated Hydrological Research Lifecycle

summary.en: HydroScholar AI turns an approved hydrological plan into executable code, figures, and a draft manuscript while recording prompts, approvals, edits, executions, and file changes.
summary.zh: HydroScholar AI 将经批准的水文计划转换为可执行代码、图表和论文草稿，同时记录提示词、批准、编辑、执行和文件变更。

details.en: The human-in-the-loop platform integrates planning, Python generation, execution, debugging, visualization, and drafting in one auditable workspace. Its hydrology-aware prompt library covers direct access to sources such as USGS NWIS and NOAA data, hydrological conventions, and standard analyses. The demonstration analyzes five years of daily streamflow for the Iowa River at Iowa City, including annual mean flow, seven-day low flow, and peak-flow dates, and produces a baseline manuscript in a single recorded session. The provenance log preserves the human–AI decision path so generated results can be inspected and reproduced.
details.zh: 该人在回路平台将规划、Python 生成、执行、调试、可视化和撰写整合在一个可审计工作区中。其具备水文学知识的提示词库涵盖对 USGS NWIS 和 NOAA 数据等来源的直接访问、水文惯例以及标准分析。该演示分析了 Iowa City 的 Iowa River 五年的日流量数据，包括年平均流量、七日低流量和峰值流量日期，并在一次完整记录的会话中生成了一份基线论文稿件。溯源日志保留了人类–AI 决策路径，因此可以检查并复现生成的结果。

limitations.en: The evidence is an author-conducted single-station case study in a non-peer-reviewed preprint; expert review remained necessary for validation choices and hydrological interpretation.
limitations.zh: 证据来自作者开展的单站点案例研究，发表于一篇未经同行评审的预印本中；验证选择和水文解释仍需专家审查。

papers.title: Hydra-LLM: A Large Language Model Framework for Irregularly Sampled Wastewater Quality Analysis

summary.en: Hydra-LLM adapts a pretrained language-model backbone to irregularly sampled biochemical-oxygen-demand prediction using numerical, temporal, and water-process prompt information.
summary.zh: Hydra-LLM 将预训练语言模型骨干适配于利用数值、时间和水处理过程提示信息进行不规则采样的生化需氧量预测。

details.en: Hydra-LLM converts non-uniform wastewater measurements into patched numerical tokens, augments them with variable, positional, and Time2Vec encodings, and supplies prompts containing task instructions, statistics, and optional mechanistic or operational-event information. Cross-attention and four residual branches fuse the LLM, numerical, positional, and temporal representations. On 2021–2025 data from one wastewater treatment plant in Yan'an, it reports test RMSE of 10.36, MAE of 8.33, and R² of 0.6138, outperforming seven time-series baselines.
details.zh: Hydra-LLM 将非均匀废水测量值转换为分块数值标记，并通过变量、位置和 Time2Vec 编码对其进行增强，同时提供包含任务指令、统计数据以及可选机制信息或运行事件信息的提示。交叉注意力和四个残差分支融合 LLM、数值、位置和时间表示。在来自延安一座污水处理厂的 2021–2025 年数据上，其测试 RMSE 为 10.36，MAE 为 8.33，R² 为 0.6138，性能优于七种时间序列基线模型。

limitations.en: Evidence comes from a retrospective split at one treatment plant and does not test transfer to other plants, prospective drift, operator use, or closed-loop process control; the official SSRN posting date is 11 March 2026, outside the requested search window.
limitations.zh: 证据来自一座处理厂的回顾性划分，未测试向其他处理厂的迁移、前瞻性漂移、操作人员使用或闭环过程控制；官方 SSRN 发布日期为 11 March 2026，超出请求的搜索时间范围。

papers.title: GCA Framework: A GCC Countries-Grounded Dataset and Agentic Pipeline for Climate Decision Support

summary.en: Gulf Climate Agent links LLM reasoning to rainfall and flood-risk prediction, GloFAS hydrological data, remote sensing, and geospatial tools for GCC climate decisions.
summary.zh: Gulf Climate Agent 将 LLM 推理与降雨和洪水风险预测、GloFAS 水文数据、遥感及地理空间工具相结合，为 GCC 气候决策提供支持。

details.en: The GCA framework combines a roughly 200,000-pair GCC-focused multimodal dataset with a tool-augmented LLM agent. Its hydrology-relevant tool suite covers rainfall inquiry and prediction, flood-risk prediction, GloFAS forecasts and reanalysis, satellite imagery, NDWI, geospatial analysis, and interpretable flood indices and maps. The agent also uses document retrieval and RAG to combine policy evidence with structured signals. A 91-question benchmark evaluates factuality, numerical precision, tool invocation, and geospatial reasoning across open and proprietary LLMs, with the paper reporting gains from domain fine-tuning and tool integration.
details.zh: GCA 框架将一个约 200,000 对、专注于 GCC 的多模态数据集与一个工具增强型 LLM 代理相结合。其与水文学相关的工具套件涵盖降雨查询和预测、洪水风险预测、GloFAS 预报和再分析、卫星影像、NDWI、地理空间分析，以及可解释的洪水指数和地图。该代理还使用文档检索和 RAG，将政策证据与结构化信号相结合。一项包含 91 个问题的基准测试评估了不同开放和专有 LLM 的事实性、数值精度、工具调用和地理空间推理能力，论文报告了领域微调和工具集成带来的提升。

limitations.en: This is a preprint about a broad GCC climate-decision system; flood and hydrology are only part of its scope, and separate operational validation for water-management decisions is not reported.
limitations.zh: 这是一篇关于广泛 GCC 气候决策系统的预印本；洪水和水文学只是其范围的一部分，并且未报告针对水资源管理决策的独立运行验证。

papers.title: Explainable flood damage assessment using multi-atrous self-attention and vision-language integration

summary.en: A dual-stage flood-assessment pipeline couples MASA segmentation with LoRA-tuned BLIP-2 to quantify affected structures and describe disaster scenes in natural language.
summary.zh: 一种双阶段洪水评估流程将MASA分割与经LoRA调优的BLIP-2相结合，以量化受影响结构并用自然语言描述灾害场景。

details.en: The framework first segments flood-affected structures with a multi-atrous self-attention module trained on FloodNet, then uses a LoRA-adapted BLIP-2 model trained on LADI-v2 image-text pairs to generate scene descriptions. The segmentation component reports 73.78% mIoU and the language component reports an 80.77% BLEU score. It therefore contributes an interpretable interface for post-flood damage assessment by pairing spatial measurements with textual descriptions, but it is a fixed analytical pipeline rather than an autonomous water-management Agent.
details.zh: 该框架首先使用在FloodNet上训练的多空洞自注意力模块对受洪水影响的结构进行分割，然后使用在LADI-v2图像-文本对上训练的经LoRA适配的BLIP-2模型生成场景描述。分割组件报告的mIoU为73.78%，语言组件报告的BLEU分数为80.77%。因此，该框架通过将空间测量与文本描述相结合，为洪水过后损害评估提供了一个可解释的接口，但它是一个固定的分析流程，而不是自主的水资源管理Agent。

limitations.en: The quantitative and language components are evaluated on separate public datasets, and the available evidence does not establish field deployment, decision-maker validation, or performance on live flood-response data.
limitations.zh: 定量和语言组件分别在不同的公共数据集上进行评估，现有证据无法证明其已进行实地部署、获得决策者验证，或在实时洪水响应数据上的性能。

papers.title: Evaluating Hydro-Science and Engineering Knowledge of Large Language Models

summary.en: Hydro-SE Bench evaluates LLM knowledge and engineering reasoning with 4,000 questions spanning nine hydroscience and water-engineering subfields.
summary.zh: Hydro-SE Bench 通过涵盖九个水文科学和水工程子领域的4,000道问题，评估LLM的知识和工程推理能力。

details.en: The benchmark separates basic concepts, engineering application, and reasoning or calculation across nine Hydro-Science and Engineering subfields. Reported accuracy ranges from 0.74 to 0.80 for commercial models and from 0.41 to 0.68 for smaller models. Performance is stronger on natural and physical science topics and weaker on industry standards and hydraulic structures, while scaling helps reasoning and calculation more than domain-specific engineering knowledge. The dataset provides a useful capability baseline for selecting or adapting LLMs before embedding them in water-sector workflows.
details.zh: 该基准测试将九个水文科学与工程子领域的问题分为基本概念、工程应用以及推理或计算。报告显示，商业模型的准确率范围为0.74至0.80，较小模型的准确率范围为0.41至0.68。在自然科学和物理科学主题上的表现更强，在行业标准和水力结构方面的表现较弱；与领域特定的工程知识相比，扩展规模对推理和计算的帮助更大。该数据集为在将LLM嵌入水务部门工作流程之前选择或调整LLM提供了有用的能力基线。

limitations.en: Multiple-choice performance measures knowledge and constrained reasoning, not reliable tool use, model execution, report verification, or operational decision quality in real water workflows.
limitations.zh: 多项选择题的表现衡量的是知识和受约束的推理能力，而不是在真实水务工作流程中的可靠工具使用、模型执行、报告核验或运营决策质量。

papers.title: Entropy-Constrained Strategy Optimization in Urban Floods: A Multi-Agent Framework with LLM and Knowledge Graph Integration

summary.en: H-J combines hierarchical LLM agents, a knowledge graph, entropy-constrained generation, and feedback optimization to coordinate urban-flood response tasks under changing rainfall conditions.
summary.zh: H-J结合分层LLM智能体、知识图谱、熵约束生成和反馈优化，在降雨条件变化下协调城市洪涝响应任务。

details.en: H-J links multi-source perception to strategic execution through hierarchical LLM agents whose prompts are grounded by a knowledge graph. Entropy constraints are intended to reduce unstable strategy generation, while feedback updates plans as traffic, task, and risk conditions change. Evaluation on real urban topology and rainfall data under extreme, intermittent, and light-rain scenarios reports gains over rule-based and reinforcement-learning baselines in traffic smoothness, task success, and robustness.
details.zh: H-J通过分层LLM智能体将多源感知连接至战略执行，这些智能体的提示由知识图谱提供依据。熵约束旨在减少不稳定的策略生成，而反馈则在交通、任务和风险条件变化时更新计划。在极端、间歇性和小雨情景下，基于真实城市拓扑和降雨数据的评估显示，相较于基于规则和强化学习的基线方法，该方法在交通平稳性、任务成功率和鲁棒性方面均有所提升。

limitations.en: This is an arXiv preprint, and the abstract does not establish live emergency-service deployment or independent replication of the reported simulation results.
limitations.zh: 这是一篇arXiv预印本，且摘要未证明其已在实际应急服务中部署，也未证明所报告的仿真结果已得到独立复现。

papers.title: Domain-specific embedding models for hydrology and environmental sciences: enhancing semantic retrieval and question answering

summary.en: HydroEmbed fine-tunes hydrology-specific sentence embeddings for retrieval-augmented question answering and reports gains over general-purpose baselines, especially for fill-in-the-blank and open-ended tasks.
summary.zh: HydroEmbed 针对检索增强问答对水文学特定的句子嵌入进行微调，并报告了相较于通用基线的提升，尤其是在填空题和开放式任务上。

details.en: HydroEmbed provides open-source sentence-embedding models trained on the HydroLLM Benchmark for multiple-choice, true/false, fill-in-the-blank and open-ended hydrology questions. On a held-out set of 400 textbook-derived question–answer pairs, the study evaluates top-k context retrieval followed by GPT-4o-mini answer generation; domain-aligned embeddings match or exceed the tested proprietary and open-source baselines, with the clearest improvements on fill-in-the-blank and open-ended tasks. The record is retained as foundational RAG evidence rather than an autonomous workflow.
details.zh: HydroEmbed 提供了在 HydroLLM Benchmark 上训练的开源句子嵌入模型，用于选择题、判断题、填空题和开放式水文学问题。在一个包含 400 个源自教材的问题—答案对的留出集上，该研究评估了 top-k 上下文检索，随后使用 GPT-4o-mini 生成答案；与领域对齐的嵌入相比，测试的专有和开源基线表现相当或更优，其中在填空题和开放式任务上的改进最为明显。该记录作为基础性 RAG 证据保留，而非自主工作流。

papers.title: CrisiSense-RAG: Crisis Sensing Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Rapid Disaster Impact Assessment

summary.en: CrisiSense-RAG fuses temporally misaligned social reports and aerial imagery to estimate peak flood extent and damage without disaster-specific fine-tuning.
summary.zh: CrisiSense-RAG 融合时间上不一致的社会报告和航空影像，在无需针对灾害进行微调的情况下估计洪水峰值范围和损害。

details.en: CrisiSense-RAG uses hybrid dense-sparse retrieval for text, CLIP-based retrieval for imagery, and separate evidence pipelines so that real-time social reports represent peak inundation while later imagery supplies persistent structural-damage evidence. On 207 Hurricane Harvey ZIP-code queries, it reports flood-extent MAE of 10.94%–28.40% and damage-severity MAE of 16.47%–21.65% in zero-shot settings; metric-grounded prompts improve damage estimates by up to 4.75 percentage points. The work is relevant to rapid flood-impact assessment because it explicitly manages the timing mismatch between eyewitness evidence and post-event remote sensing.
details.zh: CrisiSense-RAG 对文本使用混合稠密-稀疏检索，对影像使用基于 CLIP 的检索，并采用独立的证据处理流程，使实时社会报告代表洪水淹没峰值，而后续影像提供持续性的结构损害证据。在针对 Hurricane Harvey 的 207 个 ZIP-code 查询中，该方法在零样本设置下报告的洪水范围 MAE 为 10.94%–28.40%，损害严重程度 MAE 为 16.47%–21.65%；基于指标的提示词使损害估计最多提高 4.75 个百分点。该工作与快速洪水影响评估相关，因为它明确管理了目击者证据与事件后遥感之间的时间不匹配。

limitations.en: Results are retrospective and limited to Hurricane Harvey; the study does not demonstrate prospective use within an emergency-management operation or independent replication across other flood types and regions.
limitations.zh: 结果为回顾性结果，且仅限于 Hurricane Harvey；该研究未展示其在应急管理行动中的前瞻性使用，也未在其他洪水类型和地区进行独立复现。

papers.title: Can large language models effectively reason about adverse weather conditions?

summary.en: Several language-model families were compared for classifying National Weather Service flood and adverse-weather reports, with LLaMA-3 reaching peak performance using 60% of the data.
summary.zh: 比较了多个语言模型系列对美国国家气象局洪水和恶劣天气报告进行分类的表现，其中 LLaMA-3 使用 60% 的数据达到了最佳性能。

details.en: The study applies BART, BERT, LLaMA-2, LLaMA-3, and LLaMA-3.1 to predefined categories in National Weather Service flood-report data from 2005–2024 for Charleston County, South Carolina. It examines how classification performance changes with training-data volume and reports that LLaMA-3 reached its best performance at 60% of the dataset while the other models generally required 80–100%. The work supplies foundational evidence about language-model processing of hydrological hazard narratives rather than an autonomous flood-management workflow.
details.zh: 该研究将 BART、BERT、LLaMA-2、LLaMA-3 和 LLaMA-3.1 应用于美国国家气象局 2005–2024 年南卡罗来纳州查尔斯顿县洪水报告数据中的预定义类别。研究考察了训练数据量变化对分类性能的影响，并报告称 LLaMA-3 在使用数据集 60% 的数据时达到最佳性能，而其他模型通常需要 80–100% 的数据。该工作为语言模型处理水文灾害叙述提供了基础性证据，而不是一种自主洪水管理工作流。

limitations.en: The study is limited to one county, predefined report labels, and an imbalanced event distribution; it evaluates text classification, not flood forecasting, warning issuance, or agentic tool use.
limitations.zh: 该研究仅限于一个县、预定义的报告标签以及不均衡的事件分布；它评估的是文本分类，而不是洪水预报、预警发布或智能体工具使用。

papers.title: Building an Intelligent Data Exploring Assistant for Geoscientists
papers.venue: Journal of Geophysical Research Machine Learning and Computation

summary.en: The Intelligent Data Exploring Assistant links an LLM to domain instructions, coastal water-level observations, analytical tools and computing resources; its SEA implementation performs natural-language data analysis, vertical-datum conversion, visualization and flood-risk assessment.
summary.zh: 智能数据探索助手将 LLM 与领域指令、沿海水位观测、分析工具和计算资源连接起来；其 SEA 实现可执行自然语言数据分析、垂直基准转换、可视化和洪水风险评估。

details.en: IDEA is a prototype framework for grounding an LLM in domain-specific instructions, data, tools and computing resources. Its Station Explorer Assistant implementation enables sea-level scientists to interrogate coastal water-level observations through natural-language prompts, including vertical-datum conversion and flood-risk analysis, and produces analyses and visualizations. The study also demonstrates a separate Mars deployment to test the framework’s portability while acknowledging current LLM uncertainty.
details.zh: IDEA 是一个用于将 LLM 基于领域特定指令、数据、工具和计算资源的原型框架。其 Station Explorer Assistant 实现使海平面科学家能够通过自然语言提示查询沿海水位观测数据，包括垂直基准转换和洪水风险分析，并生成分析结果和可视化内容。该研究还展示了一个独立的火星部署，以测试该框架的可移植性，同时承认当前 LLM 存在不确定性。

papers.title: Application of large language models in developing conversational agents for water quality education, communication, and operations

summary.en: The AI Hub deploys multiple ChatGPT-based conversational agents grounded in water-quality data to explain nitrogen pollution and local conditions and to support conservation planning.
summary.zh: AI Hub 部署了多个以 ChatGPT 为基础、以水质数据为依据的对话代理，用于解释氮污染和当地情况，并支持保护规划。

details.en: The published study develops a suite of water-quality conversational agents for three related tasks: explaining nitrogen pollution, answering questions about local water-quality conditions, and proposing actionable water-conservation plans. ChatGPT is combined with domain data so that users receive current, context-specific responses rather than generic model output. The authors report overall evaluation accuracy above 89%, positioning the system as an information and planning aid for communities and water stakeholders.
details.zh: 该已发表研究开发了一套水质对话代理，用于三个相关任务：解释氮污染、回答有关当地水质状况的问题，以及提出可执行的水资源保护计划。ChatGPT 与领域数据相结合，使用户获得当前且具有具体情境的回应，而不是通用的模型输出。作者报告称，整体评估准确率超过 89%，并将该系统定位为社区和水资源利益相关者的信息与规划辅助工具。

limitations.en: The collected abstract reports aggregate accuracy but does not specify the evaluation sample, scoring rubric, error distribution, or evidence of sustained use in water-utility operations.
limitations.zh: 所收集的摘要报告了总体准确率，但未具体说明评估样本、评分标准、错误分布，或在供水公用事业运营中持续使用的证据。

papers.title: An LLM-Agent and Knowledge Graph–Integrated Framework for Collaborative Optimization of Hydropower Maintenance Resources Scheduling

summary.en: An LLM Agent uses a hydropower-maintenance knowledge graph to generate resource-allocation plans and a genetic algorithm to optimize them against resource and cost constraints.
summary.zh: LLM Agent 使用水电维护知识图谱生成资源分配方案，并使用遗传算法在资源和成本约束下对其进行优化。

details.en: The framework first uses an LLM-assisted process to construct a hydropower maintenance knowledge graph and retrieves query-relevant multi-hop subgraphs for a maintenance request. A three-stage prompting process generates structured resource-allocation alternatives, after which an LLM-Agent module invokes a genetic algorithm to manage constraints and reduce cost across candidate schedules. The study reports improved allocation efficiency and represents direct workflow execution support for hydropower-equipment maintenance rather than general water-sector question answering.
details.zh: 该框架首先使用 LLM-assisted 过程构建水电维护知识图谱，并针对维护请求检索与查询相关的多跳子图。三阶段提示过程生成结构化的资源分配备选方案，随后 LLM-Agent 模块调用遗传算法管理约束，并降低候选调度方案的成本。该研究报告了分配效率的提升，并代表了对水电设备维护的直接工作流执行支持，而非一般性的水务部门问答。

limitations.en: The collected abstract does not report dataset size, numerical effect sizes, independent replication, or deployment within a live hydropower maintenance system.
limitations.zh: 所收集的摘要未报告数据集规模、数值效应量、独立复现情况，或在实际水电维护系统中的部署情况。

papers.title: AI-Augmented Water Quality Event Response: The Role of Generative Models for Decision Support

summary.en: The ACQUIRE case uses retrieval-augmented generation over drinking-water regulatory reports to recover prior incident experience and draft response plans for water-quality personnel.
summary.zh: ACQUIRE案例使用基于检索的生成方法处理饮用水监管报告，以获取以往事件经验，并为水质工作人员起草响应计划。

details.en: The article links generative AI, RAG, and agentic workflows to drinking-water quality event management, where infrequent incidents and fragmented regulatory records make institutional experience difficult to reuse. Its ACQUIRE case mines historical reports and presents prior actions, cautions, and candidate response plans through an AI assistant. The published paper reports feedback from use within a UK water-company control-room context, with particular value as a starting point for less-experienced staff, while retaining water professionals as decision makers.
details.zh: 该文章将生成式AI、RAG和智能体工作流与饮用水质量事件管理联系起来；在这一领域，事件发生频率低且监管记录分散，使机构经验难以复用。其ACQUIRE案例挖掘历史报告，并通过AI助手呈现以往措施、注意事项和候选响应计划。该论文报告了在英国一家供水公司的控制室环境中使用后的反馈，显示其对经验较少的工作人员尤其具有作为起点的价值，同时保留水务专业人员作为决策者。

limitations.en: The evidence supports retrieval and decision assistance, not autonomous incident control; the case is tied to one regulatory and organizational context and does not establish cross-utility performance.
limitations.zh: 证据支持检索和决策辅助，而非自主事件控制；该案例与单一监管和组织环境相关，未能证明跨供水企业的表现。

papers.title: A Semi-Automated Framework for Flood Ontology Construction with an Application in Risk Communication

summary.en: A human-in-the-loop process combines expert flood schemas with LLM expansion from authoritative sources to build a richer ontology for more specific public flood messages.
summary.zh: 人机协同流程将专家制定的洪水模式与基于权威来源的 LLM 扩展相结合，以构建更丰富的本体，从而生成更具体的公众洪水信息。

details.en: The framework begins with expert-defined flood concepts and relations, then uses an LLM to expand and refine the ontology from authoritative material under human review. Technical comparison indicates richer relationships and expressiveness than the disaster ontologies used as baselines. A proof of concept shows how explicit relations between flood conditions, vulnerable groups, and recommended actions can turn generic warnings into targeted advice, making the contribution relevant to flood-risk communication rather than hydraulic forecasting.
details.zh: 该框架始于专家定义的洪水概念和关系，随后在人工审查下，使用 LLM 根据权威材料扩展和完善本体。技术比较表明，与作为基线使用的灾害本体相比，该本体具有更丰富的关系和更强的表达能力。概念验证展示了洪水状况、易受影响群体和建议行动之间的明确关系如何将通用警告转化为有针对性的建议，使该贡献与洪水风险传播相关，而非水文预报。

limitations.en: The alert application is a proof of concept; the study does not report deployment in an operational warning service or evidence that personalized messages changed public response.
limitations.zh: 该预警应用是概念验证；研究未报告其在实际运行的预警服务中的部署情况，也未提供个性化信息改变公众响应的证据。

papers.title: A Novel Multimodal Large Language Model-Based Approach for Urban Flood Detection Using Open-Access Closed Circuit Television in Bandung, Indonesia

summary.en: Multimodal LLMs classify urban flooding from public CCTV images across 340 Bandung locations, providing a passive monitoring option where dedicated gauges are difficult to maintain.
summary.zh: 多模态 LLM 根据来自万隆340个地点的公共 CCTV 图像对城市洪水进行分类，为难以维护专用水位计的地区提供了一种被动监测选项。

details.en: The study prompts four multimodal language models to classify flooding directly from publicly accessible CCTV images collected across 340 Bandung locations over one year. ChatGPT-4.1 achieved the highest reported overall accuracy at 85%, with performance falling from 89% in daytime to 78% at night. The analysis also quantifies the cost of 15-minute inference and shows the operational trade-off between model accuracy and compact-model expense, making it relevant to urban-pluvial-flood detection and early-warning data acquisition.
details.zh: 该研究促使四种多模态语言模型直接根据在一年内从万隆340个地点收集的公开可访问 CCTV 图像对洪水进行分类。ChatGPT-4.1 达到报告的最高总体准确率85%，其性能从白天的89%下降到夜间的78%。分析还量化了每15分钟推理的成本，并展示了模型准确率与紧凑型模型费用之间的运营权衡，使其与城市暴雨洪水检测和预警数据采集相关。

limitations.en: The evidence comes from one city and image classification rather than water-depth estimation or flood forecasting; night-time degradation and recurring inference cost remain material constraints.
limitations.zh: 证据来自一个城市，且采用的是图像分类而非水深估计或洪水预报；夜间性能下降和持续的推理成本仍是重要限制。

papers.title: Towards HydroLLM: approaches for building a domain-specific language model for hydrology

summary.en: HydroLLM fine-tunes multiple language-model sizes on about 8,800 hydrology question-answer pairs and finds an 8B variant stronger than both smaller and larger alternatives.
summary.zh: HydroLLM 在约 8,800 个水文学问答对上对多个语言模型规模进行微调，发现 8B 变体比更小和更大的替代模型都更强。

details.en: HydroLLM constructs approximately 8,800 hydrology question-answer pairs with supporting textbook and article passages across multiple-choice, true/false, fill-in-the-blank and open-ended formats. LoRA fine-tuning compares model sizes from 1.5B to 32B parameters using accuracy and cosine-similarity metrics. The 8B DeepSeek-Llama variant performs best overall, while the 32B model overfits and the 1.5B model underperforms. The study provides domain-adaptation evidence that can underpin later hydrological Agents but does not itself implement tool use or workflow execution.
details.zh: HydroLLM 构建了约 8,800 个水文学问答对，并在选择题、判断题、填空题和开放式格式中提供配套的教材和文章段落。LoRA 微调使用准确率和余弦相似度指标，对比了参数量从 1.5B 到 32B 的模型规模。8B DeepSeek-Llama 变体整体表现最佳，而 32B 模型出现过拟合，1.5B 模型表现不佳。该研究提供了领域适配证据，可为后续水文 Agents 提供基础，但其本身未实现工具使用或工作流执行。

limitations.en: Evaluation is limited to a curated knowledge question-answer corpus; it does not measure factual reliability on live data, hydrological-model execution, decision quality or operational deployment.
limitations.zh: 评估仅限于经过整理的知识问答语料库；未测量实时数据上的事实可靠性、水文模型执行、决策质量或实际部署。

papers.title: The Implementation of Multimodal Large Language Models for Hydrological Applications: A Comparative Study of GPT-4 Vision, Gemini, LLaVa, and Multimodal-GPT

summary.en: GPT-4 Vision, Gemini, LLaVA and Multimodal-GPT are compared on hydrology images spanning flood severity, water levels, agricultural discharge and water pollution.
summary.zh: GPT-4 Vision、Gemini、LLaVA 和 Multimodal-GPT 在涵盖洪水严重程度、水位、农业排放和水污染的水文学图像上进行了比较。

details.en: The study prompts four multimodal language models to interpret hydrology-specific images and compares their generated assessments across flood management, water-level monitoring, agricultural discharge and water-pollution scenarios. GPT-4 Vision is reported as strongest for flood-severity and water-quality interpretation, while the paper also discusses possible uses in drought, streamflow, groundwater and wetland tasks. It is foundation-model perception evidence and does not implement a tool-using Agent or closed operational workflow.
details.zh: 该研究提示四种多模态语言模型解读水文学特定图像，并比较它们在洪水管理、水位监测、农业排放和水污染场景下生成的评估结果。据报道，GPT-4 Vision 在洪水严重程度和水质解读方面表现最强，而论文还讨论了其在干旱、径流、地下水和湿地任务中的可能用途。这是基础模型感知方面的证据，并未实现使用工具的 Agent 或封闭式操作工作流。

limitations.en: The public abstract does not describe a standardised dataset, sample size, blinded expert scoring or operational validation; several proposed applications are prospective rather than experimentally demonstrated.
limitations.zh: 公开摘要未描述标准化数据集、样本量、盲法专家评分或操作验证；若干拟议应用是前瞻性的，而非通过实验展示的。

papers.title: Text-Prompt-Based AI-Generated Virtual Image Augmentation for Data-Scarce Flood Detection in Urban Flood-Prone Areas

summary.en: Text-prompt-generated flood imagery improved ground-level flood classification only when anchored by enough real observations; synthetic-heavy training degraded performance.
summary.zh: 文本提示生成的洪水图像只有在由足够的真实观测数据支撑时，才改善了地面洪水分类；以合成数据为主的训练会降低性能。

details.en: The study uses OpenAI's gpt-image-1-mini-image-generation model to create text-prompt-only flood and non-flood street imagery for training augmentation, without seed or reference images. Eight ImageNet-pretrained classifiers were trained under different real-to-synthetic ratios and evaluated only on real AlleyFloodNet validation and test images. The strongest condition, EfficientNet-B2 with 30% real and 70% generated training data, reached 91.00% accuracy, 89.48% flooded-class recall and 90.79% macro-F1, while more synthetic-dominant conditions performed worse. For this project, it is evidence of a standalone GPT foundation-model capability supporting flood perception rather than an autonomous Agent workflow.
details.zh: 该研究使用 OpenAI 的 gpt-image-1-mini-image-generation 模型，仅通过文本提示生成洪水和非洪水街景图像，用于训练数据增强，不使用种子图像或参考图像。研究在不同真实数据与合成数据比例下训练了八个基于 ImageNet 预训练的分类器，并仅使用真实的 AlleyFloodNet 验证图像和测试图像进行评估。最佳条件是使用 30% 真实训练数据和 70% 生成训练数据的 EfficientNet-B2，达到了 91.00% 的准确率、89.48% 的洪水类别召回率和 90.79% 的宏平均 F1，而合成数据占主导的条件表现更差。对于本项目而言，这表明独立的 GPT 基础模型能力能够支持洪水感知，而不是一个自主 Agent 工作流。

limitations.en: The contribution is training-data augmentation rather than an Agent; results come from one ground-level flood dataset and the authors explicitly caution that generated imagery cannot replace real flood observations.
limitations.zh: 该贡献是训练数据增强，而不是 Agent；结果来自一个地面洪水数据集，且作者明确提醒，生成的图像不能替代真实洪水观测。

papers.title: Remote sensing in river obstruction research: A bibliometric analysis integrated with large language model

summary.en: LLM-based classification structures the river-obstruction remote-sensing literature with reported 88.1% precision and 86.1% recall, revealing basin and impact patterns.
summary.zh: 基于LLM的分类以报告的88.1%精确率和86.1%召回率梳理河流阻碍物遥感文献，揭示流域和影响模式。

details.en: The study combines conventional bibliometrics with an LLM classifier to analyse remote-sensing research on river obstructions. It reports average precision of 88.1% and recall of 86.1% for topic classification, identifies hydrological impacts in 39.05% and ecological impacts in 26.63% of the corpus, and maps prominent study areas including the Yangtze and Mekong basins. The contribution demonstrates LLM-assisted evidence synthesis for a substantive river-management topic rather than field sensing or operational obstruction control.
details.zh: 该研究将传统文献计量学与LLM分类器相结合，分析有关河流阻碍物的遥感研究。研究报告显示，主题分类的平均精确率为88.1%，召回率为86.1%；确定语料库中39.05%的研究涉及水文影响，26.63%的研究涉及生态影响；并绘制出包括长江和湄公河流域在内的主要研究区域。该贡献展示了LLM辅助的证据综合方法在实质性河流管理议题中的应用，而非用于现场传感或阻碍物运行控制。

limitations.en: The LLM classifies scientific literature rather than hydrological observations or operating decisions; conclusions depend on Web of Science and Scopus coverage and the study's topic-classification protocol.
limitations.zh: LLM对科学文献进行分类，而非对水文观测或运行决策进行分类；结论取决于Web of Science和Scopus的覆盖范围以及该研究的主题分类方案。

papers.title: Large language model assisted hyper-heuristic evolutionary algorithm for groundwater level prediction

summary.en: LLM-evolved mutation operators improve a hyper-heuristic search framework for groundwater-level prediction across two independent datasets.
summary.zh: LLM演化的变异算子改进了一个用于跨两个独立数据集进行地下水位预测的超启发式搜索框架。

details.en: LLMHHEA combines large-language-model-generated evolutionary operators with a hyper-heuristic search over metaheuristics and neural prediction models. A co-evolutionary design uses dynamically selected mutation types, constrained crossover and adaptive selection. Tests on two groundwater-level datasets and one temperature series selected different LLM-improved optimiser–predictor combinations for different datasets and report better prediction and generalisation than the corresponding original optimisation methods. This is standalone LLM-assisted model development, not an interactive hydrological Agent.
details.zh: LLMHHEA将大语言模型生成的进化算子与针对元启发式算法和神经预测模型的超启发式搜索相结合。一种协同进化设计使用动态选择的变异类型、受约束的交叉和自适应选择。在两个地下水位数据集和一个温度序列上的测试为不同数据集选择了不同的LLM改进的优化器–预测器组合，并报告了相比相应原始优化方法更好的预测和泛化性能。这是独立的LLM辅助模型开发，而不是交互式水文Agent。

limitations.en: The LLM contributes evolutionary operators rather than executing a water-management workflow; the public abstract does not establish operational use or decision impact beyond the evaluated time-series datasets.
limitations.zh: LLM提供的是进化算子，而不是执行水资源管理工作流；公开摘要未证明其在所评估时间序列数据集之外的实际应用或决策影响。

papers.title: Integrating large language models (LLMs) in climate-smart water management: Future approaches and innovations
papers.venue: Advances in Chemical Pollution, Environmental Management and Protection

details.en: Climate change, urbanization, and population growth pose significant challenges to water management, necessitating more adaptive and sustainable approaches. This article explores the possibilities of integrating Large Language Models (LLMs) into climate-smart water management to improve decision-making, predictive modeling, data analysis, and stakeholder engagement. Conventional water management systems rely heavily on historical data and centralized decision-making and are generally becoming increasingly inadequate to address the complexities of climate variability, including extreme weather events. Evidence limitation: No abstract or detailed description was available from the collected official metadata, so the chapter should not support specific capability, performance or deployment claims until the full text is reviewed.
details.zh: 气候变化、城市化和人口增长对水资源管理构成重大挑战，因此需要采取更具适应性和可持续性的方法。本文探讨将大型语言模型（LLMs）融入气候智能型水资源管理的可能性，以改进决策、预测建模、数据分析和利益相关者参与。传统水资源管理系统高度依赖历史数据和集中式决策，并且通常越来越无法应对气候变率的复杂性，包括极端天气事件。证据局限：所收集的官方元数据中没有摘要或详细描述，因此在审阅全文之前，本章不应支持关于具体能力、性能或部署的主张。

limitations.en: No abstract or detailed description was available from the collected official metadata, so the chapter should not support specific capability, performance or deployment claims until the full text is reviewed.
limitations.zh: 所收集的官方元数据中没有摘要或详细描述，因此在审阅全文之前，本章不应支持关于具体能力、性能或部署的主张。

papers.title: Global flood research patterns, disparities, and risk–attention mismatches revealed by large language models

summary.en: Qwen-2.5-32B-Instruct structures a 64,989-paper flood corpus to expose thematic and geographic research disparities, including high-risk regions that remain underrepresented.
summary.zh: Qwen-2.5-32B-Instruct 对一个包含 64,989 篇论文的洪水语料库进行结构化处理，揭示主题和地理研究差异，包括仍未得到充分代表的高风险地区。

details.en: This study uses Qwen-2.5-32B-Instruct with chain-of-thought prompts to semantically filter flood abstracts and extract study locations, flood types and Integrated Flood Management categories from 64,989 publications. Manual validation of 500 stratified abstracts reported 94.4% accuracy for study-area identification and 87.8% for flood-type classification. The resulting global analysis finds that research attention is more closely associated with socioeconomic capacity than flood risk, with 53.1% of countries showing a risk-attention mismatch and high-risk regions in Africa and South America remaining underrepresented. It is useful as evidence for LLM-assisted hydrological knowledge synthesis and classification, not as an operational flood-management Agent.
