details.zh: 本研究使用带有思维链提示的 Qwen-2.5-32B-Instruct，对洪水摘要进行语义筛选，并从 64,989 篇出版物中提取研究地点、洪水类型和 Integrated Flood Management 类别。对 500 篇分层摘要进行的人工验证显示，研究区域识别准确率为 94.4%，洪水类型分类准确率为 87.8%。由此得到的全球分析发现，研究关注度与社会经济能力的关联比其与洪水风险的关联更密切，53.1% 的国家表现出风险—关注度不匹配，非洲和南美洲的高风险地区仍未得到充分代表。这项研究可作为 LLM 辅助水文知识综合和分类的证据，但不能作为实际运行的洪水管理 Agent。

limitations.en: The LLM performs literature screening and classification rather than hydrological forecasting or system operation; findings depend on OpenAlex/Web of Science coverage, abstract-level extraction and a 500-record validation sample.
limitations.zh: LLM 执行的是文献筛选和分类，而非水文预测或系统运行；研究结果取决于 OpenAlex/Web of Science 的覆盖范围、摘要层面的提取以及 500 条记录的验证样本。

papers.title: Enhancing Large Language Model Performance in Hydrology and Water Resources through Retrieval-Augmented Domain Knowledge

summary.en: A hydrology-adapted LightRAG service improves question-answer performance while reducing indexing and inference cost relative to general and graph-based retrieval baselines.
summary.zh: 一种适配水文学的LightRAG服务在降低索引和推理成本的同时，相较于通用检索和基于图的检索基线提升了问答性能。

details.en: The study adapts LightRAG for hydrology and water-resources knowledge services using hybrid two-level chunking, domain prompts and a graph schema over textbooks, papers and standards. More than 500 question-answer pairs support comparative and ablation experiments. With GLM-4-Plus, the reported composite score rises from 0.609 to 0.811; relative to GraphRAG, token use falls by 82.2% during indexing and 70.0% during inference, while response time falls from 17 to 5 seconds. The contribution is domain knowledge and cognition support rather than autonomous hydrological execution.
details.zh: 该研究通过混合双层分块、领域提示词以及覆盖教材、论文和标准的图模式，将LightRAG适配用于水文学和水资源知识服务。超过500个问答对支持对比实验和消融实验。使用GLM-4-Plus时，报告的综合得分从0.609升至0.811；相较于GraphRAG，索引期间的令牌使用量减少82.2%，推理期间减少70.0%，同时响应时间从17秒降至5秒。其贡献在于领域知识和认知支持，而非自主执行水文任务。

limitations.en: This is an SSRN preprint focused on education-oriented knowledge service; the benchmark does not test live data, model execution, operational decision quality or field deployment.
limitations.zh: 这是一篇聚焦教育导向知识服务的SSRN预印本；该基准不测试实时数据、模型执行、运营决策质量或现场部署。

papers.title: Engineering AI-Assisted Client-Side Scientific Workflows: WebGPU Inference Architecture and Framework for Privacy-Preserving Hydrological Analysis

summary.en: Hydro AI Lab runs hydrological analysis and a locally hosted LLM assistant entirely in the browser, prioritising privacy and low-infrastructure deployment.
summary.zh: Hydro AI Lab 在浏览器中完全运行水文分析和本地托管的 LLM 助手，优先考虑隐私和低基础设施部署。

details.en: Hydro AI Lab combines a user interface, a framework-free deep-learning engine, geospatial visualisation and a WebGPU-powered browser LLM assistant for client-side hydrological analysis. Structured context injection places analytical results directly into LLM interactions, while benchmarks report 21–95 tokens per second across model sizes on commodity hardware. The contribution demonstrates local, privacy-preserving interpretation within an end-to-end analysis environment; it does not establish autonomous model configuration or operational decision authority.
details.zh: Hydro AI Lab 将用户界面、无框架深度学习引擎、地理空间可视化和由 WebGPU 驱动的浏览器 LLM 助手相结合，用于客户端水文分析。结构化上下文注入将分析结果直接置于 LLM 交互中，同时基准测试报告显示，在普通硬件上，不同模型规模的速度为每秒 21–95 tokens。该贡献展示了端到端分析环境中的本地、隐私保护型解读；但未确立自主模型配置或运营决策权限。

limitations.en: The source is an EarthArXiv preprint, performance evidence focuses on browser inference rather than hydrological decision quality, and the design is not evaluated in a production water agency.
limitations.zh: 该来源是 EarthArXiv 预印本，性能证据侧重于浏览器推理而非水文决策质量，并且该设计尚未在生产环境中的水务机构进行评估。

papers.title: AtmosSci-Bench: Evaluating the Recent Advance of Large Language Model for Atmospheric Science

summary.en: AtmosSci-Bench tests several LLM families on graduate-level atmospheric-science reasoning, including hydrology as one of five subject categories.
summary.zh: AtmosSci-Bench 测试多个 LLM 系列在研究生水平大气科学推理方面的表现，其中水文学是五个学科类别之一。

details.en: AtmosSci-Bench combines template-generated multiple-choice questions with open-ended problems across hydrology, atmospheric dynamics, atmospheric physics, geophysics and physical oceanography. It evaluates instruction-tuned, reasoning, math-augmented and domain-specific climate models to expose differences in scientific reasoning. The benchmark is retained as adjacent foundational evidence for evaluating hydrological knowledge, not as evidence of an Agent or water-management application.
details.zh: AtmosSci-Bench 结合了模板生成的选择题和涵盖水文学、大气动力学、大气物理学、地球物理学及物理海洋学的开放式问题。它评估经过指令调优的、推理型的、数学增强的以及特定领域的气候模型，以揭示科学推理方面的差异。该基准被保留为评估水文知识的相邻基础证据，而不是 Agent 或水资源管理应用的证据。

limitations.en: Hydrology is only one of five benchmark categories, and the tasks assess academic reasoning rather than observation handling, model execution, operational decisions or field outcomes.
limitations.zh: 水文学只是五个基准类别之一，这些任务评估的是学术推理，而不是观测处理、模型执行、运行决策或现场结果。

papers.title: Application of Large Language Models to Predict Enteric Viruses Removal Using Surrogate Indicators

summary.en: CALM-VR applies large language models to enteric-virus removal prediction in wastewater, while leave-one-location-out validation exposes weaker cross-facility transferability.
summary.zh: CALM-VR 将大型语言模型应用于污水中肠道病毒去除预测，而留一地点法验证揭示了较弱的跨设施迁移能力。

details.en: The Environmental Science & Technology study applies large language models to predict enteric-virus removal from surrogate indicators under data-scarce wastewater-surveillance conditions. The available abstract fragment reports a reproducible, quality-controlled CALM-VR framework and explicitly notes reduced performance when validation holds out an entire facility. It is retained as standalone LLM evidence for water-quality prediction, not as an Agent workflow.
details.zh: 这项发表于 Environmental Science & Technology 的研究应用大型语言模型，根据替代指标预测数据稀缺的污水监测条件下的肠道病毒去除情况。现有的摘要片段报告了一个可复现且经过质量控制的 CALM-VR 框架，并明确指出，当验证集留出整个设施时，性能会下降。该研究作为水质预测的独立 LLM 证据保留，而不是作为 Agent 工作流。

limitations.en: The publisher article is closed access and the collected metadata contains only the closing portion of the abstract, so detailed model architecture and performance figures should be checked against the full paper before use in a quantitative claim.
limitations.zh: 该出版商的文章为非开放获取，所收集的元数据仅包含摘要的结尾部分，因此在用于定量论断之前，应根据完整论文核查详细的模型架构和性能数据。

papers.title: Agentic Modelling Pipeline: Reproducible Rapid Stormwater Modelling Management System with OpenClaw

summary.en: Agentic SWMM uses skills and MCP to turn natural-language requests into auditable stormwater-model configuration, execution, diagnostics and plots.
summary.zh: Agentic SWMM 使用技能和 MCP 将自然语言请求转化为可审计的雨洪模型配置、执行、诊断和绘图。

details.en: The preprint defines an Agentic SWMM workflow that automates model configuration, command-line execution, result extraction and plotting through reusable skills and Model Context Protocol services. Each run writes a manifest containing the SWMM version, parameter mappings, input hashes and quality gates such as continuity diagnostics. A Tod Creek case verifies equivalence between MCP-triggered and conventional command-line or GUI execution, including identical peak results. This is direct evidence of tool-grounded workflow execution with reproducibility controls.
details.zh: 该预印本定义了一个 Agentic SWMM 工作流，通过可复用的技能和模型上下文协议服务，自动完成模型配置、命令行执行、结果提取和绘图。每次运行都会写入一个清单，其中包含 SWMM 版本、参数映射、输入哈希值以及连续性诊断等质量门槛。Tod Creek 案例验证了 MCP 触发的执行与传统命令行或 GUI 执行之间的等效性，包括峰值结果一致。这是关于基于工具的工作流执行以及可复现性控制的直接证据。

limitations.en: The work is an EarthArXiv preprint evaluated on one watershed and demonstrates execution equivalence rather than improved forecast skill, operational reliability or authorised control of drainage infrastructure.
limitations.zh: 该工作是一篇 EarthArXiv 预印本，仅在一个流域上进行了评估，展示的是执行等效性，而非预测技能、运行可靠性或对排水基础设施的授权控制有所改进。

papers.title: AI-Assisted Voice Enabled Computing Framework for Hydrological Analysis

summary.en: A voice- and text-driven LLM interface retrieves federal hydrological data, invokes HydroSuite functions and manages multi-turn analytical maps over the Mississippi River Delta.
summary.zh: 一个由语音和文本驱动的 LLM 界面，可检索联邦水文数据、调用 HydroSuite 函数，并管理围绕密西西比河三角洲的多轮分析地图。

details.en: The web platform converts spoken or typed requests into structured intents, retrieves hydrological data through HydroShare and federal services, invokes modular HydroSuite analysis functions, and controls visual map layers while maintaining session state. A Mississippi River Delta case demonstrates guided, multi-source exploration and low-latency execution in a no-code interface. This is evidence of an LLM-mediated hydrological workflow with data and tool grounding, although it stops short of autonomous operational decisions.
details.zh: 该 Web 平台将语音或文字请求转换为结构化意图，通过 HydroShare 和联邦服务检索水文数据，调用模块化 HydroSuite 分析函数，并在保持会话状态的同时控制可视化地图图层。密西西比河三角洲案例展示了在无代码界面中的引导式、多源探索和低延迟执行。这证明了一个具有数据和工具支撑的 LLM 介导水文工作流，但尚未达到自主运行决策。

limitations.en: The source is an EarthArXiv preprint with one demonstration region; the abstract reports usability and latency qualitatively but no comparative task-success, scientific-validity or production-reliability evaluation.
limitations.zh: 该来源是一篇 EarthArXiv 预印本，仅包含一个示范区域；摘要对可用性和延迟进行了定性报告，但没有对任务成功率、科学有效性或生产可靠性进行比较评估。

papers.title: Towards domain-adapted large language models for water and wastewater management: methods, datasets and benchmarking

summary.en: This Perspective lays out prompt, knowledge/tool augmentation, fine-tuning, dataset, and benchmark requirements for reliable water-domain LLMs.
summary.zh: 本文观点阐述了实现可靠的水领域 LLM 所需的提示、知识/工具增强、微调、数据集和基准测试要求。

details.en: This Perspective proposes a roadmap for domain-adapted large language models in water and wastewater management, covering prompt engineering, knowledge and tool augmentation, fine-tuning, domain datasets and benchmarks. It introduces WaterGPT as a concept for bringing water-domain knowledge and operational context into general-purpose language models while identifying evaluation and deployment requirements.
details.zh: 本文观点提出了水与废水管理领域适配大型语言模型的路线图，涵盖提示工程、知识和工具增强、微调、领域数据集和基准测试。文中提出 WaterGPT 这一概念，旨在将水领域知识和运营背景引入通用语言模型，同时确定评估和部署要求。

limitations.en: The article is a roadmap and conceptual wastewater-treatment example rather than an implemented, independently evaluated operational system.
limitations.zh: 本文是一份路线图，并以概念性的废水处理示例为主，而非一个已实施并经过独立评估的运营系统。

papers.title: One Prompt to Rule Them All: Automated Curve and Image Retrieval from PDFs and Websites with Agentic Multimodal RAG
papers.venue: World Environmental and Water Resources Congress 2025

details.en: In the water industry, subject matter experts (SMEs) often manually review numerous documents and websites to find image-based information, such as chemical reaction curves and software manual screenshots for model setups. This process is time-consuming, inconsistent, and inefficient. This paper introduces a multimodal agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) tool to automate this task. Evidence limitation: The collected Crossref source lacks an abstract and no open PDF was validated; scope and summary were checked against the McMaster institutional scholarly record (https://experts.mcmaster.ca/scholarly-works/3897583) on 2026-07-22.
details.zh: 在水务行业，主题专家（SME）通常需要手动查阅大量文档和网站，以查找基于图像的信息，例如化学反应曲线和用于模型设置的软件手册截图。这一过程耗时、缺乏一致性且效率低下。本文介绍了一种多模态智能体检索增强生成（RAG）工具，用于自动化完成此任务。证据局限性：所收集的 Crossref 来源缺少摘要，且未验证有开放获取的 PDF；研究范围和摘要已于 2026-07-22 根据麦克马斯特大学机构学术记录（https://experts.mcmaster.ca/scholarly-works/3897583）进行核查。

limitations.en: The collected Crossref source lacks an abstract and no open PDF was validated; scope and summary were checked against the McMaster institutional scholarly record (https://experts.mcmaster.ca/scholarly-works/3897583) on 2026-07-22.
limitations.zh: 所收集的 Crossref 来源缺少摘要，且未验证有开放获取的 PDF；研究范围和摘要已于 2026-07-22 根据麦克马斯特大学机构学术记录（https://experts.mcmaster.ca/scholarly-works/3897583）进行核查。

papers.title: Improving LLM-Assisted Hydropower Operation Through Data Query Enhanced Agent

summary.en: A Dadu River benchmark shows that context engineering raises an LLM hydropower agent's data-acquisition success from 52.9% to 81.3% and end-to-end success from 4.3% to 46%.
summary.zh: 大渡河基准测试表明，上下文工程使LLM水电智能体的数据获取成功率从52.9%提高到81.3%，端到端成功率从4.3%提高到46%。

details.en: The study develops and evaluates an LLM-based agent for hydropower generation scheduling, reservoir water-level control and operational-data analysis in the Dadu River Basin. A 300-task, four-stage evaluation covers task recognition, data querying, tool calling and result integration. Context engineering and a data-reference checklist raise data-acquisition success from 52.9% to 81.3% and end-to-end success from 4.3% to 46%.
details.zh: 该研究开发并评估了一个基于LLM的智能体，用于大渡河流域的水电发电调度、水库水位控制和运行数据分析。一项包含300个任务的四阶段评估涵盖任务识别、数据查询、工具调用和结果整合。上下文工程和数据参考清单使数据获取成功率从52.9%提高到81.3%，端到端成功率从4.3%提高到46%。

limitations.en: The evaluation uses 300 generated tasks from one basin, and the improved 46% end-to-end success rate remains insufficient for autonomous high-stakes operation.
limitations.zh: 该评估使用了来自一个流域的300个生成任务，而改进后的46%端到端成功率对于自主开展高风险运行仍然不足。

papers.title: HydroBlox: AI-assisted visual programming framework for enhanced scientific reproducibility in hydrology

summary.en: HydroBlox adds an optional external-LLM assistant with active-workflow context and session memory to a browser-based visual hydrology workflow platform.
summary.zh: HydroBlox 为基于浏览器的可视化水文工作流平台增加了一个可选的外部 LLM 助手，该助手具有活动工作流上下文和会话记忆。

details.en: HydroBlox is a client-side browser framework for constructing, executing and exporting hydrologic workflows through visual programming. It integrates data retrieval, analysis and visualization blocks and includes an optional assistant that can use external large language models with active-workflow context and session memory to guide workflow construction. Case studies cover precipitation-streamflow analysis and drought-index computation.
details.zh: HydroBlox 是一个客户端浏览器框架，用于通过可视化编程构建、执行和导出水文工作流。它集成了数据检索、分析和可视化模块，并包含一个可选助手，该助手可以利用具有活动工作流上下文和会话记忆的外部大型语言模型来指导工作流构建。案例研究涵盖降水—径流分析和干旱指数计算。

limitations.en: The LLM assistant is described in the full text rather than the abstract; the registered PDF is the EarthArXiv preprint, and the case studies evaluate workflow reproducibility rather than the assistant itself.
limitations.zh: LLM 助手在全文中进行了描述，而不是摘要中；登记的 PDF 是 EarthArXiv 预印本，案例研究评估的是工作流的可复现性，而不是助手本身。

papers.title: AQUAH: Automatic Quantification and Unified Agent in Hydrology
papers.venue: 2025 IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision Workshops (ICCVW)

summary.en: AQUAH uses LLM/VLM reasoning to turn natural-language basin requests into data retrieval, hydrologic-model execution, visualization, and a self-contained report.
summary.zh: AQUAH 使用 LLM/VLM 推理，将自然语言流域请求转化为数据检索、水文模型执行、可视化和一份自包含报告。

details.en: AQUAH is an end-to-end language-based hydrologic modeling agent that accepts natural-language requests, retrieves terrain, forcing and gauge data, configures and runs hydrologic models, and produces a PDF report. The system combines large language and vision-language models, and is evaluated on U.S. basin cases as an early demonstration that still requires broader calibration and validation.
details.zh: AQUAH 是一种端到端的基于语言的水文建模智能体，可接受自然语言请求，检索地形、强迫和测站数据，配置并运行水文模型，并生成 PDF 报告。该系统结合了大型语言模型和视觉语言模型，并在美国流域案例上进行了评估，作为一项早期演示，但仍需要更广泛的校准和验证。

limitations.en: The evidence is an initial U.S.-basin demonstration; operational calibration and validation remain incomplete, and the reported expert assessment is qualitative rather than a comparative field benchmark.
limitations.zh: 证据来自一项初步的美国流域演示；运行校准和验证仍不完整，且所报告的专家评估是定性的，而不是比较性的现场基准。

papers.title: HydroAgent: Formalizing Forecaster Expertise into Skill-Orchestrated Flood Forecasting Workflows

summary.en: HydroAgent formalizes tacit flood-forecaster expertise as explicit LLM-executable skills that constrain prior judgment and hydrological scheme selection within an auditable forecasting workflow.
summary.zh: HydroAgent 将洪水预报员的隐性专业知识形式化为可由 LLM 执行的显式技能，在可审计的预报工作流中约束先验判断和水文方案选择。

details.en: This preprint presents HydroAgent, a skill-orchestrated LLM agent embedded in a physically based flood-forecasting workflow. Explicit skills formalize forecaster rules and checkpoints for estimating plausible peak-flow and flood-volume ranges, selecting and adjusting parameter schemes, running the hydrological model, and retaining human review before warnings. Evaluation in the South Yamhill River basin uses 129 historical events for five-fold validation and 14 held-out events; prior judgments captured observed peak and volume within 5% tolerance for 10 and 11 events, while guided scheme selection improved KGE by 0.023-0.154 over an already strong scheme library. Five state-of-the-art LLMs completed the workflow with comparable judgment accuracy but different costs, supporting the paper's main contribution: converting tacit expertise into reproducible, bounded agent skills rather than replacing forecasters or physical models.
details.zh: 这篇预印本介绍了 HydroAgent，这是一个嵌入基于物理的洪水预报工作流中的技能编排型 LLM 智能体。显式技能将预报员用于估计合理峰值流量和洪水量范围、选择和调整参数方案、运行水文模型以及在发布预警前保留人工复核的规则和检查点形式化。在 South Yamhill River basin 的评估中，使用 129 个历史事件进行五折验证，并使用 14 个留出事件；先验判断在 5% 容差内捕捉到了 10 个事件的观测峰值和 11 个事件的观测洪水量，而引导式方案选择相较于已经较强的方案库使 KGE 提高了 0.023-0.154。五个最先进的 LLM 以相近的判断准确率但不同的成本完成了该工作流，支持论文的主要贡献：将隐性专业知识转化为可复现且受约束的智能体技能，而不是取代预报员或物理模型。

limitations.en: This is an arXiv v1 preprint rather than a peer-reviewed article; evaluation is limited to one basin and the linked Zenodo DOI identifies companion research data rather than the paper.
limitations.zh: 这是一篇 arXiv v1 预印本，而非经过同行评审的文章；评估仅限于一个流域，并且相关 Zenodo DOI 指向的是配套研究数据，而不是论文。

papers.title: Making waves: A conceptual framework exploring how large language model-based multi-agent systems could reshape water engineering

papers.title: Toward HydroLLM: a benchmark dataset for hydrology-specific knowledge assessment for large language models

summary.en: HydroLLM-Benchmark evaluates GPT-4o-mini and Llama 3 variants on hydrology-specific questions, providing enabling evidence about domain knowledge rather than an autonomous agent workflow.
summary.zh: HydroLLM-Benchmark 评估 GPT-4o-mini 和 Llama 3 变体在水文学特定问题上的表现，为领域知识提供支持性证据，而非自主智能体工作流。

details.en: This paper constructs a hydrology-specific benchmark from research articles and textbooks, with true/false, multiple-choice, open-ended, and fill-in-the-blank questions. It evaluates GPT-4o-mini, Llama3:8B, and Llama3.1:70B using accuracy for objective questions and cosine similarity for subjective responses, documenting both capabilities and limitations of LLM hydrological knowledge. The resource is relevant as an evaluation foundation for HydroAgent systems, but it does not implement tool use, planning, or autonomous model execution.
details.zh: 本文基于研究论文和教材构建了一个水文学特定基准，包含判断题、选择题、开放式问题和填空题。研究使用客观题准确率和主观回答余弦相似度评估 GPT-4o-mini、Llama3:8B 和 Llama3.1:70B，记录 LLM 水文学知识的能力与局限性。该资源可作为 HydroAgent 系统的评估基础，但未实现工具使用、规划或模型自主执行。

limitations.en: This is a benchmark of LLM hydrology knowledge and does not implement an AI agent, tool-use loop, or autonomous hydrological workflow.
limitations.zh: 这是一个关于 LLM 水文学知识的基准，未实现 AI 智能体、工具使用循环或自主水文工作流。

papers.title: GenAI models for urban water systems: Opportunities, challenges and future directions

details.en: Generative artificial intelligence (AI), particularly large language models, offers transformative potential for the management and operation of urban water systems. As water utilities face increasing pressures from climate change, ageing infrastructure and population growth, AI-driven tools provide new opportunities for real-time monitoring, predictive maintenance and enhanced decision support. This article explores how generative AI can revolutionise the water industry by enabling more efficient operations, improved customer engagement and advanced training mechanisms.
details.zh: 生成式人工智能（AI），尤其是大型语言模型，为城市水系统的管理和运行提供了变革性潜力。随着水务部门面临气候变化、基础设施老化和人口增长带来的日益加剧的压力，AI驱动的工具为实时监测、预测性维护和增强决策支持提供了新的机会。本文探讨了生成式AI如何通过实现更高效的运营、改善客户参与度和先进的培训机制，推动水务行业变革。

papers.title: Assessing the spatial accuracy of geocoding flood-related imagery using Vision Language Models

summary.en: This study benchmarks GPT-4o and three open vision-language models for geocoding flood-related social-media imagery, exposing substantial accuracy and geographic-bias limitations.
summary.zh: 本研究对 GPT-4o 和三个开放式视觉语言模型进行基准测试，用于对与洪水相关的社交媒体图像进行地理编码，揭示了显著的准确性和地理偏差局限性。

details.en: The study evaluates BLIP-2, LLaVA1.6, OpenFlamingo, and GPT-4o on location inference from flood-related Flickr images and compares inferred locations with original coordinates and human labels. GPT-4o provides the strongest spatial accuracy and country/continent identification, while OpenFlamingo geocodes the largest share of images; all models retain large errors and geographically uneven performance. The work demonstrates a concrete language-model application to flood-observation data and quantifies where such models remain unreliable.
details.zh: 该研究使用与洪水相关的 Flickr 图像，评估 BLIP-2、LLaVA1.6、OpenFlamingo 和 GPT-4o 的位置推断能力，并将推断位置与原始坐标和人工标签进行比较。GPT-4o 在空间准确性以及国家/洲识别方面表现最强，而 OpenFlamingo 对最大比例的图像进行了地理编码；所有模型仍存在较大误差，且性能在地理上不均衡。该工作展示了语言模型在洪水观测数据中的一项具体应用，并量化了此类模型仍不可靠的方面。

limitations.en: This is a vision-language-model benchmark for flood imagery, not an autonomous Agent, hydrological forecast, or operational flood-management deployment.
limitations.zh: 这是一项针对洪水图像的视觉语言模型基准测试，而不是自主 Agent、水文预报或运营性洪水管理部署。

papers.title: A Comprehensive Bibliometric Analysis of Large Language Models in Hydrology and Environmental Sciences

summary.en: This bibliometric study maps 2018–2024 LLM adoption in hydrology and environmental science, including application domains, collaboration patterns, and governance concerns.
summary.zh: 这项文献计量研究梳理了2018–2024年LLM在水文学和环境科学中的采用情况，包括应用领域、合作模式和治理问题。

details.en: The study analyzes publication and citation trends, contributors, affiliations, countries, research types, domains, and keywords across LLM-related hydrology and environmental-science literature. It also classifies use cases and discusses cost, scalability, privacy, transparency, sustainability, and other adoption constraints. The result supplies landscape evidence for where conversational AI is being applied, rather than evidence of a single Agent system, and helps identify gaps for future research and policy.
details.zh: 该研究分析了与LLM相关的水文学和环境科学文献中的出版和引用趋势、贡献者、所属机构、国家、研究类型、领域和关键词。研究还对使用案例进行分类，并讨论成本、可扩展性、隐私、透明度、可持续性和其他采用限制。该结果为对话式AI应用的领域提供了全景证据，而不是单一Agent系统的证据，并有助于确定未来研究和政策方面的空白。

limitations.en: The collected record is the February 2025 preprint and provides bibliometric landscape evidence rather than an operational Agent evaluation; the work later appeared as DOI 10.1016/j.infgeo.2025.100030.
limitations.zh: 所收集的记录为2025年2月的预印本，提供的是文献计量学全景证据，而非运行中的Agent评估；该研究后来以DOI 10.1016/j.infgeo.2025.100030发表。

papers.title: WDS-Modality: A Physics-Informed Multi-Modal Agent Framework for Resilient Water Distribution System Assessment Using Large Language Models without Fine-tuning

summary.en: WDS-Modality couples topology-aware knowledge representation, hydraulic simulation, physics verification, and multi-objective optimization in a multi-agent workflow that achieved 85.71% diagnostic success with zero reported physics violations across five benchmark networks.
summary.zh: WDS-Modality在多智能体工作流中结合了拓扑感知知识表示、水力模拟、物理验证和多目标优化，在五个基准网络上实现了85.71%的诊断成功率，且报告的物理违规次数为零。

details.en: WDS-Modality addresses the accessibility and physical-consistency limitations of water-distribution resilience assessment by coordinating LLM reasoning with hydraulic simulation rather than fine-tuning a domain model. Its multi-agent workflow combines queryable topology and hydraulic-state representations, a physics-informed verification mechanism, and multi-objective optimization for district-metered-area partitioning and boundary-valve decisions. Across five benchmark networks, the framework generated feasible configurations spanning different partition and closure scales, reduced flow entropy in most cases, and balanced hydraulic, mechanical, and energy-based resilience objectives. The reported 85.71% overall diagnostic success rate, 97.50% performance on partitioning and visualization tasks, and absence of physics violations position the work as core evidence for tool-grounded, verifiable water-system agents.
details.zh: WDS-Modality通过协调LLM推理与水力模拟，而非对领域模型进行微调，解决了供水系统韧性评估在可及性和物理一致性方面的局限。其多智能体工作流结合了可查询的拓扑和水力状态表示、物理信息验证机制，以及用于分区计量区域划分和边界阀决策的多目标优化。在五个基准网络中，该框架生成了涵盖不同分区和关闭规模的可行配置，在大多数情况下减少了流量熵，并平衡了基于水力、机械和能量的韧性目标。报告的85.71%总体诊断成功率、97.50%的分区和可视化任务性能，以及不存在物理违规，使该工作成为工具支撑且可验证的供水系统智能体的核心证据。

limitations.en: The publisher abstract and metadata were available, but the full text is access-restricted and the reported benchmark results have not been independently replicated in an operational utility setting.
limitations.zh: 出版商摘要和元数据可获取，但全文受访问限制，且报告的基准结果尚未在实际运行的公用事业环境中得到独立复现。

papers.title: Review article: Global flood research across four decades: An analysis of 57,474 research articles based on a large language model

summary.en: An LLM-assisted review of 57,474 flood studies reconstructs four decades of thematic and geographic change, providing adjacent evidence for hydrological knowledge synthesis rather than an operational water agent.
summary.zh: 一项借助LLM对57,474项洪水研究开展的综述重构了四十年来主题和地理变化的脉络，为水文学知识综合提供了相关证据，而非一个可操作的水务代理。

details.en: This review uses a large language model to screen and organize 57,474 flood publications from 1985 to 2024, then maps publication growth, collaboration, disciplinary influence, topics, and geographic concentration. It reports that annual output now exceeds 5,500 papers, collaboration has expanded, and research emphasis has progressed from eco-hydrological interactions toward flood prediction and climate-risk assessment. River flooding remains dominant, while urban-flood attention increased over the past decade and geographic leadership evolved toward a United States-China dual core. For HydroAgent monitoring, the study is useful as evidence that LLMs can support large-scale hydrological literature synthesis and field mapping, but it does not demonstrate an autonomous agent that invokes hydrological models or controls water-system decisions.
details.zh: 该综述使用大型语言模型筛选并整理1985年至2024年的57,474篇洪水出版物，随后绘制出版增长、合作、学科影响、主题和地理集中度。报告显示，目前年产出已超过5,500篇论文，合作不断扩大，研究重点已从生态水文相互作用发展到洪水预测和气候风险评估。河流洪水仍占主导地位，而过去十年对城市洪水的关注有所增加，地理主导地位则演变为美国—中国双核心格局。对于HydroAgent监测而言，该研究可作为LLM能够支持大规模水文学文献综合和领域制图的证据，但并未展示一个能够调用水文模型或控制水系统决策的自主代理。

limitations.en: The LLM supports literature screening and synthesis; the study is adjacent evidence and should not be interpreted as an operational AI-agent or autonomous hydrological workflow.
limitations.zh: LLM支持文献筛选和综合；该研究属于相关证据，不应被解读为可操作的AI代理或自主水文工作流。

papers.title: Retrospective Assessment of Urban Flooding Susceptibility on the Qinghai–Tibet Plateau Under Data Scarcity

summary.en: LLM semantic mining converts historical disaster archives into spatial flood samples for a high-resolution Qinghai–Tibet Plateau waterlogging susceptibility model.
summary.zh: LLM语义挖掘将历史灾害档案转换为高分辨率青藏高原内涝易感性模型的空间洪涝样本。

details.en: The study reconstructs 1985–2003 urban-waterlogging evidence on the Qinghai–Tibet Plateau by combining LLM-based semantic mining of historical disaster archives, spatial reconstruction, and XGBoost-SHAP susceptibility modeling. The extracted records become spatial training samples for a high-resolution atlas; the reported spatial-block cross-validation AUC is 0.9793, and high-susceptibility areas cover about 45% of the region's urban built-up area. SHAP results identify geomorphic confinement as a stronger control than most climatic variables, supporting historical flood-risk assessment under data scarcity.
details.zh: 本研究通过结合基于LLM的历史灾害档案语义挖掘、空间重建和XGBoost-SHAP易感性建模，重建了1985–2003年青藏高原城市内涝证据。提取的记录成为高分辨率图集的空间训练样本；报告的空间分块交叉验证AUC为0.9793，高易感性区域约占该地区城市建成区面积的45%。SHAP结果表明，地貌约束比大多数气候变量具有更强的控制作用，为数据稀缺条件下的历史洪涝风险评估提供支持。

limitations.en: The LLM is used for semantic mining rather than as a tool-using autonomous agent.
limitations.zh: LLM用于语义挖掘，而不是作为能够使用工具的自主智能体。

papers.title: Operational SAR flood mapping as a full-stack systems problem: an AI-enabled perspective

summary.en: An AI-agent-assisted, human-supervised development workflow rebuilt SIENA into a multi-daily operational Sentinel-1 flood-mapping service.
summary.zh: 一种由AI代理辅助、人工监督的开发工作流，将SIENA重建为一项每日多次运行的Sentinel-1洪水制图服务。

details.en: This perspective reframes operational SAR flood mapping as a coordinated full-stack system spanning data access, preprocessing, ancillary data, model logic, computing, validation, and maintenance. It documents a human-supervised, AI-agent-assisted rebuild of the SIENA Sentinel-1 workflow and compares the resulting system against operational water and flood products in four evaluation settings. The rebuilt workflow now supports public flood-product updates several times per day over CONUS and Alaska while retaining hydrologic validation and human oversight.
details.zh: 该观点将业务化SAR洪水制图重新定义为一个协调一致的全栈系统，涵盖数据访问、预处理、辅助数据、模型逻辑、计算、验证和维护。文中记录了对SIENA Sentinel-1工作流进行人工监督、AI代理辅助的重建，并在四种评估设置下将所得系统与业务化水体和洪水产品进行了比较。重建后的工作流现已支持在CONUS和Alaska上每日多次更新公共洪水产品，同时保留水文验证和人工监督。

limitations.en: The collected abstract describes a perspective and operational case study but does not specify the AI-agent architecture.
limitations.zh: 所收集的摘要描述了一个观点和业务化案例研究，但未具体说明AI代理架构。

papers.title: Knowledge-Based Feature Selection Substantially Enhances Data-Driven Wastewater Treatment Modeling

summary.en: LLM-augmented, knowledge-based feature selection preserves wastewater N2O model generalizability under high-flow distribution shift.
summary.zh: 基于LLM增强的知识型特征选择在高流量分布偏移下保持废水N2O模型的泛化能力。

details.en: The study combines mechanistic knowledge with statistical correlation for feature selection in full-scale wastewater-treatment N2O modeling. It compares attention-based deep-learning selectors with expert-guided and LLM-augmented approaches: expert selection achieves the strongest reported accuracy, while the LLM-assisted approach remains competitive and preserves temporal generalizability under out-of-distribution high-flow conditions. The work positions LLM support as a practical route for incorporating domain knowledge into small, high-dimensional water-treatment datasets.
details.zh: 该研究将机理知识与统计相关性相结合，用于全规模废水处理N2O建模中的特征选择。研究比较了基于注意力的深度学习选择器，以及专家指导和LLM增强的方法：专家选择取得了报告中的最高准确率，而LLM辅助方法仍具有竞争力，并在分布外高流量条件下保持了时间泛化能力。该工作将LLM支持定位为一种实用途径，用于将领域知识融入小型、高维水处理数据集。

limitations.en: The LLM supports feature selection rather than acting as an autonomous or tool-using agent.
limitations.zh: LLM支持特征选择，而不是作为自主或使用工具的智能体。

papers.title: Can We Trust LLMs for Complex Earth System Model Analysis? Silent Failure and Evidence from Module-Grounded Benchmarking

details.en: Abstract. Large language models (LLMs) are becoming increasingly capable of complex scientific scripting, but this growing robustness creates a paradox: the more trustworthy their outputs appear, the more easily scientifically incorrect results can pass unnoticed. In Earth system model (ESM) analysis, such silent failures are more dangerous than visible crashes because they produce plausible figures and statistics that may be accepted without detailed inspection.
details.zh: 摘要。大型语言模型（LLMs）在复杂科学脚本编写方面的能力日益增强，但这种不断提高的稳健性带来了一个悖论：其输出看起来越值得信赖，科学上不正确的结果就越容易在未被察觉的情况下通过。在地球系统模型（ESM）分析中，这类无声失败比明显的崩溃更加危险，因为它们会生成看似合理的图表和统计结果，可能在未经详细检查的情况下被接受。

papers.title: Water-MAS: A multi-agent LLM framework with instruction-data decoupling for smart water management

summary.en: Water-MAS is an LLM multi-agent framework for smart water management that combines planning, execution, and checking agents with instruction-data decoupling.
summary.zh: Water-MAS 是一个用于智慧水务管理的 LLM 多智能体框架，将规划、执行和检查智能体与指令-数据解耦相结合。

details.en: Water-MAS addresses complex water-management workflows where single-agent tool use struggles with accuracy, adaptability, and long heterogeneous data. The framework uses planning, execution, and checking agents and separates task instructions from underlying data to reduce overhead. The paper evaluates multi-agent collaboration and instruction-data decoupling on tool-invocation tasks, compares foundation models, and demonstrates applications in water sampling and water-quality forecasting, making it direct evidence for LLM-based multi-agent workflows in water environmental monitoring and analysis.
details.zh: Water-MAS 解决了复杂的水务管理工作流问题，在这些工作流中，单智能体工具使用在准确性、适应性和长异构数据方面面临困难。该框架采用规划、执行和检查智能体，并将任务指令与底层数据分离，以降低开销。该论文在工具调用任务上评估了多智能体协作和指令-数据解耦，比较了基础模型，并展示了其在水样采集和水质预测中的应用，为基于 LLM 的水环境监测与分析多智能体工作流提供了直接证据。

papers.title: Systematic LLM Translation of Legacy Scientific Code to Differentiable Frameworks: Application to a Land Surface Model

summary.en: An LLM-based agentic pipeline translates a land surface model from Fortran to differentiable JAX with autonomous repair loops.
summary.zh: 一个基于 LLM 的智能体流程将陆面模型从 Fortran 转换为可微分的 JAX，并通过自主修复循环实现转换。

details.en: This arXiv preprint presents a five-phase LLM-based agentic pipeline for translating legacy scientific Fortran code into JAX. The workflow uses dependency analysis, autonomous compile-repair loops, and a Fortran reference oracle to enforce numerical parity. It is demonstrated on CLM-ml-v2, a 19,000-line land surface model, producing a differentiable model that supports full-Jacobian computation and faster parameter recovery. The relevance to HydroAgent is the agentic workflow for model transformation and calibration-enabling infrastructure, though it is framed as land-surface/Earth-system modeling rather than hydrology alone.
details.zh: 这篇 arXiv 预印本介绍了一个基于 LLM 的五阶段智能体流程，用于将遗留科学 Fortran 代码转换为 JAX。该工作流采用依赖分析、自主编译-修复循环和 Fortran 参考预言机来确保数值一致性。该方法在 CLM-ml-v2 上进行了演示，这是一个包含 19,000 行代码的陆面模型，生成了一个支持全 Jacobian 计算和更快参数恢复的可微分模型。其与 HydroAgent 的相关性在于用于模型转换和支持校准的智能体工作流基础设施，不过其定位是陆面/地球系统建模，而非仅限于水文学。

limitations.en: The source is not hydrology-specific; it is included because land surface models are central Earth-system components with hydrologic process relevance.
limitations.zh: 该来源并非针对水文学；之所以纳入，是因为陆面模型是地球系统的核心组成部分，并且与水文过程相关。

papers.title: Multi-Engine Collaborative Large Language Models Enhance the Intelligence of Eco-Environmental Monitoring and Governance in China

details.en: The expansion of China’s modernized eco-environmental monitoring networks has generated vast amounts of data. Consequently, traditional, expertise-reliant analysis is increasingly ill-suited for agile regulatory decision-making. Although large language models (LLMs) present a promising alternative, their practical deployment remains limited by domain-specific knowledge gaps, hallucinations and an inherent difficulty in managing multi-faceted ecological tasks.
details.zh: 中国现代化生态环境监测网络的扩展产生了海量数据。因此，传统的、依赖专业知识的分析越来越不适合敏捷的监管决策。尽管大型语言模型（LLM）提供了一种有前景的替代方案，但其实际部署仍受到领域特定知识缺口、幻觉以及管理多方面生态任务的固有困难的限制。

papers.title: LLM-Driven Diagnostic Reasoning for Distributed Hydrological Model Calibration

details.en: Calibration of distributed hydrological models remains computationally intensive in nested-basin systems, where upstream errors propagate downstream, and performance must be balanced across multiple outlets. Traditional optimization algorithms rely on scalar performance metrics and require thousands of model evaluations to converge. Manual expert calibration and recent single-agent LLM approaches use process-level signals, but their extension to coupled multi-basin systems remains largely unexplored.
details.zh: 分布式水文模型的校准在嵌套流域系统中仍然计算密集，因为上游误差会向下游传播，且必须在多个出口之间平衡性能。传统优化算法依赖标量性能指标，并需要进行数千次模型评估才能收敛。手动专家校准和近期的单智能体 LLM 方法使用过程级信号，但其向耦合多流域系统的扩展仍基本未被探索。

papers.title: KISS - Knowledge Infrastructure for Scientific Simulation: A Scaffolding for Agentic Earth Science

summary.en: KISS builds agent-actionable knowledge infrastructure that improves autonomous execution on a coupled-hydrology benchmark.
summary.zh: KISS 构建了可供智能体执行的知识基础设施，提升了耦合水文基准测试中的自主执行能力。

details.en: This arXiv preprint introduces knowledge infrastructure as an agent-actionable scaffold for process-based scientific simulation. In a 3,000-trial coupled-hydrology benchmark, agents using the scaffold produced physically plausible and verifiable simulations far more often than agents without it. The work also introduces a Knowledge Dissection Toolkit that autonomously generates such infrastructure for many Earth-science models, making it directly relevant to autonomous workflow design for hydrology and Earth-system modeling.
details.zh: 这篇 arXiv 预印本将知识基础设施引入为基于过程的科学模拟的智能体可执行支架。在 3,000 次试验的耦合水文基准测试中，使用该支架的智能体生成物理上合理且可验证模拟的频率远高于未使用该支架的智能体。该工作还介绍了 Knowledge Dissection Toolkit，可为许多地球科学模型自主生成此类基础设施，使其与水文学和地球系统建模的自主工作流设计直接相关。

limitations.en: The work spans Earth science broadly; the hydrology evidence comes from the coupled-hydrology benchmark described in the abstract.
limitations.zh: 该工作广泛涵盖地球科学；其中的水文证据来自摘要中所述的耦合水文基准测试。

papers.title: Embracing large language model (LLM) technologies in hydrology research

summary.en: This EarthArXiv perspective frames LLMs as infrastructure for hydrological data, knowledge, and model development.
summary.zh: 这篇发表于 EarthArXiv 的观点文章将 LLMs 视为水文数据、知识和模型开发的基础设施。

details.en: This perspective reviews how LLMs can support hydrological research across data management, knowledge management, and model development. It argues that LLMs can extract and organize heterogeneous hydrological information, support knowledge retrieval and synthesis, and combine with modular development, chain-of-thought reasoning, and intent-based network ideas to transform physical model development. It is mainly a perspective and roadmap item rather than a single implemented autonomous agent.
details.zh: 这篇观点文章综述了 LLMs 如何支持涵盖数据管理、知识管理和模型开发的水文研究。文章认为，LLMs 可以提取和组织异构水文信息，支持知识检索与综合，并与模块化开发、思维链推理和基于意图的网络理念相结合，从而改变物理模型开发。它主要是一篇观点和路线图文章，而非单个已实施的自主智能体。

limitations.en: This is a perspective and topical review that synthesizes opportunities for hydrological data, knowledge, and model development; it does not evaluate a single implemented agent or an operational water-management deployment.
limitations.zh: 这是一篇观点和专题综述，综合了水文数据、知识和模型开发方面的机遇；它没有评估单个已实施的智能体或运营中的水管理部署。

papers.title: EPANET-Agentic: A multi-agent system for natural language-controlled simulations of water distribution networks

summary.en: EPANET-Agentic turns EPANET water-distribution simulations into a natural-language multi-agent workflow with orchestrator, execution, code-running, and data-analysis agents.
summary.zh: EPANET-Agentic 将 EPANET 水分配模拟转变为包含编排器、执行、代码运行和数据分析智能体的自然语言多智能体工作流。

details.en: EPANET-Agentic integrates large language models with EPANET to make water distribution network simulations controllable through natural-language prompts. The system uses an orchestrator-centered, tool-driven architecture with TaskExecutor, CodeRunner, and DataAnalyzer agents, plus human-in-the-loop oversight for safety-critical interventions. It is evaluated on L-Town, C-Town, and Net3 across hydraulic system characterization, dynamics, operation, and scenario simulation tasks, with the PDF reporting complete task success, accurate tool invocation, interpretable multimodal analysis, and scalability across hydraulic workflows.
details.zh: EPANET-Agentic 将大型语言模型与 EPANET 集成，使水分配网络模拟可通过自然语言提示进行控制。该系统采用以编排器为中心、工具驱动的架构，其中包括 TaskExecutor、CodeRunner 和 DataAnalyzer 智能体，并通过人在回路监督来确保安全关键干预的安全性。该系统在 L-Town、C-Town 和 Net3 上针对水力系统表征、动态特性、运行和场景模拟任务进行评估，PDF 报告显示其实现了完整的任务成功、准确的工具调用、可解释的多模态分析，以及跨水力工作流的可扩展性。

papers.title: Bloom or Bluff? Benchmarking Vision–Language Models Against Classical Machine Learning for Harmful Algal Bloom Detection from Satellite Imagery

summary.en: Benchmarks GPT-4o, GPT-5.5, and Claude Sonnet 4.6 as vision-language models for Lake Erie harmful algal bloom detection and finds classical multispectral ML remains stronger.
summary.zh: 将 GPT-4o、GPT-5.5 和 Claude Sonnet 4.6 作为用于伊利湖有害藻华检测的视觉语言模型进行基准测试，并发现经典多光谱 ML 仍然更强。

details.en: This paper is in scope as a water-quality remote-sensing study that tests large vision-language models on harmful algal bloom detection from Sentinel-2 imagery. Using western Lake Erie bloom events from 2019 to 2025, it compares GPT-4o, GPT-5.5, and Claude Sonnet 4.6 against Random Forest, SVM, and XGBoost baselines using RGB and multispectral inputs. The VLMs showed high recall mainly by over-labeling scenes as bloom-positive, producing high false positive rates and weak severity classification, while the multispectral SVM performed best overall. For HydroAgent tracking, the key signal is negative but useful: off-the-shelf VLMs are not yet reliable operational agents for aquatic remote sensing without domain-specific spectral information and adaptation.
details.zh: 本文属于水质遥感研究，测试大型视觉语言模型基于 Sentinel-2 影像进行有害藻华检测的能力。利用 2019 年至 2025 年西部伊利湖的藻华事件，将 GPT-4o、GPT-5.5 和 Claude Sonnet 4.6 与使用 RGB 和多光谱输入的 Random Forest、SVM 和 XGBoost 基线进行比较。VLM 主要通过将场景过度标记为藻华阳性来获得较高召回率，导致较高的假阳性率和较弱的严重程度分类性能，而多光谱 SVM 的总体表现最佳。对于 HydroAgent 跟踪，关键信号是否定的但具有实用价值：如果没有特定领域的光谱信息和适应能力，现成的 VLM 目前还不是水生遥感领域可靠的运行代理。

limitations.en: The work benchmarks VLMs rather than a full autonomous agent; it is retained because the scope includes LLM/VLM applications to water systems.
limitations.zh: 该工作对 VLM 进行了基准测试，而不是完整的自主代理；由于范围包括 LLM/VLM 在水系统中的应用，因此予以保留。

papers.title: Autonomous inverse modeling of complex groundwater systems via a physics-integrated large language model multi-agent framework

summary.en: Hydro-Agent uses LLM-driven reasoning and execution agents to generate, debug, and configure physics-based groundwater inverse-modeling simulations.
summary.zh: Hydro-Agent 使用 LLM 驱动的推理和执行智能体来生成、调试和配置基于物理的地下水反演建模模拟。

details.en: Hydro-Agent targets the gap between hydrogeological hypotheses and executable groundwater simulation code. The framework couples a HydroCoder reasoning agent with an Executor agent under a code-as-policy design, using LLMs to generate, debug, and adapt optimization strategies for process-based solvers instead of replacing them with black-box surrogates. The paper validates the approach across heterogeneous media, kinetic experiments, and the Aquia Aquifer, emphasizing mass-conserving, interpretable, and auditable inverse modeling for complex groundwater flow and reactive transport systems.
details.zh: Hydro-Agent 旨在弥合水文地质假设与可执行地下水模拟代码之间的差距。该框架采用代码即策略设计，将 HydroCoder 推理智能体与 Executor 智能体相结合，使用 LLM 生成、调试并调整面向过程的求解器的优化策略，而不是用黑箱代理模型取代它们。论文在非均质介质、动力学实验和 Aquia Aquifer 上验证了该方法，强调针对复杂地下水流动和反应性运移系统的守恒质量、可解释且可审计的反演建模。

papers.title: Assessing Large Multimodal Models for Urban Floodwater Depth Estimation

summary.en: Large multimodal models, including GPT-4, are evaluated for image-based urban floodwater depth estimation.
summary.zh: 包括 GPT-4 在内的大型多模态模型被用于评估基于图像的城市洪水水深估计。

details.en: This Water Resources Research paper evaluates whether large multimodal models can estimate urban floodwater depth from ground-level images. Using two urban flood image datasets, the study reports that LMM outputs show acceptable agreement with ground truth, with GPT-4 providing the strongest reported performance. It also examines how image complexity and textual prompting affect model performance. The item is relevant because it links multimodal foundation models to flood monitoring, flood forecasting data expansion, and model calibration support.
details.zh: 这篇 Water Resources Research 论文评估了大型多模态模型能否根据地面图像估计城市洪水水深。利用两个城市洪水图像数据集，该研究报告称，LMM 输出与真实值表现出可接受的一致性，其中 GPT-4 提供了报告中的最佳性能。研究还考察了图像复杂性和文本提示如何影响模型性能。该条目具有相关性，因为它将多模态基础模型与洪水监测、洪水预报数据扩展和模型校准支持联系起来。

limitations.en: The work uses LMMs for estimation rather than a fully autonomous tool-using agent.
limitations.zh: 该工作使用 LMM 进行估计，而不是使用完全自主的工具调用智能体。

papers.title: AI Agent for Hydrologic Modeling: Definition, Development, and Application

summary.en: Defines a six-level autonomy framework for hydrologic modeling and demonstrates a Level-4 LLM-powered agent on the July 2025 Texas flash flood case.
summary.zh: 定义了一个用于水文建模的六级自主性框架，并在2025年7月德克萨斯州山洪事件案例中展示了一个由LLM驱动的Level-4智能体。

details.en: This paper is directly in scope because it formalizes AI-agent autonomy for hydrologic modeling and implements a Level-4 LLM-powered agent that turns natural-language requests into data retrieval, model execution, diagnostics, and reporting with human oversight. Its proof-of-concept application to the July 2025 Texas flash flood reproduced key flood dynamics and reduced manual workflow effort, while also showing an important limitation: a forecast-driven run missed the flood response when deterministic rainfall displaced the storm core. The evidence supports the feasibility of AI-agent-assisted hydrologic modeling, but the source also cautions that robustness across basins and events still requires systematic validation, probabilistic meteorological forcing, and expert review of automated outputs.
details.zh: 本文与该主题直接相关，因为它形式化了水文建模中的AI智能体自主性，并实现了一个由LLM驱动的Level-4智能体，在人工监督下将自然语言请求转化为数据检索、模型运行、诊断和报告。其在2025年7月德克萨斯州山洪事件中的概念验证应用再现了关键洪水动态，并减少了工作流程中的人工操作，同时也显示出一个重要局限：当确定性降雨使风暴核心发生偏移时，由预报驱动的运行未能捕捉到洪水响应。证据支持AI智能体辅助水文建模的可行性，但来源也指出，在不同流域和事件中的稳健性仍需要系统验证、概率气象强迫，以及专家对自动化输出的审查。

limitations.en: Evidence is based on the collected abstract and metadata; broader robustness claims remain limited to the proof-of-concept case described by the source.
limitations.zh: 证据基于所收集的摘要和元数据；更广泛的稳健性主张仍局限于来源所描述的概念验证案例。

papers.title: WaterGPT: Training a Large Language Model to Become a Hydrology Expert

summary.en: WaterGPT trains a language model for multimodal hydrology tasks and hydrological decision support.
summary.zh: WaterGPT 训练一个用于多模态水文学任务和水文决策支持的语言模型。

details.en: The collected abstract introduces WaterGPT as a language model designed for complex multimodal tasks in hydrology. It targets processing and analyzing images/text in water resources, supporting intelligent decision-making for hydrological tasks, and enabling interdisciplinary information integration and knowledge-based Q&A. This is a strong HydroAgent-relevant source for domain-specialized hydrology LLMs, though the collected evidence does not necessarily describe a tool-using agent architecture.
details.zh: 所收集的摘要介绍了 WaterGPT，这是一个为水文学中的复杂多模态任务而设计的语言模型。它旨在处理和分析水资源领域的图像/文本，支持水文任务的智能决策，并实现跨学科信息整合和基于知识的问答。这是一个与 HydroAgent 高度相关的领域专用水文学 LLM 来源，尽管所收集的证据不一定描述了工具使用型智能体架构。

papers.title: Transparent Large Language Model-Assisted Pump Scheduling: Performance Evaluation and Interpretability in Water Distribution Systems
papers.venue: World Environmental and Water Resources Congress 2026

summary.en: This paper uses sparse autoencoders to interpret GPT-2 pump-control recommendations for LLM-assisted water-distribution scheduling.
summary.zh: 本文使用稀疏自编码器解释 GPT-2 针对 LLM 辅助的供水系统调度所提出的泵控制建议。

details.en: The paper addresses energy-intensive pump scheduling in water distribution systems and studies how a GPT-2 model represents pump-control information learned from hydraulic-simulation summaries. Using about 60,000 daily operational summaries covering pump start levels, minimum pressure, tank alarms, and energy metrics, the authors train a sparse autoencoder over hidden activations to identify sparse, human-interpretable features. Feature attribution, activation analysis, and clustering are used to evaluate how these features influence recommended control adjustments, making the paper useful evidence for transparent LLM-assisted control in water infrastructure.
details.zh: 本文针对供水系统中能耗较高的泵调度问题，研究 GPT-2 模型如何表示从水力模拟摘要中学习到的泵控制信息。作者使用约 60,000 条每日运行摘要，涵盖泵启动水位、最低压力、水箱报警和能耗指标，在隐藏激活之上训练稀疏自编码器，以识别稀疏且可由人解释的特征。研究使用特征归因、激活分析和聚类来评估这些特征如何影响推荐的控制调整，使本文成为支持供水基础设施中透明的 LLM 辅助控制的有用证据。

limitations.en: The work concerns interpretable LLM-assisted scheduling, not a fully autonomous deployed water-control agent.
limitations.zh: 该工作涉及可解释的 LLM 辅助调度，而不是完全自主部署的供水控制代理。

papers.title: Toward Automated Scientific Discovery in Hydrology: The Opportunities and Dangers of AI Augmented Research Frameworks

summary.en: INDRA is a multi-agent LLM framework for AI-augmented hydrological modeling workflows.
summary.zh: INDRA 是一个用于 AI 增强型水文建模工作流的多智能体 LLM 框架。

details.en: The commentary introduces INDRA, an Intelligent Network for Dynamic River Analysis, as a prototype AI-assisted framework built from specialized LLM agents. It integrates with CONFLUENCE to support model conceptualization, configuration, execution, and interpretation in hydrological modeling. This is one of the clearest HydroAgent-frontier entries because it directly connects multi-agent LLM architecture with automated scientific discovery in hydrology, while also discussing opportunities and risks.
details.zh: 该评论介绍了 INDRA（智能动态河流分析网络），这是一个由专门化 LLM 智能体构建的原型 AI 辅助框架。它与 CONFLUENCE 集成，以支持水文建模中的模型概念化、配置、执行和解释。这是 HydroAgent 前沿条目中最清晰的条目之一，因为它将多智能体 LLM 架构与水文学中的自动化科学发现直接连接起来，同时也讨论了机遇和风险。

papers.title: Retrieval Augmented Generation for Tables in Textual Documents based on Graph Representation Learning

summary.en: Related entry: this paper applies graph-based retrieval and LLM question answering to tables in water-resources documents.
summary.zh: 相关条目：本文将基于图的检索和 LLM 问答应用于水资源文档中的表格。

details.en: The abstract describes a retrieval-augmented generation method for water-resources documents containing important tables such as water intake and precipitation. It uses graph representation learning for table retrieval and an LLM for table question answering. This is relevant to HydroAgent knowledge ingestion and document reasoning, although it is not a hydrological simulation or autonomous modeling agent.
details.zh: 摘要介绍了一种针对包含取水量和降水量等重要表格的水资源文档的检索增强生成方法。该方法使用图表示学习进行表格检索，并使用 LLM 进行表格问答。这与 HydroAgent 的知识摄取和文档推理相关，但它不是水文模拟或自主建模智能体。

limitations.en: Relevant to water-resources document RAG, not to autonomous hydrological model control.
limitations.zh: 与水资源文档 RAG 相关，但与自主水文模型控制无关。

papers.title: Reservoir inflow forecasting using a large language model and time series approach

summary.en: TIME-LLM uses structured hydrological prompts to improve daily reservoir inflow forecasting with a large language model.
summary.zh: TIME-LLM 使用结构化水文提示，通过大型语言模型改进日尺度水库入流预测。

details.en: This Environmental Modelling & Software entry introduces TIME-LLM for daily reservoir inflow forecasting. The collected abstract says the framework uses structured prompts that include task instructions, dataset statistics, and hydrological context based on runoff yield and concentration mechanisms involving climate, surface conditions, and human activities. Reported results show lower MAE and RMSE and improved NSE and KGE in calibration and validation periods, indicating that the LLM-based time-series framework can capture temporal inflow patterns and respond to hydrological prompts. It is a strong LLM-for-hydrology entry, though it is better characterized as prompt-based forecasting than as a fully autonomous agent.
details.zh: 这篇 Environmental Modelling & Software 条目介绍了用于日尺度水库入流预测的 TIME-LLM。收集到的摘要称，该框架使用结构化提示，其中包括任务指令、数据集统计信息，以及基于径流产流和汇流机制的水文背景，这些机制涉及气候、地表条件和人类活动。报告结果显示，在校准期和验证期内，MAE 和 RMSE 更低，NSE 和 KGE 得到改进，表明基于 LLM 的时间序列框架能够捕捉入流的时间模式，并对水文提示作出响应。这是一项较强的 LLM-for-hydrology 条目，但将其描述为基于提示的预测，而非完全自主的智能体，更为恰当。

limitations.en: The canonical RSS source has limited metadata; the full summary uses the duplicate source record with manually enriched publisher abstract. The work is LLM-based forecasting rather than a fully autonomous tool-using agent.
limitations.zh: 规范 RSS 来源的元数据有限；完整摘要使用了重复来源记录，其中的出版商摘要经过人工补充。这项工作属于基于 LLM 的预测，而不是完全自主的工具调用智能体。

papers.title: Leveraging large language models for automating water distribution network optimization.

summary.en: This Water Research paper uses LLMs to automate water distribution network optimization and hydraulic decision-making.
summary.zh: 这篇 Water Research 论文使用 LLMs 自动化供水管网优化和水力决策。

details.en: The abstract focuses on water distribution networks, where management tasks require system modeling, optimization, and specialized domain expertise. It argues that LLMs can help automate complex hydraulic decision-making tasks. This is strongly relevant to HydroAgent because it applies LLM automation to water-system optimization rather than generic text analysis.
details.zh: 摘要聚焦于供水管网，其中管理任务需要系统建模、优化和专业领域知识。论文认为，LLMs 可以帮助自动化复杂的水力决策任务。这与 HydroAgent 高度相关，因为它将 LLM 自动化应用于水系统优化，而不是通用文本分析。

papers.title: Leveraging Large Language Models for Agent‐Based Simulation of Human‐Water System Interactions

summary.en: This paper uses LLMs to support agent-based simulation of human-water system interactions.
summary.zh: 本文使用LLMs支持人类-水系统交互的基于智能体的模拟。

details.en: The paper addresses human-water system interactions, where agent-based models are useful but often depend on manually coded rules, simplified behavioral assumptions, and limited qualitative information. The collected abstract states that LLMs are used to simulate agent decisions through natural-language reasoning guided by behavioral theory frameworks. This is directly relevant to HydroAgent because it links LLM reasoning, agent-based simulation, and socio-hydrological modeling.
details.zh: 本文研究人类-水系统交互，其中基于智能体的模型很有用，但通常依赖手动编码的规则、简化的行为假设和有限的定性信息。所收集的摘要指出，LLMs通过行为理论框架指导的自然语言推理来模拟智能体决策。这与HydroAgent直接相关，因为它将LLM推理、基于智能体的模拟和社会-水文建模联系起来。

papers.title: Large Language Models for Water Distribution Systems Modeling and Decision-Making
papers.venue: World Environmental and Water Resources Congress 2025

summary.en: LLM-EPANET studies plain-language interaction with hydraulic and water-quality models for water-distribution simulation and decision support.
summary.zh: LLM-EPANET研究了使用自然语言与水力和水质模型进行交互，以支持供水系统模拟和决策支持。

details.en: This conference paper frames water distribution system modeling as a high-burden expert workflow and proposes plain-language interaction with hydraulic and water-quality models through an LLM-EPANET architecture. The framework is tested across increasingly complex query types to assess whether LLMs can interact with WDS models, run simulations, and report results. Its value for HydroAgent is as evidence that LLM interfaces can reduce the programming and interpretation barrier around water-infrastructure models and support model-informed decision-making for non-specialists.
details.zh: 这篇会议论文将供水系统建模描述为一项负担较重的专家工作流程，并提出通过LLM-EPANET架构使用自然语言与水力和水质模型进行交互。该框架针对日益复杂的查询类型进行测试，以评估LLM是否能够与WDS模型交互、运行模拟并报告结果。其对HydroAgent的价值在于证明，LLM接口可以降低围绕水基础设施模型的编程和解释门槛，并支持非专业人员进行基于模型的决策。

limitations.en: The abstract describes an LLM decision-support interface rather than a fully autonomous agent workflow.
limitations.zh: 摘要描述的是一种LLM决策支持接口，而不是完整的自主智能体工作流程。

papers.title: Large Language Models as Calibration Agents in Hydrological Modeling: Feasibility and Limitations

summary.en: This paper evaluates LLMs as calibration agents for hydrological modeling and compares them with standard calibration benchmarks.
summary.zh: 本文评估了 LLM 作为水文建模校准智能体的表现，并将其与标准校准基准进行了比较。

details.en: The abstract positions hydrological model calibration as an underexplored target for modern LLMs and evaluates five advanced LLMs against traditional calibration benchmarks, including SCE-UA. This is directly relevant to HydroAgent because it treats LLMs as calibration agents for hydrological modeling and focuses on feasibility and limitations rather than generic AI enthusiasm. It should be a priority source for understanding where LLM agents can or cannot replace established calibration methods.
details.zh: 摘要将水文模型校准定位为现代 LLM 尚未得到充分探索的目标，并将五种先进 LLM 与包括 SCE-UA 在内的传统校准基准进行了评估。这与 HydroAgent 直接相关，因为它将 LLM 视为水文建模的校准智能体，并关注可行性和局限性，而不是对通用 AI 的热情推崇。它应作为理解 LLM 智能体在何种情况下能够或不能替代成熟校准方法的优先来源。

papers.title: IWMS-LLM: an intelligent water resources management system based on large language models

summary.en: IWMS-LLM proposes an LLM-based intelligent water resources management system with visual workflow orchestration.
summary.zh: IWMS-LLM 提出了一种基于 LLM 的智能水资源管理系统，并配备可视化工作流编排。

details.en: The abstract frames water resources management as dynamic, uncertain, and poorly served by fixed-process information systems. IWMS-LLM uses large language models and visual workflow orchestration to make water resources management tasks more flexible and responsive to emerging needs and sudden events. This is a direct HydroAgent-relevant entry because it links LLMs, water-resources decision support, and orchestrated workflows.
details.zh: 摘要将水资源管理描述为动态、不确定，且固定流程信息系统难以充分应对的领域。IWMS-LLM 使用大型语言模型和可视化工作流编排，使水资源管理任务更加灵活，并能更及时地响应新出现的需求和突发事件。这是一个与 HydroAgent 直接相关的条目，因为它将 LLM、水资源决策支持和编排式工作流联系起来。

papers.title: Hydrological Research Evolution: A Large Language Model‐Based Analysis of 310,000 Studies Published Globally Between 1980 and 2023

summary.en: Context entry: this paper uses LLM-based analysis to map 310,000 global hydrology studies from 1980 to 2023.
summary.zh: 背景条目：本文使用基于LLM的分析，对1980年至2023年的310,000项全球水文学研究进行制图。

details.en: The abstract frames hydrology as central to understanding Earth water systems and addressing water-related problems under climate change. It uses LLM-based analysis to assess a very large corpus of hydrological studies, especially around hydrological basins as spatial-geographic units. This is useful for background and literature-landscape analysis, but it is not a HydroAgent-style autonomous modeling workflow.
details.zh: 摘要将水文学描述为理解地球水系统以及在气候变化下应对与水相关问题的核心。本文使用基于LLM的分析，评估了一个规模非常庞大的水文学研究语料库，尤其关注作为空间地理单元的水文流域。这对于背景和文献图景分析很有用，但它不是HydroAgent式的自主建模工作流。

limitations.en: Relevant to LLM-assisted hydrology literature analysis, not to LLM agents controlling hydrological models.
limitations.zh: 与LLM辅助的水文学文献分析相关，但与控制水文模型的LLM代理无关。

papers.title: HydroAgent: Closing the Gap Between Frontier LLMs and Human Experts in Hydrologic Model Calibration via Simulator-Grounded RL

details.en: Calibrating distributed hydrologic models is a critical bottleneck across operational water resources management - streamflow prediction, reservoir operation, drought monitoring, infrastructure design, and flood forecasting all depend on it. Each basin demands an expert to translate hydrograph signatures into adjustments of a high-dimensional parameter vector, and the resulting workflow does not transfer between watersheds. We ask: can frontier large language model (LLM) agents replace the human hydrologic modeler, and if not, what would it take?
details.zh: 校准分布式水文模型是业务化水资源管理中的一个关键瓶颈——径流预测、水库运行、干旱监测、基础设施设计和洪水预报都依赖于此。每个流域都需要专家将水文过程线特征转化为对高维参数向量的调整，而由此产生的工作流程无法在不同流域之间迁移。我们提出的问题是：前沿大型语言模型（LLM）代理能否取代人类水文模型师；如果不能，需要具备什么条件？

limitations.en: Preprint evidence; the prior arXiv 2605.27957 identity and local PDF association were corrected to arXiv 2605.17792.
limitations.zh: 预印本证据；此前的 arXiv 2605.27957 标识和本地 PDF 关联已更正为 arXiv 2605.17792。

papers.title: Fine-tuning large language models for interdisciplinary environmental challenges

summary.en: Context entry: this paper addresses fine-tuning LLMs for interdisciplinary environmental challenges including hydrology and climate modeling.
summary.zh: 背景条目：本文探讨针对包括水文学和气候建模在内的跨学科环境挑战对 LLM 进行微调。

details.en: The abstract argues that environmental science requires domain-specific data and evaluation because it spans climate dynamics, ecosystem management, hydrology, and other specialized areas. It focuses on fine-tuning and evaluating LLMs for interdisciplinary environmental challenges rather than on agentic hydrology workflows. It is useful background for data generation, evaluation, and domain adaptation in HydroAgent development.
details.zh: 摘要指出，环境科学涵盖气候动力学、生态系统管理、水文学以及其他专业领域，因此需要领域特定的数据和评估。本文重点关注针对跨学科环境挑战对 LLM 进行微调和评估，而不是智能体化的水文工作流。它为 HydroAgent 开发中的数据生成、评估和领域适应提供了有用背景。

limitations.en: Relevant to environmental LLM adaptation, but no autonomous hydrology-agent workflow is evident in the collected abstract.
limitations.zh: 与环境领域的 LLM 适应相关，但在收集的摘要中没有明显体现自主水文智能体工作流。

papers.title: Classifying Hydrological Risk Adaptation Policies with Large Language Models: the HYDROADAPT Dataset

summary.en: HYDROADAPT uses an LLM classification pipeline to build a geolocated dataset of hydrological-risk adaptation policies.
summary.zh: HYDROADAPT 使用 LLM 分类流程构建了一个水文风险适应政策地理定位数据集。

details.en: This paper introduces HYDROADAPT, a dataset for measuring adaptation policy related to hydrological risks such as floods and landslides. It uses a custom LLM-powered classification pipeline over Italy’s OpenCUP public-investment registry, focusing on Emilia-Romagna and identifying more than 24,000 hydrological-instability-related projects. The workflow classifies interventions as Ex-Ante or Ex-Post, adds geolocation, time stamps, funding, policy-instrument, and implementing-body metadata, and uses the May 2023 floods for validation, making it relevant evidence for LLM-based hydrological-risk policy intelligence.
details.zh: 本文介绍了 HYDROADAPT，这是一个用于衡量与洪水和滑坡等水文风险相关的适应政策的数据集。该数据集使用基于自定义 LLM 的分类流程，对意大利 OpenCUP 公共投资登记系统中的数据进行处理，重点关注艾米利亚-罗马涅大区，并识别出超过 24,000 个与水文不稳定性相关的项目。该工作流程将干预措施分类为 Ex-Ante 或 Ex-Post，添加地理定位、时间戳、资金、政策工具和实施机构元数据，并使用 2023 年 5 月的洪水进行验证，使其成为与基于 LLM 的水文风险政策情报相关的证据。

limitations.en: The work is an LLM text-classification and policy-dataset pipeline, not a hydrological model-control agent.
limitations.zh: 该工作是一个 LLM 文本分类和政策数据集流程，而不是水文模型控制代理。

papers.title: Advances in hydrological research in China over the past two decades: Insights from advanced large language model and topic modeling

summary.en: Context entry: this paper uses LLM and topic modeling to analyze two decades of hydrological research in China.
summary.zh: 背景介绍：本文使用 LLM 和主题建模分析中国二十年的水文学研究。

details.en: The collected highlights report that advanced technologies including large language models and topic modeling reveal evolving hydrology research patterns in China from 2000 to 2023. The work identifies growth in publications, collaboration, common hydrological models, and shifts toward ecological hydrology, climate change, and carbon dynamics. It is valuable for landscape context, but it is not an agentic workflow or HydroAgent implementation paper.
details.zh: 所收集的亮点报告显示，包括大型语言模型和主题建模在内的先进技术揭示了 2000 年至 2023 年中国水文学研究模式的演变。该研究发现，出版物数量、合作和常用水文模型均有所增长，研究重点也转向生态水文学、气候变化和碳动态。对于景观背景而言，这项工作具有价值，但它不是智能体工作流或 HydroAgent 实现论文。

limitations.en: Relevant to LLM-assisted bibliometric analysis, not to LLM agents controlling hydrological models.
limitations.zh: 与 LLM 辅助的文献计量分析相关，但与控制水文模型的 LLM 智能体无关。

papers.title: A novel hybrid modeling-based artificial intelligence agent for water-food-ecology-environment-economy system trade-offs

summary.en: A hybrid AI Agent combines agro-hydrological modeling, machine learning, MCDM, and an LLM to optimize water-food-ecology-environment-economy trade-offs.
summary.zh: 一种混合型 AI Agent 结合农业水文建模、机器学习、MCDM 和 LLM，以优化水资源-粮食-生态-环境-经济权衡。

details.en: This Journal of Hydrology entry describes an AI Agent for water-food-ecology-environment-economy trade-offs. The source evidence says the system integrates an agro-hydrological model, machine learning, multi-criteria decision making, and a large language model within an AI development platform. It automatically optimizes irrigation, fertilization, and crop planting structures while balancing irrigation water productivity, crop yield, ecosystem service value, nitrogen pollution load, and economic benefit. In the Wuliangsuhai lake watershed case, the abstract reports improved sustainability outcomes by reducing irrigation and nitrogen inputs and optimizing the wheat-to-maize ratio under combined hydrological-year, irrigation, nitrogen, and planting-structure scenarios.
details.zh: 这篇 Journal of Hydrology 条目描述了一种用于水资源-粮食-生态-环境-经济权衡的 AI Agent。来源证据表明，该系统在一个 AI 开发平台内集成了农业水文模型、机器学习、多标准决策和大型语言模型。它在平衡灌溉水生产率、作物产量、生态系统服务价值、氮污染负荷和经济效益的同时，自动优化灌溉、施肥和作物种植结构。在 Wuliangsuhai 湖流域案例中，摘要报告称，在水文年、灌溉、氮和种植结构综合情景下，通过减少灌溉和氮投入并优化小麦与玉米的比例，实现了可持续性结果的改善。

limitations.en: The canonical RSS source has limited metadata; the full summary uses the duplicate source record with manually enriched publisher abstract.
limitations.zh: 规范 RSS 来源的元数据有限；完整摘要使用了包含人工丰富出版商摘要的重复来源记录。

papers.title: A Multi-Agent and GraphRAG-Based Framework for Operation and Management Decision-Making in Hydraulic Projects

summary.en: This paper builds a multi-agent LLM + GraphRAG framework for hydraulic-project inspection and operation-management decisions.
summary.zh: 本文构建了一个用于水利工程巡检和运行管理决策的多智能体 LLM + GraphRAG 框架。

details.en: The Springer abstract describes hydraulic-project inspection as a safety-critical management task limited by manual labor, low risk-identification accuracy, and weak dynamic decision capability. It proposes a multi-agent collaborative decision framework integrating LLMs and GraphRAG, organized around perception, cognition, and decision modules for automated inspection. The study uses three years of multi-source inspection data, builds a multimodal dataset, reports improved F1 scores for equipment recognition and defect detection after domain-adaptive fine-tuning, and adds a dynamic knowledge graph. This is directly relevant to HydroAgent-style water-infrastructure decision support.
details.zh: Springer 摘要将水利工程巡检描述为一项受人工劳动、较低的风险识别准确率和较弱的动态决策能力限制的安全关键型管理任务。本文提出了一个融合 LLM 和 GraphRAG 的多智能体协同决策框架，围绕感知、认知和决策模块组织，用于自动化巡检。该研究使用三年的多源巡检数据，构建了一个多模态数据集，报告称领域自适应微调后设备识别和缺陷检测的 F1 分数得到提升，并加入了一个动态知识图谱。这与 HydroAgent 风格的水基础设施决策支持直接相关。

papers.title: A Generalizable Automated Geophysical Agent Workflow in Subsurface Hydrology

summary.en: GAGAW is an LLM-based automated geophysical agent workflow for subsurface hydrology tasks.
summary.zh: GAGAW 是一种基于 LLM 的自动化地球物理智能体工作流，用于地下水文学任务。

details.en: The abstract introduces the Generalizable Automated Geophysical Agent Workflow (GAGAW), an LLM-based framework that automates complex geophysical workflows by managing multiple open-source tools through a natural-language interface. The motivation is directly tied to subsurface hydrology, where geophysical methods are useful but difficult for non-specialists and require chained tools. This is a strong HydroAgent-relevant example of tool orchestration, natural-language control, and domain workflow automation.
details.zh: 摘要介绍了通用化自动化地球物理智能体工作流（GAGAW），这是一个基于 LLM 的框架，通过自然语言接口管理多个开源工具，从而实现复杂地球物理工作流的自动化。其动机直接与地下水文学相关，在该领域，地球物理方法虽然有用，但对非专业人士而言难以使用，并且需要串联多个工具。这是一个与 HydroAgent 高度相关的工具编排、自然语言控制和领域工作流自动化示例。

papers.title: A Comparative Analysis between Visual Language and Large Language Models to Monitor Contaminated Water in the face of Climate Change

summary.en: Related monitoring entry: this paper compares VLM and LLM approaches for contaminated-water monitoring under climate-change framing.
summary.zh: 相关监测条目：本文在气候变化框架下比较了用于受污染水体监测的 VLM 和 LLM 方法。

details.en: The abstract compares report-generation approaches using a visual language model and a large language model for contaminated-water monitoring. It is relevant to multimodal language-model use in water quality or contaminated-water contexts, but the collected evidence describes model comparison rather than an autonomous agent or hydrological modeling workflow. Use it as adjacent evidence for LLM/VLM water monitoring.
details.zh: 摘要比较了使用视觉语言模型和大语言模型进行受污染水体监测的报告生成方法。它与多模态语言模型在水质或受污染水体场景中的应用相关，但所收集的证据描述的是模型比较，而非自主智能体或水文建模工作流。将其作为 LLM/VLM 水体监测的相关证据。

limitations.en: No autonomous agent component is evident in the collected abstract.
limitations.zh: 所收集的摘要中没有明显的自主智能体组件。

papers.title: HydroCraft: an efficient online platform for hydrological modeling integrated with a large language model agent

summary.en: HydroCraft packages watershed setup, forcing generation, calibration, visualization, and LLM-agent assistance into a browser-based hydrological modeling platform.
summary.zh: HydroCraft将流域设置、驱动数据生成、校准、可视化和LLM代理辅助集成到一个基于浏览器的水文建模平台中。

details.en: HydroCraft is a web-based platform intended to lower the expertise barrier for hydrological modeling by supporting basin extraction, driving-data generation, parameter calibration, and result visualization for watersheds globally. The platform includes adaptive watershed delineation, three hydrological models (THREW, Xin’anjiang, and Miyun Hydrological Model), and an LLM agent that provides modeling guidance and automated task execution. Two case studies compare user-driven and LLM-agent-assisted workflows, positioning HydroCraft as direct evidence for agent-supported hydrological modeling infrastructure and accessible simulation workflows.
details.zh: HydroCraft是一个基于网络的平台，旨在通过为全球流域提供流域提取、驱动数据生成、参数校准和结果可视化支持，降低水文建模的专业知识门槛。该平台包括自适应流域划分、三个水文模型（THREW、Xin’anjiang和Miyun Hydrological Model），以及一个提供建模指导和自动化任务执行的LLM代理。两个案例研究比较了用户驱动的工作流和LLM代理辅助的工作流，将HydroCraft定位为代理支持的水文建模基础设施和易于使用的模拟工作流的直接证据。

papers.title: Does AI Understand Hydrology? - Investigating AI recommended conceptual hydrological model setups

summary.en: This study tests whether AI can recommend conceptual hydrological model setups and reason like a hydrology assistant.
summary.zh: 本研究测试 AI 是否能够推荐概念性水文模型配置并像水文学助手一样进行推理。

details.en: The abstract frames LLM-based AI assistants as a timely question for hydrology and hydrologic modeling. It investigates whether AI can recommend conceptual hydrological model setups, which is directly relevant to using language models for model conceptualization and expert-like hydrological reasoning. This is a strong entry for the frontier around AI assistants in hydrological modeling workflows.
details.zh: 摘要将基于 LLM 的 AI 助手视为水文学和水文建模领域的一个及时问题。研究考察 AI 是否能够推荐概念性水文模型配置，这与使用语言模型进行模型概念化和类似专家的水文推理直接相关。这是水文建模工作流程中 AI 助手前沿方向的一个有力案例。
